reports.text: [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/live/2026/nov/17/donald-trump-alaska-senate-race-midterms-democrats-republicans-latest-news-updates) reported that challenger Mary Peltola is closing in on victory in the US Senate race in Alaska.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMioAFBVV95cUxQd1RRY19Ha3RVUnJmTDFJUzJFZk4wTlFEaElFUjJsbTJJZnBSV3JQWDZQeXNOZWswSlQ5OF9hcUNHMV95a3M4bGY2YjhPMm9GSFg0TjBpQXhoZkgzN2cxa2p2dHBjWUZLM0Zzbi01YVlHcVZRQjB2SHM4QU1MY3lRX2FoWW12RkdlVUJsblA1Y0gxOXE4MDZLRU1QRmJHaE9U?oc=5) reported that Democrat Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins stated his successful gubernatorial campaign covered every corner of Alaska.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitAFBVV95cUxQNTZXTFM5V00xOEJZcWtJU21rRENBM2lkQ3JCQmJvbUVRSDNqeWplR0FWSk9qSWVVdDAxR295VWxLMmNKb1Z0RmZURlQ3TV9ReHVrTW1nak9IVHpCNjduUXZZTG5NQ3JhT2pTNUR1N3dtZTNoZDVwdjNKeGY1cGxvSFNsYTNMMjhyZmNENkl1SDR4cFBDNllZdWRRbHhQa3BFUS1xc2lLTkFrOXNkZDNVSnJrRi0?oc=5) reported that Democrat Holscher won the Kansas governor's race amid data center backlash.

[Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/us-news/2026-11-14/ty-article/alaska-elects-a-democratic-governor-for-the-first-time-since-1998/000001a1-d911-da30-a7fb-d9bd00550000) reported that Jonathan Kreis-Tomkins defeated three Republicans to win the election for governor of Alaska.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimAFBVV95cUxNMFlrazk1QlViSjJ3ZjlhblpyOXFxT1FWZTkxSVdxc0NweEtuLUk3NDh6RkRDb1I2MVJnbG5yUm9hcmxtaHZ2VGtOT3MyaUxkSVE4MDJwMzU2NS16N2F1Tk5RLUdtaDl4TWt5NkxIT3JYZHJONGFaX3RRbXY2SW04MUc3UjhGMG1wQWtIeG91Nl9CRXRvMkdTTA?oc=5), [Politico](https://www.politico.com/news/2026/11/14/jonathan-kreiss-tomkins-wins-alaska-governor-01166573), [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/14/us/elections/alaska-governor-winner-kreiss-tomkins-jkt.html), [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/democrat-jonathan-kreiss-tomkins-wins-election-for-governor-in-alaska-101794632680893.html) reported that Democrat Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins won the election for governor of Alaska, defeating Dave Bronson and becoming the first Democrat elected to the office since 1998.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/13/mississippians-scott-colom-election) reported that Mississippians across racial lines celebrated Scott Colom becoming the state's first Black senator since Reconstruction.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/democrat-cindy-holscher-wins-kansas-governors-race-amid-datacenter-backlash-it-s-the-honor-of-a-lifetime-101794582914757.html) reported that Democrat Cindy Holscher won Kansas' governor's race after campaigning to pause data center approvals.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/trump-scott-colom-interview-praise-b3084510.html) reported that U.S. President Donald Trump praised Mississippi's Senator-elect Scott Colom following his historic senate upset.

[The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/historically-red-mississippi-and-alaska-win-blue-senate-seats) reported that historically red Mississippi and Alaska won blue Senate seats, breaking Republican strongholds.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/12/us/kansas-governor-democrat-holscher-wins.html) reported that State Senator Cindy Holscher won the Kansas governor race, retaining the seat for Democrats.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqwFBVV95cUxQdFAyRnM5T3lHNFY3S0NUd3lKQkpuZGJSdmJMMGc5aVJZanZmb2JRNjFlU1laTHp0OXJwRzZUSnRmbVlPR1J5OHp1ZUNPbDBwNm5xOEZ3N1ZRejAxNk5hU1dyWFNJdTJsZk4zaW1rbHBnODZZUUdlR0tVR0NKSlNYdTFHZ2pmRHpobUkwUzNnSENSQzlIQXJvd05TV3QtQlFLX2R6a3RNQi1DYW8?oc=5) reported that Democrat Cindy Holscher was elected Kansas' next governor.

[NPR World](https://www.npr.org/2026/11/12/g-s1-153171/up-first-newsletter-scott-colom-trump-democrats-ukraine-russia), [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/live/2026/nov/12/mississippi-scott-colom-ukraine-donald-trump) reported that Scott Colom won the Mississippi Senate race after more than a week of counting ballots.

[NPR World](https://www.npr.org/2026/11/12/g-s1-153171/up-first-newsletter-scott-colom-trump-democrats-ukraine-russia), [RT](https://rt-english.com/news/648747-trump-democrats-clash-corruption-probes/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS), a Russian state outlet, reported that White House counsel Will Scharf warned Democrats that their probes into Trump could lead to executive branch investigations.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiswFBVV95cUxPaTRFXzVMOVNIM2JnNFFkTzlrSmVYYnV5NTJlNDVVY1FhTXVBR1QybjdUd3JoVWpvZ3NRdFVGY0FkNlRmcW96d2VTR0tYei15dnp4eEhibFF4cGhwUnJnX3gwSHU0TEU4MUx2dE40V1BBSTZQYXVqOV9Nd0pkNXk0T3JQeFJ5emx3azFxMm5kLU5FLTJVcDJ5cmhURG9RYjBMVE1vbVJ6aEJiM3otQVFtVk5Cdw?oc=5), [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/12/us/elections/mississippi-colom-senate-race-black-voters.html), [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261112-mississippi-elects-democrat-colom-as-state-s-first-post-civil-war-black-senator), [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/scott-colom-wins-mississippi-senate-race-in-historic-upset-3725488) reported that Democrat Scott Colom won the Mississippi Senate race, becoming the state's first Black senator since the Reconstruction era or 1874.
[The Rio Times](https://www.riotimesonline.com/scott-colom-wins-mississippi-us-senate-seat-hyde-smith/) reported that Scott Colom defeated Republican Senator Cindy Hyde-Smith 49.2% to 48.7%.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/mississippi-senate-race-democrat-scott-colom-defeats-republican-cindy-hyde-smith/a-79924938?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that Democrat Scott Colom defeated Republican Cindy Hyde-Smith in the Mississippi Senate race.
[The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/mississippis-scott-colom-flips-us-senate-seat-democrat) reported that Scott Colom flipped a US Senate seat to the Democrats in Mississippi.

[Times of Malta](https://timesofmalta.com/article/mississippi-democrat-flips-us-senate-seat-historic-upset.1136956) reported that senator-elect Scott Colom waved during the conclusion of a victory rally at Tougaloo College.

[Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/mississippi-elege-democrata-scott-colom-primeiro-senador-negro-pelo-estado-dos-eua-em-150-anos.shtml) reported that Democrat Scott Colom won a seat in the United States Senate for Mississippi, becoming the first Black politician to win the seat in 150 years.
[Politico](https://www.politico.com/news/2026/11/11/scott-colom-wins-mississippi-senate-01161555) reported that Democrat Scott Colom won the Mississippi Senate race in an upset.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/videos/cjy5x42p3qzko?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that Scott Colom’s victory makes him the first Black person elected to the US Senate from Mississippi in over 140 years.
[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/11/us/elections/hyde-smith-concedes-senate-colom.html) reported that Senator Cindy Hyde-Smith conceded the race to Scott Colom.
[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/11/us/elections/colom-mississippi-senate-democrats.html) reported that Colom’s victory gives Democrats 55 seats in the Senate.

[Politico](https://www.politico.com/video/2026/11/11/business-leaders-and-washington-prepare-for-a-democratic-congress-2227260) reported that business leaders and Washington are preparing for a Democratic Congress.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/11/us/democratic-dark-money-super-pac-complaint.html) reported that a new Democratic-tied dark-money group is drawing scrutiny over its midterm spending.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/11/us/blue-texas-battleground-kansas-both-parties-wonder-if-the-map-has-shifted.html) reported that the breadth of Democrats' midterm victories has led both parties to wonder if the electoral map has shifted, particularly regarding Texas.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/immigration-arrests-go-on-unabated-despite-trumps-misgivings-after-gops-midterm-wipeout/article71688665.ece) reported that Donald Trump said his immigration crackdown may have been too tough and suggested it was time for a change after Democrats won control of the next Congress.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/trump-ally-jim-jordan-elected-us-house-republican-leader-after-midterm-election-rout/article71688105.ece) reported that Ohio Congressman Jim Jordan was elected U.S. House Republican leader after the midterm election rout.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/us-senate-republicans-vote-to-keep-john-thune-as-leader-after-steep-midterm-election-losses/article71688101.ece) reported that U.S. Senate Republicans voted to keep John Thune as leader after steep midterm election losses.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/10/us/politics/republican-house-leader-scalise-jordan.html) reported that House Republicans chose Jim Jordan as their leader and Senate Republicans re-elected John Thune following election losses.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/10/us/politics/bernie-sanders-chuck-schumer-senate.html) reported that Bernie Sanders opposed Chuck Schumer as majority leader, with Sanders stating that the time for change is now ([The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/10/bernie-sanders-chuck-schumer-senate-democrats)).

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/video/2026/nov/10/chuck-schumer-confident-on-senate-leadership-role-bernie-sanders-video) reported that New York senator Chuck Schumer expressed confidence in becoming the majority leader after Democrats gained at least 54 seats in the Senate.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/10/us/ballot-measures-democrats-republicans.html) reported that in some states that elected Democrats, voters also approved measures to restrict transgender athletes, require voter identification, and toughen prison sentences.

reports.text: [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/tens-of-thousands-attend-polish-nationalist-march-days-afer-shootings) reported that tens of thousands of Polish nationalist sympathisers gathered in Warsaw for an annual Independence Day March.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/feature/2026/11/10/what-we-know-about-michal-oksinski-the-gunman-behind-the-krakow-mass-shooting) reported details regarding 24-year-old Michał Oksiński, who shot and killed his parents and sister before opening fire in central Kraków.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/poland-shooting-artist-krakow-izabela-wozna-b3082508.html) reported that the suspect’s 21-year-old younger sister, a queer artist, was also killed in the Krakow shooting that left six dead.

[Rzeczpospolita](https://www.rp.pl/spoleczenstwo/art45472871-po-zamachu-w-krakowie-niemal-10-mln-zl-zebranych-dla-ofiar-i-policjantow) reported that over 7 million złoty has been raised for Artur Morański and Jakub Kulika, the police officers who immobilized the gunman in Krakow.

[Politika](https://www.politika.rs/scc/clanak/801608/zavrsena-obdukcija-napadaca-iz-krakova-utvrden-veci-broj-prostrelnih-rana) reported that autopsy results determined a large number of bullet wounds on the Krakow attacker.

[Rzeczpospolita](https://www.rp.pl/przestepczosc/art45472811-zamach-w-krakowie-specgrupa-wyjasni-ostrowiecki-watek-ataku) reported that a special group of officers will investigate the Ostrowiec Świętokrzyski thread of the Krakow attack and triple murder.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/poland-krakow-shooting-suspect-fascinated-by-norwegian-mass-murder-anders-breivik-says-justice-minister/a-79910435?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that the 24-year-old suspect read significant material about Breivik and other far-right figures according to the justice minister.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiigFBVV95cUxPT3F0cG9XZEVlN0pBaEFzQTlWdjFka082QUE5eDRWd0RUMEpvQURHTG4zNHVpb0haZ1E4OVFiQmFXaHE2djVpVHhCcHRzSXp4cWF4cmRDcnotMXRlZ3UwNXR4NHprdWZBMDZnMXBTWUFYRnE2QXAwTjJwQXh5eUR3eTlrR3ZsTVNJZ1E?oc=5) reported that the Polish gunman who killed six people in Krakow square died in a hospital.

[HuffPost World](https://www.huffpost.com/entry/krakow-poland-mass-shooting_n_6af16b78e4b043b6d4e34889) reported that the 24-year-old assailant who killed six and wounded 15 died in the hospital on Monday morning after being shot by police.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMioAFBVV95cUxNVmhPQUFLblhESV9CWnFmX2ZONzdHOTFMQkhHMW9hUzNoYlp6ZU5BUnE5b1pJZ05TbjFOODNDa2VKTW9UMzRETE5hdVBhSzVmLTJjalRFUjA2RERZdW5GS0lXOUdMM0RLRmIyWndqWUFrUjA3VFZISUMtTHdVMjQzYUJreWdKaGFnSV8xbkR5NWs4b2VBTE1BMVJlZlNvdGl3?oc=5), [Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/87335196) reported that U.S. envoy Jared Kushner stated that progress has been made toward signing a peace agreement in Ukraine, though difficult decisions lie ahead.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/16/8063172/) reported that U.S. envoy Jared Kushner stated preparations are underway for a multilateral meeting on the war in Ukraine and that he discussed next steps with Putin's aide Yuri Ushakov.
[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/16/8063176/) reported that Jared Kushner stated any final peace agreement must be agreed by both Russia and Ukraine.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/16/8063174/) reported that Dmitry Peskov backed Donald Trump's remarks about Russia's military actions in Ukraine and confirmed the main topics for an upcoming meeting.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/17/ukraine-holds-peace-talks-with-us-europe-as-conflict-escalates?traffic_source=rss) reported that Ukraine held peace talks with the US and Europe as the conflict escalates, with Kushner reporting progress towards a deal while Moscow stated it has not agreed to European participation in the next talks.

[The Moscow Times](https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/11/16/kremlin-aide-denies-russia-agreed-to-include-europe-in-ukraine-peace-talks-a94279), [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/16/kremlin-says-the-next-u-s-russia-ukraine-peace-talks-will-be-trilateral-without-europe), [RT](https://rt-english.com/russia/648921-putin-aide-reveals-moscow-stance-europe-talks/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS) reported that Kremlin aide Yury Ushakov stated Moscow has not agreed to include a European delegation in upcoming Ukraine peace talks.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/16/8063169/) reported that Kremlin aide Yuri Ushakov stated Russia was not consulted on Europe's involvement in peace talks and wants Europe to present constructive proposals.

[Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/europe/us-ukraine-europeans-discuss-how-to-draw-russia-into-peace-talks) reported that European officials joined talks with Ukrainian and U.S. negotiators to discuss ways to bring Russia into direct engagement on ending the war.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/russia-ukraine-kaja-kallas-brussels-europe-b3085569.html) reported that European Union countries accused Russia of delaying peace talks in Ukraine while continuing attacks on civilian infrastructure.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/15/8063001/), [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4185002-europe-to-engage-in-ukraine-peace-talks-and-ensure-maximum-pressure-on-russia-von-der-leyen.html) reported that European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen stated Europe will participate in negotiations to end the war through the E5 + EU format while maintaining pressure on Russia.
[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/86782146) reported that Moldova news noted Russia laid out conditions for signing a peace agreement in Ukraine.

[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/86745418) reported that European leaders meeting in Dublin agreed that Germany, France, Italy, Poland, the United Kingdom, and EU institutions would represent them in Ukraine peace talks.

[RT](https://rt-english.com/russia/648894-us-europe-worlds-apart-ukraine-diplomacy/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS), a Russian state outlet, reported that Foreign Minister Lavrov stated the US and Europe are worlds apart on Ukraine peace talks and that European leaders dismiss Russia's security concerns.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/15/8062909/), [Aravot](https://en.aravot.am/2026/11/15/382477/) reported that French President Emmanuel Macron stated that limiting aid and forcing Ukraine into an unjust peace would make Europe vulnerable and described the Ukrainian army as Europe's army.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/europe-will-closely-engage-in-peace-negotiations-between-russia-ukraine-von-der-leyen-says/) reported that European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen stated that Europe will closely engage in peace negotiations between Russia and Ukraine following an agreement by European leaders.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90150) reported that US special envoy Jared Kushner announced that Washington is working to establish direct engagement between Moscow and European partners.

[TASS](https://tass.com/russias-foreign-policy/2218309) reported that Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov stated that European nations want to join Ukraine talks at the last minute and do not know what role they could play.
[TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2218239) reported that the Kremlin stated European negotiators have not yet contacted Russia regarding peace talks.

[CGTN](https://news.cgtn.com/news/2026-11-14/EU-institutions-E5-to-represent-Europe-in-Ukraine-peace-talks-1S3x46aI1Ko/p.html?UTM_Source=cgtn&UTM_Medium=rss&UTM_Campaign=World) reported that EU leaders agreed Europe's team for Ukraine peace talks will comprise EU institutions and five major military powers consisting of Britain, France, Germany, Italy, and E5.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/14/us-envoy-kushner-says-he-aims-to-broker-europe-russia-talks-on-ukraine?traffic_source=rss), [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/jared-kushner-says-us-preparing-next-round-of-russia-ukraine-peace-talks-with-european-partners-directly-involved-101794696615177.html) reported that US envoy Jared Kushner stated he aims to broker Europe-Russia talks on Ukraine with European partners directly involved.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/us-now-focused-on-facilitating-direct-engagement-between-russia-europe-kushner-says-after-ukraine-peace-talks/) reported that U.S. envoy Jared Kushner stated the current focus is on facilitating direct engagement between Moscow and European partners and preparing the agenda for trilateral talks.
[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2218233), a Russian state outlet, reported that U.S. President Donald Trump emphasized the need for actionable conflict prevention mechanisms.
[TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2218187) reported that Kremlin spokesperson Dmitry Peskov stated Russia is unwilling to set conditions on the European negotiating team regarding talks on Ukraine.

[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90111) reported that Latvian Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs warned during the Dublin summit that Russian President Vladimir Putin is using peace negotiations as a tactical maneuver to distract Europe from aid.

[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90109) reported that U.S. Special Envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner agreed to a Kremlin demand, giving Russian President Vladimir Putin room to stall peace negotiations over Ukraine.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/14/europe-taps-national-security-advisers-to-represent-the-continent-in-russia-ukraine-peace-talks) reported that national security advisers from the European Union, Germany, France, the United Kingdom, Italy, and Poland will represent Europe in upcoming talks on ending the war.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90104) reported that Poland was among the E5 countries selected to represent Europe at upcoming Ukraine peace negotiations.

[Pakistan Today](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMizgFBVV95cUxOZTRoMkNpSGIzbDhlUVh4c2FJWmU3eFNDbm56NndMNjl0MjN5WjQxbklnZ001cTVSdnR5LW40YXZCNHV1NV91SEF1am9KTnplZVNscHJ2MVUyQ3RJQ1ZGd21hWUVaUHBuNkVUZGhRNlB1VFhUeW5KR091TTRLeFhEcFBkVjNSNTNURXZMd2t5UHVxMXRFdXJHZHZKMHdxNThfZmZFUEhqLUdyejFKdy1MWXVOTDU4WkdDNTlIUUJDVTVLblptdmZ2eTVCNGFNUQ?oc=5), [teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/russia-may-open-door-to-european-role-in-ukraine-peace-talks/) reported that EU leaders rejected a Russian push to include European security in Ukraine peace talks, while Russia signaled openness to European participation if Kyiv agrees to Kremlin demands.

[Politico](https://www.politico.eu/article/sviatlana-tsikhanouskaya-urges-europe-include-belarus-ukraine-peace-negotiations/?utm_source=RSS_Feed&utm_medium=RSS&utm_campaign=RSS_Syndication) reported that Belarusian dissident leader Sviatlana Tsikhanouskaya wants Europe to consider Belarus in a broader Ukraine peace deal.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/ckn80j9jv3jxo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky welcomed the US bringing Europe into Russia-Ukraine peace talks.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/13/ukraine-war-briefing-europe-to-join-negotiations-says-kushner-as-putin-warns-against-peace-keepers) reported that Jared Kushner said the move will allow talks to address broader postwar European security arrangements.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqwFBVV95cUxOLXVZUW9PS0M3SlFocHN4c3ZfZE5aZmwzamtmX3lkRHYtMm14N2EzVFV1M3ZzQ0tsbjNiMWVOMlBtRkdrLVp1cGhubG1yc283Y1RRMnk3SkRtXzVhQkItYlVJME9vX2stYUxNOEJTU2puX19kUHM4NnpZdVN4QUdTN2FNMGw5Sk9xeEtuV1hUT2pyYjBIRnQ0dDF1Um1lVFlMSEJzS1JmNUpYQjA?oc=5), [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/ukraine-fires-nearly-1200-drones-at-russia-as-us-led-talks-consider-wider-european-security/article71699290.ece), [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/ukraine-launches-nearly-1-200-drones-at-russia-as-us-led-talks-will-consider-wider-european-security-101794595053247.html) reported that Ukraine launched nearly 1,200 drones at Russia while US-led talks considered wider European security.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/13/russia-strikes-hospital-central-kyiv-spacex-starshield-system-fails) reported that Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated speed restrictions on the Starshield system hindered Ukraine's ability to shoot down drones.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261113-russian-airstrikes-continue-ukraine-launches-nearly-1-200-drones) reported that Russian strikes hit targets across Ukraine, damaging a hospital, while Ukraine fired nearly 1,200 drones at Russian targets.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90082) reported that national security advisers from the EU and the E5 format will represent Europe in upcoming Russia-Ukraine peace talks.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20261113-europe-to-send-diplomats-from-across-the-continent-to-ukraine-peace-talks) reported that European Council President Antonio Costa stated that Brussels will send diplomats from the bloc and five countries, including the UK, France, Germany, Italy, and Poland.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/13/8062792/) reported that Politico stated EU leaders are close to agreeing on a negotiating team involving Germany, France, the UK, Italy, Poland, and EU institutions for talks on Ukraine.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/13/8062795/) reported that EU leaders agreed that Germany, France, the UK, Italy, Poland and EU institutions will represent Europe in negotiations.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/13/eu-leaders-bring-italy-and-poland-into-ukraine-peace-talks-team-as-kallas-fights-for-spot) reported that Europe decided on a joint team for the peace talks led by France, Germany, the UK, Italy, Poland, EU institutions, and NATO.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/politique/article/2026/11/17/impots-logement-smic-ce-qu-il-faut-retenir-du-debat-entre-candidats-a-la-presidentielle_6812895_823448.html) reported that presidential candidates Gabriel Attal, Raphaël Glucksmann, Marine Le Pen, Jean-Luc Mélenchon, and Bruno Retailleau debated taxes, salaries, housing, and pensions.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/elections/presidentielles/presidentielle-2027-impots-logement-associations-ce-qu-il-faut-retenir-du-grand-debat-entre-cinq-candidats-sur-la-vie-chere-20261116) reported that presidential candidates Jean-Luc Melenchon, Raphael Glucksmann, Gabriel Attal, Bruno Retailleau, and Marine Le Pen debated taxes, housing, and the cost of living on LCI and TF1.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/elections/presidentielles/programmes/presidentielle-2027-marine-le-pen-veut-supprimer-parcoursup-le-controle-continu-et-avancer-le-bac-en-mai-20261116) reported that National Rally candidate Marine Le Pen detailed proposals regarding high school and the baccalaureate, including abolishing Parcoursup.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/election-presidentielle-2027/live/2026/11/16/en-direct-debat-de-la-presidentielle-2027-les-cinq-candidats-s-affrontent-sur-les-retraites-marine-le-pen-cible-la-ligue-des-droits-de-l-homme-un-ramassis-de-gauchistes_6811633_6205049.html) reported that five presidential candidates debated on pensions while Marine Le Pen targeted the Human Rights League.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/election-presidentielle-2027/live/2026/11/16/en-direct-presidentielle-2027-pouvoir-d-achat-posez-vos-questions-a-l-economiste-mathieu-plane_6811633_6205049.html) reported that economist Mathieu Plane answered questions on inflation and purchasing power regarding the 2027 presidential election.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/election-presidentielle-2027/live/2026/11/16/en-direct-presidentielle-2027-suivez-dans-notre-live-le-debat-entre-gabriel-attal-raphael-glucksmann-marine-le-pen-jean-luc-melenchon-et-bruno-retailleau-sur-la-vie-chere_6811633_6205049.html) reported that Le Monde hosted a debate on purchasing power and precarity featuring Gabriel Attal, Raphaël Glucksmann, Marine Le Pen, Jean-Luc Mélenchon, and Bruno Retailleau.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/elections/presidentielles/en-direct-presidentielle-2027-marine-le-pen-edouard-philippe-emmanuel-macron-ukraine-teddy-riner-20261116) reported that Marine Le Pen remains far ahead in voting intentions for the first round of the presidential election, ahead of Jean-Luc Mélenchon.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/elections/presidentielles/presidentielle-juppe-2016-la-hantise-derriere-le-refus-d-edouard-philippe-de-participer-a-la-primaire-20261115) reported that Horizons candidate Edouard Philippe rejected primaries ten years after the surprise failure of his mentor.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/elections/presidentielles/programmes/presidentielle-2027-edouard-philippe-promet-de-construire-4-millions-de-logements-en-dix-ans-pour-faire-baisser-les-prix-20261115) reported that Edouard Philippe promised to build 4 million homes over ten years to lower real estate prices.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/politique/article/2026/11/15/presidentielle-2027-edouard-philippe-tente-de-deployer-son-contre-agenda-face-aux-vents-contraires_6810973_823448.html) reported that Edouard Philippe refuses to participate in a primary election and has launched a new campaign counter-agenda.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/elections/presidentielles/candidats/debat-primaire-irruption-de-teddy-riner-et-david-lisnard-la-campagne-en-defense-d-edouard-philippe-20261115) reported that Horizons candidate Édouard Philippe is being outpaced in the polls by Jean-Luc Mélenchon and challenged by David Lisnard.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/election-presidentielle-2027/article/2026/11/15/presidentielle-2027-teddy-riner-decouvre-le-combat-politique-entre-popularite-et-agacement_6810907_6205049.html) reported that judoka Teddy Riner spent his Saturday afternoon at the Made in France trade fair as his presidential campaign experienced early turbulence.
[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c6dj1e8wyykmo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that judo champion Teddy Riner announced a surprise candidacy in the French presidential race.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/elections/presidentielles/sondages/presidentielle-2027-jean-luc-melenchon-s-installe-a-la-deuxieme-place-teddy-riner-devance-gabriel-attal-dans-un-scenario-selon-un-sondage-20261114) reported that an Elabe poll shows Jean-Luc Mélenchon in second place and Teddy Riner ahead of Gabriel Attal in a scenario, while Marine Le Pen maintains a wide lead in first-round voting intentions.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/elections/presidentielles/je-suis-un-pur-produit-francais-le-candidat-teddy-riner-s-offre-un-premier-bain-de-foule-au-salon-du-made-in-france-a-paris-20261114) reported that presidential candidate Teddy Riner undertook his second campaign event by spending over three hours walking the aisles of the Made in France trade fair in Paris.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/france/20261114-judo-star-and-presidential-hopeful-riner-calls-macron) reported that French judo champion Teddy Riner publicly distanced himself from President Emmanuel Macron, calling his endorsement a poisoned chalice.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/politique/article/2026/11/14/presidentielle-2027-je-ne-suis-pas-un-macroniste-rejette-teddy-riner-qui-qualifie-les-felicitations-d-emmanuel-macron-de-baiser-empoisonne_6810346_823448.html), [Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/politique/je-ne-suis-pas-un-macroniste-teddy-riner-qualifie-les-felicitations-de-macron-a-sa-candidature-de-baiser-empoisonne-20261114) reported that Teddy Riner rejected being labeled a macronist and called Emmanuel Macron's congratulations a poisoned kiss.

[Le Figaro](https://tvmag.lefigaro.fr/programme-tv/actu-tele/c-est-un-milieu-qui-fait-peur-malik-bentalha-reagit-a-la-candidature-de-teddy-riner-a-la-presidentielle-20261114) reported that comedian Malik Bentalha reacted on television to Teddy Riner's presidential candidacy.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/elections/presidentielles/la-gloire-ne-fait-pas-l-election-coluche-bigard-hulot-avant-teddy-riner-le-difficile-passage-de-la-celebrite-a-la-course-a-l-elysee-20261114) reported that judo champion Teddy Riner's presidential ambitions draw comparisons to previous celebrity political entries in France.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/politique/a-peine-arrive-l-ex-ministre-de-la-sante-francois-braun-quitte-la-campagne-de-teddy-riner-20261114) reported that former health minister François Braun left the presidential campaign team of Teddy Riner six days after its launch.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/elections/presidentielles/candidats/presidentielle-2027-david-lisnard-donne-a-au-moins-10-juste-derriere-edouard-philippe-et-raphael-glucksmann-selon-un-sondage-20261113) reported that a poll showed Cannes mayor David Lisnard receiving between 10% and 12% of voting intentions for the 2027 presidential election.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/politique/article/2026/11/13/presidentielle-2027-bruno-retailleau-devoile-son-programme-toujours-plus-dur-pour-lutter-contre-l-immigration_6809292_823448.html) reported that 2027 presidential candidate Bruno Retailleau published a policy booklet attacking birthright citizenship to harden his immigration program.

[Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/13/teddy-riner-announces-presidential-bid-pledges-to-unite-france/) reported that Teddy Riner announced his presidential bid in an interview with Le Parisien, pledging to unite France and stating he could not remain silent amid social tensions.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/elections/presidentielles/en-direct-presidentielle-2027-teddy-riner-david-lisnard-edouard-philippe-sondage-campagne-20261113) reported that Teddy Riner will make his first campaign trip on Saturday to the Made in France exhibition.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/elections/presidentielles/presidentielle-2027-avec-riner-la-droite-a-trouve-un-candidat-qui-a-de-l-allure-lance-jean-luc-melenchon-20261111) reported that Jean-Luc Melenchon commented on Teddy Riner as a candidate for the 2027 presidential election.

[Rzeczpospolita](https://www.rp.pl/polityka/art45474021-judoka-chce-zjednoczyc-francje-jest-nowy-kandydat-na-prezydenta) reported that Olympic judo champion Teddy Riner intends to run in next year's presidential election in France.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/elections/presidentielles/22-des-electeurs-seraient-prets-a-voter-pour-teddy-riner-en-2027-selon-un-sondage-ifop-20261110) reported that an Ifop poll found 22 percent of voters would be ready to vote for Teddy Riner.

[RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/20261109-olympic-judo-champion-teddy-riner-joins-race-for-french-presidency) reported that five-time Olympic judo champion Teddy Riner announced he would run in next year's presidential election.

reports.text: [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-election-2026/article-915097) reported that an Eisenkot-led bloc is weighing a unity government and coalition talks with haredi parties following the October election, while Golan and Liberman warned against a Netanyahu-led unity government.

[Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-politics/2026-11-16/ty-article/.premium/this-likud-mks-protest-tent-is-well-intentioned-but-it-serves-netanyahu/000001a1-e38c-db97-a1e1-e39ebbf50000) reported that Likud and Smotrich representatives appeared at a protest tent calling for unity.

[Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-politics/2026-11-15/ty-article/.premium/whats-behind-netanyahus-frantic-push-for-a-unity-government/000001a1-e027-d59b-a1f3-f8b72d260000) reported that Benjamin Netanyahu is urging Gadi Eisenkot to share power after losing his majority.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/15/can-netanyahu-and-eisenkot-form-a-unity-government-in-israel?traffic_source=rss) reported that Yashar and Likud are scheduled to hold talks on Sunday.

[Jowhar](https://jowhar.com/netanyahu-again-urges-rival-to-join-him-in-forming-unity-government/) reported that Israeli caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu urged rival Gadi Eisenkot to join him in forming a unity government.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/eisenkot-rejects-netanyahus-unity-government-call-as-media-stunt-3725584) reported that Gadi Eisenkot described the call as a media stunt and noted that negotiating teams from his Yashar party and Likud are due to meet.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/11/15/iran-war-live-israel-vows-gaza-offensive-policy-despite-caretaker-status?traffic_source=rss) reported that Israel has pledged to continue its offensive policy on Gaza.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/middle-east/20261114-netanyahu-renews-call-for-israeli-government-unity-as-eisenkot-dismisses-tricks), [Arab News](https://www.arabnews.com/middle-east/netanyahu-calls-for-israeli-unity-government-eisenkot-dismisses-tricks-3011919), [RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/world/2026/1114/1599234-netanyahu-renews-call-unity-government/) reported that Israeli caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu renewed his call for a national unity government with Gadi Eisenkot, who dismissed the appeal as tricks.
[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-election-2026/article-914874) reported that Netanyahu invoked the Hatikvah walkout and warned of Iran's nuclear threat.

[The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/netanyahu-pushes-trump-iran-strikes-amid-mossad-us-visit) reported that Benjamin Netanyahu is pressing Donald Trump to renew attacks on Iran while Mossad chief Roman Gofman visits Washington.

[Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-politics/2026-11-14/ty-article/.premium/after-briefing-eisenkot-netanyahu-urges-unity-government-without-preconditions/000001a1-db08-ddc9-abb7-dfca699e0000) reported that Benjamin Netanyahu invoked the threat from Iran and the need for national reconciliation in his appeal to Eisenkot.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-election-2026/article-914878) reported that Eisenkot accused Netanyahu of political spin over his unity government appeal and demanded a break with extremists.

[Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-politics/2026-11-14/ty-article/.premium/eisenkot-calls-netanyahus-unity-plea-a-bluff/000001a1-db48-d59b-a1f3-dbdcd9bd0000) reported that Eisenkot called Netanyahu's unity plea a bluff and urged backing for Yashar's Knesset speaker pick.

[Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-politics/2026-11-13/ty-article/.premium/eisenkot-bloc-moves-to-undo-netanyahus-judicial-coup-through-knesset-committees/000001a1-d12f-da30-a7fb-d9bf1ba40000) reported that the Eisenkot bloc seeks to control key Knesset committees to undo Netanyahu's judicial coup.

[Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-politics/2026-11-12/ty-article/.premium/eisenkot-controls-the-knesset-netanyahu-is-still-pm-what-each-bloc-is-planning/000001a1-ce67-dfd7-a7a3-ce7757c70000) reported on what Eisenkot's bloc and Netanyahu's bloc are planning to do regarding the Knesset and government formation.

[Sada El Balad](https://www.elbalad.news/7177688) reported that Israeli Defense Minister Israel Katz responded to Eisenkot by stating that Tel Aviv does not need the opposition's approval to continue operations in Gaza, Lebanon, Syria, and the West Bank.

[Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190016/%D8%B4%D8%AF%D9%8A%D8%AF-%D9%8A%D8%AD%D8%B0%D8%B1-%D9%85%D9%86-%D8%AA%D8%B3%D8%A7%D8%B1%D8%B9-%D9%85%D8%B5%D8%A7%D8%AF%D8%B1%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%B6%D9%8A-%D9%88%D8%AA%D9%88%D8%B3%D9%8A%D8%B9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%B3%D8%AA%D9%8A%D8%B7%D8%A7%D9%86-%D8%A8%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B6%D9%81%D8%A9) reported that Hamas leader Abdul Rahman Shadid warned against the acceleration of land expropriation and settlement expansion in the West Bank.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimwFBVV95cUxOR2xtdC1iNFRNSEZwNjVlM1hTeFVjREM0MlU4ZFlaWkVBYnQyNmxEdnZKeXRLQXBmbVVOeHI1U1l0TFN2cG1tQS02TFV0OElNUzhqZ1dRbUVfS3BtTVphOVFud1R6N1hZdGlpVl9GVE45dk93akNtcGRhUFB6cmpOd0FZbC1GOXBFendqUmtmalYwcUJybFo2WWRtOA?oc=5) reported that Israel's president gave Eisenkot the first chance to form the next government.

[Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/11/israel-swears-in-new-parliament-as-netanyahu-remains-caretaker-pm/) reported that Gadi Eisenkot, tasked with forming a new Israeli government, pledged to reverse many of Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's policies.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/crime-in-israel/article-914571) reported that Amit Hadad, Netanyahu’s lawyer, stated that the judges could summon Baharav-Miara regardless of her position and that the door remains open to talks.

[Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261111-netanyahu-rejects-palestinian-state-warns-of-iran-threat-and-calls-for-unity-government/) reported that outgoing Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu warned of potential international pressure on Israel to withdraw from territories it controls in Gaza.

[Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-politics/2026-11-11/ty-article/.premium/eisenkot-bloc-leaders-were-unaware-of-yashars-planned-talks-with-likud/000001a1-ca01-d1f4-a7f9-cac3d5240000) reported that Lieberman, Bennett and Golan learned of the planned Yashar-Likud talks only after they were canceled following Netanyahu's speech attacking Arab parties.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/11/netanyahu-heckled-by-bennett-at-knesset-opening-session?traffic_source=rss) reported that Benjamin Netanyahu was heckled by Naftali Bennett at the Knesset opening session.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/middle-east/20261110-eisenkot-pushes-october-7-inquiry-as-netanyahu-targets-arab-parties-in-tense-new-parliament) reported that Gadi Eisenkot pledged to launch an official inquiry into Hamas's October 7, 2023 attack.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/israel-politics-sara-netanyahu-heated-shouting-match-with-naftali-bennett-during-benjamin-netanyahus-knesset-address-101794372417173.html) reported that Naftali Bennett and Sara Netanyahu got into a heated exchange after the former questioned caretaker PM Benjamin Netanyahu about his Qatari advisers.

[Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/middle-east/unfit-to-remain-in-office-eisenkot-attacks-netanyahu-after-hateful-knesset-speech/articleshow/135722286.cms) reported that Gadi Eisenkot's Yashar party cancelled a meeting with Netanyahu's Likud party after a hateful Knesset speech.

[Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/mid-east/eisenkot-vows-to-undo-netanyahu-policies-as-israeli-parliament-opens) reported that Israeli Prime Minister-designate Gadi Eisenkot pledged to dismantle key policies of outgoing Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu as the newly opened parliament began.

[RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/en/international/20261108-ex-army-chief-eisenkot-given-first-chance-to-form-government-in-israel) reported that former army chief Gadi Eisenkot was given the first chance to form Israel's next government after elections left neither main political bloc with a majority.

[HuffPost World](https://www.huffpost.com/entry/israel-election-eisenkot-netanyahu_n_6aeff8afe4b0d2d11fa40151) reported that Israeli President Isaac Herzog tapped opposition candidate Gadi Eisenkot to form a governing coalition in a setback for Netanyahu.

[Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/189964/%D9%85%D8%B9%D8%B3%D9%83%D8%B1-%D8%A2%D9%8A%D8%B2%D9%86%D9%83%D9%88%D8%AA-%D9%8A%D8%B7%D8%B1%D8%AD-%D9%82%D9%88%D8%A7%D9%86%D9%8A%D9%86-%D9%84%D9%84%D8%AA%D8%AD%D9%82%D9%8A%D9%82-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%A5%D8%AE%D9%81%D8%A7%D9%82%D8%A7%D8%AA-7-%D8%A3%D9%83%D8%AA%D9%88%D8%A8%D8%B1) reported that Gadi Eisenkot's 'Yashar' party submitted bills to the Knesset, led by establishing an official commission of inquiry into October 7 failures.

[Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/elections/2026-11-10/ty-article/.premium/israels-new-knesset-sworn-in-as-eisenkot-seeks-to-form-government/000001a1-c600-d0f7-adfb-f721e5770000) reported that Israel's new Knesset was sworn in as Gadi Eisenkot seeks to form a government, while President Herzog urged lawmakers to compromise.

[The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/who-matan-kahana-israels-proposed-new-knesset-speaker) reported that anti-Netanyahu bloc leaders agreed to nominate Matan Kahana as the new Knesset speaker.

[Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-politics/2026-11-10/ty-article/.premium/arab-party-to-back-eisenkot-blocs-bid-to-replace-knesset-speaker/000001a1-c553-dba2-a9f9-d57fa5ce0000) reported that Arab-led Joint List lawmaker Ahmad Tibi said his party would back the Eisenkot bloc's Knesset speaker nominee.

[New York Times World](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/10/world/middleeast/israel-parliament-eisenkot.html) reported that dozens of first-time lawmakers headed to the Knesset, where the opposition led by Gadi Eisenkot has a majority.

[BBC World](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/crd939lpzjp9o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that Benjamin Netanyahu's main political rival, Gadi Eisenkot, had the first chance to build a new government and oust the prime minister.

[The Guardian World](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/08/gadi-eisenkot-netanyahu-allies-form-israel-government) reported that former military chief Gadi Eisenkot reached out to Netanyahu allies as he strived to form a government.

[The Guardian World](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/07/israel-president-gadi-eisenkot-form-government) reported that Israel's president chose Yashar leader Gadi Eisenkot to form a government after the Knesset had been deadlocked.

[Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2043517/new-israel-parliament-to-be-sworn-in-as-gadi-eisenkot-seeks-government) reported that Israel's new parliament was sworn in as Gadi Eisenkot works to form a government while Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu loses his majority.

According to [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261109-former-israeli-prime-minister-barak-urges-eisenkot-to-accelerate-government-formation/), former Israeli Prime Minister Ehud Barak urged Gadi Eisenkot to accelerate efforts to form a new government.

The Jerusalem Post reported that Israeli President Isaac Herzog warned against the continuation of certain policies during a ceremony to officially task Gadi Eisenkot with forming a new government ([Naharnet](https://www.naharnet.com/stories/en/323654-herzog-tells-eisenkot-to-continue-negotiations-with-lebanon)).

reports.text: [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/israeli-army-critically-wounds-palestinian-blows-up-homes-in-central-gaza-3725688) reported that the Israeli army critically wounded a Palestinian in a drone strike and blew up homes in central Gaza.

[Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190356/%D9%85%D9%85%D8%AB%D9%84-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%AA%D8%AD%D8%A7%D8%AF-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D9%88%D8%B1%D9%88%D8%A8%D9%8A-%D9%8A%D8%AF%D8%B9%D9%88-%D8%A5%D9%84%D9%89-%D9%88%D9%82%D9%81-%D8%AC%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%A6%D9%85-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%B3%D8%AA%D9%88%D8%B7%D9%86%D9%8A%D9%86), [Sada El Balad](https://www.elbalad.news/7183413) reported that EU representative in the West Bank and Gaza Strip, Ambassador Andreas Fiedler, called for an end to settler violence.

[IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86323041/Iran-condemns-Israeli-attack-on-Naser-Hospital-in-Gaza), a state-media outlet, reported that Iran's High Council for Human Rights condemned an Israeli attack on Naser Hospital in Gaza.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/israeli-attacks-kill-3-palestinians-across-gaza-medical-sources-say-3725610) reported that medical sources stated Israeli attacks killed three Palestinians across Gaza, including two in a drone strike near Rafah.

[Tehran Times](https://www.tehrantimes.com/news/532190/IHR-Council-condemns-continued-Israeli-attacks-on-Gaza), a state-run outlet, reported that Iran's High Council for Human Rights condemned Israeli attacks and violations in the Gaza Strip.

[The Rio Times](https://www.riotimesonline.com/nyala-commander-dies-of-drone-strike-wounds/) reported that the chief of staff of an armed group aligned with Sudan's RSF died of wounds from an October 19 drone strike on his Nyala home.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/israeli-drone-strike-kills-palestinian-wounds-2-in-southern-gaza-3725587) reported that an Israeli drone strike killed one Palestinian and wounded two others in the Al-Mawasi area of Khan Younis.

[Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190217/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%AA%D8%AD%D8%A7%D8%AF-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D9%88%D8%B1%D9%88%D8%A8%D9%8A-%D9%8A%D8%AF%D8%B9%D9%88-%D8%A5%D8%B3%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%A6%D9%8A%D9%84-%D8%A5%D9%84%D9%89-%D8%AA%D9%85%D9%83%D9%8A%D9%86-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D9%85%D9%85-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%AA%D8%AD%D8%AF%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D9%85%D9%84-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%BA%D8%B2) reported that the European Union urged Israel to respect international humanitarian law and expedite humanitarian access to the Gaza Strip.
[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/article-914881) reported that the IDF and Shin Bet stated the strike targeted Hamas's Khan Yunis Brigade commander Muhammad Abu Isma.

[Arab News](https://www.arabnews.com/saudi-arabia/saudi-arabia-and-17-other-nations-jointly-condemn-israels-bombing-of-gaza-hospital-3011864), [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1581496/pakistan-16-nations-condemn-israeli-gaza-hospital-strike/) reported that Saudi Arabia, Pakistan, and other nations jointly condemned an Israeli strike on a Gaza hospital.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiowFBVV95cUxNLVJHTEpnR0lwRmdFbHVCNEQ5YWRiTXcyRy1HcTczUHVMaDdyUjBIWlVpOW9xTnBFUGZnVXhMSk53WXFuLWtoeEp0RTkwVVZjbDBvd2E3bVplY2tPZnJaY2xhNzFta1kxUEZtMFhTYzZvYWlCeGs1X0ZVT2xvMHJDbEphYjJoQVlvZkJQdlN6VXBwZG9kQnpPMHNWYlA5aDF4Z3BF?oc=5), [Arab News](https://www.arabnews.com/middle-east/israeli-drone-strike-kills-2-palestinians-in-gaza-3011887) reported that an Israeli drone strike killed two Palestinians in the Gaza Strip.

[Hasht-e Subh](https://8am.media/eng/turkey-and-17-other-countries-condemn-israeli-attack-on-nasser-medical-complex-in-gaza/) reported that Turkey and 17 other countries condemned an Israeli airstrike on the Nasser Medical Complex in Khan Younis.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2640299/pakistan-16-other-countries-slam-israeli-airstrike), [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261114-18-countries-condemn-israeli-strike-on-gaza-hospital-urge-ceasefire-compliance/) reported that foreign ministers from 18 Arab and Islamic nations condemned the Israeli airstrike on the Nasser Medical Complex in Khan Younis.

[Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2044496/pakistan-16-other-countries-condemn-israeli-strike-on-southern-gaza-hospital) reported that Pakistan and 16 other countries condemned the Israeli airstrike on Nasser Hospital.

[The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/uae/2026/11/14/uae-condemns-israeli-air-strikes-on-nasser-medical-complex-in-gaza/) reported that the UAE condemned the Israeli air strikes on the Nasser Medical Complex.

[Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261113-un-warns-israeli-attacks-have-pushed-gazas-health-system-to-brink-of-collapse/) reported that the UN warned that years of Israeli attacks have pushed Gaza's health system to the brink of collapse.

[teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/793-attacks-gaza-hospitals-kill-1725/) reported that Israel has carried out 793 attacks on Gaza's health services since October 2023, killing more than 1,700 health workers.

[Jowhar](https://jowhar.com/who-warns-gaza-flooding-could-trigger-surge-in-respiratory-illnesses/) reported that floodwaters sweeping through Gaza tent camps after heavy rains are setting the stage for a sharper spike in respiratory illness.

[Tehran Times](https://www.tehrantimes.com/news/532097/Six-including-a-surgeon-killed-in-Israeli-strike-on-Nasser), a state-media outlet, reported that an Israeli airstrike on Gaza's Nasser Hospital killed six people and injured 27 others.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/respiratory-illnesses-rise-gaza-worst-come-winter-floods-arrive-who-says), [RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/middle-east/2026/1113/1599114-israel-gaza/), [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1581076/who-warns-respiratory-infections-surge-in-gaza-as-winter-approaches/) reported that the World Health Organization warned of surging respiratory illnesses in Gaza as winter floods arrive.
[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2217837) reported that the Board of Peace urged immediate action on Donald Trump's Gaza plan following a hospital strike.

[Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261113-israeli-strike-on-vehicle-outside-wedding-hall-kills-one-palestinian-in-central-gaza/) reported that an Israeli strike on a vehicle outside a wedding hall killed one person in Deir al-Balah.

[Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/mid-east/53-nations-demand-urgent-aid-access-as-gaza-baby-freezes-to-death) reported that 53 countries and organizations urged Israel to allow unrestricted humanitarian aid into the Gaza Strip as a nine-month-old baby froze to death.
[La Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/2026/11/13/mundo/028n1mun?partner=rss) reported that the Israeli army attacked Nasser hospital for the seventh time, killing at least seven Palestinians.

[Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261113-hamas-says-board-of-peace-adopts-misleading-israeli-narrative-on-gaza-hospitals/) reported that Hamas strongly rejected the Board of Peace's adoption of what it called a misleading Israeli narrative regarding the use of Gaza hospitals for military command.

[Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/202897/%D9%85%D8%AC%D9%84%D8%B3-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B3%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%85-%D9%8A%D8%AF%D8%B9%D9%88-%D9%84%D8%AA%D9%86%D9%81%D9%8A%D8%B0-%D8%AE%D8%B7%D8%A9-%D8%AA%D8%B1%D9%85%D8%A8-%D8%A8%D8%B9%D8%AF-%D8%B6%D8%B1%D8%A8-%D8%A5%D8%B3%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%A6%D9%8A%D9%84-%D9%85%D8%B3%D8%AA%D8%B4%D9%81%D9%89-%D9%86%D8%A7%D8%B5%D8%B1/) reported that the Peace Council in Gaza stated that the human casualties from the Israeli strike on Nasser hospital in Khan Younis confirm the need to implement Trump's peace plan immediately.

[Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190048/11-%D8%B4%D9%87%D9%8A%D8%AF%D8%A7-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%BA%D8%B2%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%AD%D8%AA%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%84-%D9%8A%D9%82%D8%B5%D9%81-%D9%85%D8%AC%D9%85%D8%B9-%D9%86%D8%A7%D8%B5%D8%B1-%D9%88%D9%8A%D9%88%D8%A7%D8%B5%D9%84-%D8%A7%D8%B3%D8%AA%D9%87%D8%AF%D8%A7%D9%81-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%AF%D9%86%D9%8A%D9%8A%D9%86) reported that 10 citizens were martyred in Israeli attacks on the Gaza Strip, including six who died in a strike targeting Nasser Complex.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/israel-strikes-gaza-hospital-says-hamas-senior-figure-inside/a-79927645?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that Israel stated Hamas was using the hospital as a military command center.

[Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190087/%D9%85%D8%B1%D9%83%D8%B2-%D8%AD%D9%82%D9%88%D9%82%D9%8A-%D8%A7%D8%B3%D8%AA%D9%87%D8%AF%D8%A7%D9%81-%D9%85%D8%AC%D9%85%D8%B9-%D9%86%D8%A7%D8%B5%D8%B1-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B7%D8%A8%D9%8A-%D8%AC%D8%B1%D9%8A%D9%85%D8%A9-%D8%AD%D8%B1%D8%A8-%D8%AA%D8%B3%D8%AA%D9%88%D8%AC%D8%A8-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%B3%D8%A7%D8%A1%D9%84%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AF%D9%88) reported that the 'Himaya' human rights center condemned the targeting of the surgical department at Nasser Medical Complex as a war crime.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/12/israeli-airstrike-nasser-hospital-gaza-kills-surgeon) reported that an Israeli airstrike on Nasser hospital in Gaza killed a surgeon and five others, including patients awaiting surgery.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/israel-targets-senior-hamas-member-in-gaza-hospital-strike/a-79927645?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf), [La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/internacional/israel-afirma-que-objetivo-bombardeo-hospital-era-comandante-hamas_202611126af597d74196933d7eda7a4c.html) reported that Israel stated the target of its strike on a hospital was a Hamas commander named Muhamad abu Ismail.

[Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190073/%D9%86%D8%B9%D9%8A%D9%85-%D9%85%D8%AC%D9%84%D8%B3-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B3%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%85-%D8%B4%D8%B1%D9%8A%D9%83-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%AC%D8%B1%D9%8A%D9%85%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D8%B3%D8%AA%D9%87%D8%AF%D8%A7%D9%81-%D9%85%D8%AC%D9%85%D8%B9-%D9%86%D8%A7%D8%B5%D8%B1) reported that Hamas political bureau member Basem Naim held Israel and the Peace Council responsible for targeting the Nasser Medical Complex.

[Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/mid-east/israeli-strike-on-gazas-nasser-hospital-kills-6-including-doctor) reported that an Israeli airstrike on southern Gaza's Nasser Hospital killed at least six people, including a surgeon, according to Palestinian health authorities.

[Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261112-6-palestinians-killed-dozens-injured-in-israeli-strike-on-nasser-medical-complex-in-khan-younis/) reported that six Palestinians were killed and dozens injured in an Israeli airstrike on a building inside the Nasser Medical Complex in western Khan Younis.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1580370/israeli-airstrike-kills-six-people-at-nasser-hospital-in-southern-gaza/) reported that an Israeli airstrike killed six people and wounded around 20 others at Nasser Hospital, according to Gaza's civil defence agency.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/11/world/middleeast/nasser-hospital-gaza-strike-israel.html) reported that an Israeli strike on Nasser Hospital in Khan Younis killed at least 6 people and injured 20.

[ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-12/deadly-israeli-air-strike-nasser-hospital-gaza/107379926) reported that Palestinian health authorities stated an Israeli air strike on Nasser Hospital killed at least six people and injured 20.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/ckzd9p7e4eqeo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that the Gaza civil defence agency stated an Israeli strike hit the surgery department of Nasser Hospital, injuring at least 20 people.

[Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190062/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AD%D9%83%D9%88%D9%85%D9%8A-%D8%A8%D8%BA%D8%B2%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%AD%D8%AA%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%84-%D8%A7%D8%B1%D8%AA%D9%83%D8%A8-793-%D9%87%D8%AC%D9%88%D9%85%D8%A7-%D8%B9%D9%84%D9%89-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%82%D8%B7%D8%A7%D8%B9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B5%D8%AD%D9%8A-%D9%88%D8%A7%D8%B3%D8%AA%D8%B4%D9%87%D8%AF-17) reported that Gaza's government media office stated Israel and the US bear full responsibility for attacks on medical facilities, including 793 attacks on the health sector.

[Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190058/%D9%81%D8%B5%D8%A7%D8%A6%D9%84-%D8%AA%D8%AF%D9%8A%D9%86-%D9%82%D8%B5%D9%81-%D9%85%D8%AC%D9%85%D8%B9-%D9%86%D8%A7%D8%B5%D8%B1-%D9%88%D8%AA%D8%AD%D9%85%D9%84-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%AD%D8%AA%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%84-%D9%88%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%88%D8%B3%D8%B7%D8%A7%D8%A1-%D9%85%D8%B3%D8%A4%D9%88%D9%84%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D8%B3%D8%AA%D9%85%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%B1-) reported that Palestinian factions condemned the Israeli bombing of the surgical building at Nasser Medical Complex in Khan Yunis.

reports.text: [IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86324612/Another-tanker-catches-fire-after-hitting-naval-mine-in-Strait) reported that the Iranian Navy stated another tanker caught fire and sustained severe damage after hitting a naval mine in a restricted area east of the Strait of Hormuz.

[IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86324571/Supertanker-LPG-carrier-hit-naval-mines-catch-fire-in-Strait) reported that the Islamic Revolution Guards Corps Navy announced a supertanker and an LPG carrier caught fire after striking naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/irans-revolutionary-guard-says-it-seized-us-drone-near-strait-of-hormuz-3725681) reported that Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps stated it took control of an MQM-170 drone south of Qeshm Island near the Strait of Hormuz.
[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2219571), a Russian state outlet, reported that the IRGC stated two ships were hit by mines in Hormuz and escorted by US aircraft.

[OilPrice](https://oilprice.com/Latest-Energy-News/World-News/Iran-and-Oman-Hold-Talks-on-Strait-of-Hormuz-Security-as-Tanker-Attacks-Surge.html), [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/gulf/2026/11/17/iran-and-oman-discuss-maritime-security-amid-rising-attacks-in-strait-of-hormuz/) reported that the foreign ministers of Iran and Oman discussed regional security and the importance of keeping maritime corridors safe amid rising attacks.

[Rappler (Philippines)](https://www.rappler.com/world/middle-east/iran-oman-foreign-ministers-discuss-safeguarding-maritime-corridors/), [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/oman-iran-discuss-safeguarding-maritime-corridors-amid-increasing-attacks-in-strait-of-hormuz-101794895234837.html), [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/oman-iran-discuss-safeguarding-maritime-corridors-attacks-hormuz-increase) reported that the foreign ministers of Iran and Oman held discussions on safeguarding maritime corridors and ensuring the smooth flow of global shipping and trade.

[CGTN](https://news.cgtn.com/news/2026-11-16/Iranian-FM-to-visit-Pakistan-Oman-as-tensions-mount-in-Middle-East-1S73Dmr5D9K/p.html?UTM_Source=cgtn&UTM_Medium=rss&UTM_Campaign=World) reported that Iranian Foreign Minister Seyed Abbas Araghchi is scheduled to visit Pakistan and Oman amid heightened regional tensions.

[Long War Journal](https://www.longwarjournal.org/archives/2026/11/houthis-sustain-missile-and-drone-attacks-across-saudi-arabia.php) reported that Houthis continued launching missile and drone attacks targeting oil infrastructure, airports, and military installations across Saudi Arabia.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2640286/yemens-government-aligned-forces-repel-houthi-attack-as-fighting-has-displaced-over-340000-people) reported that government-aligned Giants Brigades said they repelled a Houthi attack in southwestern Lahj province.

[Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249324/Saudis-launch-heavy-airstrikes-on-border-villages-in-Saada), a state-media outlet, reported that Saudi artillery and airstrikes targeted border villages in Yemen's Saada province.

[Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249306/Yemen-targets-East-West-oil-pipeline-in-Riyadh-military-spox) reported that the spokesman for the Yemeni armed forces announced four operations against Saudi Arabia, including targeting an East-West oil pipeline in Riyadh.

[Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/202566/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AC%D9%8A%D8%B4-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%8A%D9%85%D9%86%D9%8A-%D9%86%D9%81%D8%B0%D9%86%D8%A7-874-%D9%87%D8%AC%D9%88%D9%85%D8%A7-%D8%B6%D8%AF-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AD%D9%88%D8%AB%D9%8A%D9%8A%D9%86-%D8%AE%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%84-%D8%B3%D8%A7%D8%B9%D8%A7%D8%AA/) reported that the Yemeni army announced executing 874 air and artillery attacks targeting Houthi positions under the 'Dawn of Yemen' operation.

[Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261110-explosions-heard-in-riyadh-after-saudi-led-coalition-intercepts-houthi-missiles/) reported that explosions were heard in Riyadh after the Saudi-led coalition intercepted and destroyed two missiles.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/fani-kayode-refused-interview-after-live-stream-exclusion-sabc/), [AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611160199.html) reported that the South African Broadcasting Corporation stated Nigeria's High Commissioner Femi Fani-Kayode declined an interview invitation after his livestreamed exclusion, while the South African Presidency released the full video including his speech.

[CGTN](https://newsaf.cgtn.com/news/2026-11-15/South-Africa-s-Ramaphosa-visits-Silicon-Valley-for-AI-engagement-1S65rXO7TAA/p.html?UTM_Source=cgtn&UTM_Medium=rss&UTM_Campaign=World) reported that South African President Cyril Ramaphosa arrived in California to lead a high-level working visit to Silicon Valley focused on artificial intelligence.

[Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/politics/1741508-why-femi-fani-kayode-a-suitable-choice-south-africa-top-lawyer-explains/) reported that lawyer Inibehe Effiong supported Femi Fani-Kayode as Nigeria's South Africa envoy.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/nigerias-mission-in-s-africa-urges-calm-in-row-over-ramaphosa-spokesmans-remarks/), [The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/fani-kayode-nigerian-mission-urges-reconciliation-after-clash-with-ramaphosas-spokesman/) reported that Nigeria's High Commission in South Africa called for restraint and reconciliation following a disagreement regarding remarks made by President Cyril Ramaphosa's spokesman.

[The Sun (Nigeria)](https://thesun.ng/nigerian-high-commission-fires-back-at-south-africas-presidency-spokesperson-magwenya-insists-ramaphosa-intervened-in-fani-kayode-row/) reported that the Nigerian High Commission challenged South African presidential spokesperson Vincent Magwenya over his denial that President Cyril Ramaphosa intervened in the Fani-Kayode dispute.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/youre-the-disgrace-nigerian-high-commission-south-africa-trade-blows-over-fani-kayode/) reported that the Nigerian High Commission and South Africa traded blows over Fani-Kayode.

[The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/nigeria-south-africa-diplomatic-row-deepens-as-fani-kayode-alleges-deliberate-blackout-at-diplomatic-ceremony/) reported that diplomatic tensions between Nigeria and South Africa deepened following allegations by Nigerian High Commissioner Femi Fani-Kayode of a deliberate livestream blackout at his diplomatic ceremony.

[Mail & Guardian](https://mg.co.za/thought-leader/the-diplomat/2026-11-13-three-decades-one-melody-of-friendship-serbia-and-south-africa-celebrate-30-years-of-diplomatic-relations/) reported that Serbia and South Africa marked 30 years of diplomatic relations with a collaborative concert.

[The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/ramaphosa-had-no-role-south-africa-accuses-fani-kayode-of-wrongly-linking-president-to-broadcast-blackout/) reported that South African Presidential Spokesperson Vincent Magwenya stated President Cyril Ramaphosa had no involvement in a broadcast disruption.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/headlines/924952-fani-kayode-presents-letter-of-credence-to-ramaphosa-formally-assumes-duty-as-ambassador.html) reported that Femi Fani-Kayode presented his Letter of Credence alongside ambassadors from 14 other countries and formally assumed duty as ambassador.

[This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/13/fani-kayode-presents-letter-of-credence-to-ramaphosa-pledges-to-rebuild-nigeria-south-africa-relations/) reported that Nigeria's High Commissioner to South Africa, Femi Fani-Kayode, presented his letter of credence to President Cyril Ramaphosa.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/fani-kayode-presents-letter-of-credence-to-ramaphosa-protests-livestream-omission/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Femi Fani-Kayode protested the exclusion of his speech from the livestream of the diplomatic ceremony.

[Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/12/anc-vows-soul-searching-after-election-losses-but-says-ramaphosa-will-stay-put/) reported that leaders of South Africa's ruling African National Congress met to discuss the way forward after election losses and stated Ramaphosa will stay put.

[AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611130034.html) reported that the MK party, EFF, and SACP formed a bloc called the Council of the Left representing 20 percent of the municipal vote, with conditional support for the ANC.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/after-suffering-its-worst-election-result-what-s-next-for-the-anc-and-for-south-africa/a-79929902?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that a crushing local election result across South Africa left the ruling ANC searching for answers regarding public frustration.

[Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/12/south-africas-anc-backs-ramaphosa-despite-local-election-losses/) reported that leaders of the African National Congress met to discuss the way forward after suffering a defeat at the ballot box.

[AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611120239.html) reported that about 138 municipalities in South Africa have no political party with enough seats to govern alone, forcing parties to negotiate agreements to share power.

[Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/11/south-african-olympic-swimmer-switches-allegiance-to-the-netherlands/) reported that South African Olympic swimmer Tatjana Smith switched her allegiance to the Netherlands due to financial and practical challenges.

[RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/en/africa/20261109-south-africa-s-anc-slumps-to-worst-ever-election-result) reported that the African National Congress took just 30 percent of the votes in local elections, marking its worst electoral performance to date.

[Daily Maverick](https://www.dailymaverick.co.za/article/2026-11-10-from-475-to-325-the-ancs-local-government-slide-in-one-chart/) reported that the ANC's share of the local vote fell from 47.5% to 32.5%, while the MK entered at 9.9% and the DA rose to 22.9%.

[The Star (South Africa)](https://iol.co.za/the-star/news/2026-11-10-seven-new-parties-set-to-shake-up-cape-town-council-after-local-government-elections/) reported that newly elected municipal councils have 14 days to hold their first meetings and elect political leaders, while 127 hung councils face coalition negotiations.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261110-south-africa-s-anc-slumps-to-worst-ever-election-result) reported that the African National Congress took 30.76 percent of votes in municipal elections, marking its worst-ever result.

[France 24 Africa](https://www.france24.com/en/tv-shows/eye-on-africa/20261109-south-africa-s-anc-suffers-a-historic-setback-in-local-elections-as-coalition-talks-begin) reported that South Africa's ruling ANC party secured just 30 percent of the vote in local elections, marking its worst-ever result as coalition talks began.

According to [Mail & Guardian](https://mg.co.za/news/south-africa/2026-11-08-iec-declares-2026-local-elections-free-and-fair-as-sa-enters-coalition-era/), the Electoral Commission of South Africa declared the 2026 local elections free and fair while ordering recounts in five wards.
