reports.text: [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/tech/article/3374710/what-watch-nvidias-first-earnings-report-jensen-huang-resigned) reported that Nvidia faces its biggest investor test since the resignation of co-founder Jensen Huang when it reports quarterly earnings.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/17/nvidia-sets-up-committee-to-oversee-national-security-and-export-controls), [Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/business/economy/nvidia-sets-up-committee-for-national-security-export-controls) reported that Nvidia created an oversight committee for national security and export controls.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/nvidia-ceo-china-donald-trump-japan-b3086356.html) reported that Nvidia established a new board committee to oversee national security and global trade compliance following the abrupt departure of CEO Jensen Huang.

[Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/business/economy/nvidia-rules-out-huang-comeback-despite-growing-campaign-for-his-return), [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/technology/nvidia-board-not-considering-huangs-return-as-ceo-cnbc-reports-3725680) reported that Nvidia's board is not considering a return for Jensen Huang as CEO and remains focused on investigating his conduct.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/video/2026/11/17/hero-of-mine-sam-altman-praises-nvidias-jensen-huang) reported that OpenAI CEO Sam Altman praised Nvidia boss Jensen Huang for his contribution to the artificial intelligence revolution at a conference in Menlo Park.

[This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/17/reuters-nvidia-rules-out-ex-ceos-comeback-as-campaign-grows/) reported that Nvidia's board is not considering a return for Jensen Huang as chief executive despite a campaign by Donald Trump, Elon Musk, and others.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/trump-jensen-huang-nvidia-ceo-petition-b3086133.html) reported that US President Donald Trump stated that Jensen Huang returning to Nvidia is not a bad idea while downplaying Chinese spy allegations.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/trump-says-he-may-raise-nvidia-espionage-allegations-with-xi-3725670) reported that US President Donald Trump stated he may raise Chinese espionage allegations involving former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang with Chinese President Xi Jinping.

[ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-17/nvidia-rules-out-jensen-huang-return/107394520) reported that Nvidia is not considering reinstating Jensen Huang as chief executive despite a campaign for his return.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/trump-backs-jensen-huang-likely-return-to-nvidia-despite-china-spy-concerns-101794876678995.html) reported that Donald Trump backed calls for Jensen Huang to return as Nvidia CEO while dismissing concerns about his reported links to a woman suspected of being a Chinese spy.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimwFBVV95cUxNNVlEQlFmLS1NdUs1bFBhb0lMMkMzbFQ4b3RmdVFRQUpqTUc3QjBOWGxYZmZXWlBzR1g3aDFJX0pla08xMmVfcUc3SlFVb0NRQnFyZHhEektyZnNtdmdOTGttYjI1YldCNEFvOWhMdHdZM2M5TjhVcjJRWkFBWl82d1o1YzRFQ1dJMmR2Mm9BaGNvbVNTVG53MXBOaw?oc=5) reported that scrutiny of the FAA intensified after a communications meltdown led to a nationwide grounding of flights.

[Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/national/musk-and-trump-back-nvidia-boss-return-20261117-p61ep0.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that more than 165,000 people signed an open letter backed by Elon Musk and Donald Trump to reinstate ousted Nvidia boss Jensen Huang.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/nvidia-board-not-considering-jensen-huang-s-return-as-ceo-despite-trump-and-musk-s-push-report-101794856225877.html) reported that an online petition urging Jensen Huang's return as CEO has garnered 180,000 signatures, though Nvidia's board is not considering it.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/15/us/router-network-faa-airline-ground-stop.html) reported that aviation experts and federal officials stated the network outage began after a new piece of networking equipment flooded the system with data.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/us-flight-ground-stop-preventable-trump-faa-b3085888.html) reported that FAA officials blamed the airplane ground stop on a router.

[Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/world/north-america/trump-teases-kim-jong-un-meeting-as-he-heads-to-asia-backs-huang-for-nvidia-return-20261117-p61eog.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that US President Donald Trump cast doubt on whether Alice Huang was a Chinese spy and stated former Nvidia boss Jensen Huang learned a big lesson.

[NPR World](https://www.npr.org/2026/11/16/g-s1-153841/up-first-newsletter-faa-ground-stop-democratic-leaders-congress-trump-asia-trip) reported that US Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy stated flights could return to normal at the end of Monday following the FAA ground stop.

[The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/16/world/us-airports-returning-normal-disruption/), [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2044934/us-airports-slowly-return-to-normal-after-3-days-of-disruption), [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1582343/us-air-travel-slowly-returns-to-normal-after-chaos/) reported that US air travel slowly returned to normal following three days of nationwide disruption.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1581941/us-air-travel-expected-to-return-to-normal-by-monday-after-three-days-of-disruptions/) reported that United States air travel disruptions affected more than 11,500 flights nationwide over three days.

[CGTN](https://news.cgtn.com/news/2026-11-16/US-transportation-secretary-refuses-to-apologize-for-FAA-ground-stop-1S6PigDFnPy/p.html?UTM_Source=cgtn&UTM_Medium=rss&UTM_Campaign=World) reported that US Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy refused to apologize for the Federal Aviation Administration's nationwide ground stop.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/sean-duffy-made-the-call-to-shut-down-flights-now-he-s-making-his-case-101794797904845.html) reported that Sean Duffy is pressing Congress for billions in funds following his decision to ground thousands of flights.

[ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-16/trump-breaks-silence-after-airline-ground-stop/107388942) reported that US President Donald Trump blamed the Biden administration for an airline ground stop and insisted Congress approve funds to upgrade air traffic control systems.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/faa-issues-brief-ground-stop-at-orlando-international-airport-after-aircraft-experiences-blown-tire-101794787396896.html) reported that the FAA issued a brief ground stop at Orlando International Airport after a Southwest Airlines flight experienced a blown tire.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqgFBVV95cUxQUG5xR2UxLXNkQkhHXzNPQVliSkVQYnJSaDhia2VYdjZPeFBtU1VHN0ZHeVpuRE5Vd0hTNmpsYWtjaVh1ZFRvX2Fnd3JDQWhEQVJxNFY2RjVrLU5IcWhuSVZrZ3lFNDMzeWVwUTBYclE1RDFnUTdkR3NGUjFuaTFPd1hybm9DYzBSR1U2bDU4a19iWTA2YWc0eEdUazBGbXZ1VTc3WFAtSkEyZw?oc=5) reported that President Trump backed a campaign to reinstate the Nvidia CEO despite allegations regarding an affair with a Chinese spy.

[CBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihwFBVV95cUxQSC0zWGZQWDN3UzFxNWJPU2JmRkN0cXhTdkNkSWtRU2pBZ1FPVWRoeFhYNHIzWm1aX2JYTGlFWFF2SmM3OGhESG5hTmtlMUdYdDNYQ1Q5RHRWaHc0LTNWalJ4MG0zLUFXbG52aTdaUDB1eElqVHRDUmQ1WS03Z2hiU1pxZkxiMXM?oc=5) reported that Silicon Valley leaders called for the reinstatement of the Nvidia CEO with a 'Stand With Jensen' petition.

[El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/bbc/traigan-jensen-vuelta-campana-millonarios-tecnologicos-favor-regreso-huang-nvidia-opina-trump_1794855914) reported that the scandal generated tensions between the US Treasury and Commerce departments over high-end Nvidia chip shipments to Megaspeed.

[RT](https://rt-english.com/news/648905-musk-huang-nvidia-return/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS) reported that Elon Musk joined other Silicon Valley executives in backing a petition calling for Nvidia to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO.

[El País](https://english.elpais.com/economy-and-business/2026-11-16/i-wish-upon-you-ample-doses-of-pain-and-suffering-the-rise-and-fall-of-jensen-huang-king-of-nvidia.html) reported that Jensen Huang's downfall highlights the extreme vulnerability of a global stock market dependent on a single industry and company.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/trump-says-jensen-huang-scandal-did-not-put-us-security-at-risk-says-country-stronger-than-ever-101794847628850.html) reported that Donald Trump stated the Jensen Huang scandal did not put US security at risk and defended Howard Lutnick.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/16/president-trump-says-he-wouldnt-mind-jensen-huang-being-reinstated-as-nvidia-ceo), [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/video/2026/nov/16/trump-would-not-mind-if-jensen-huang-returns-to-nvidia-video) reported that US President Donald Trump stated he would not mind if Jensen Huang is reinstated as Nvidia CEO.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/16/us/politics/trump-jensen-huang-nvidia.html) reported that Trump played down the fallout from Huang's affair with a woman identified by officials as an intelligence asset.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2026/11/16/silicon-valley-insiders-urge-nvidia-to-restore-jensen-huangs-ceo-role?traffic_source=rss) reported that market analysts stated Nvidia faces a potential 30 percent value loss without Jensen Huang.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/economy/musk-tech-leaders-back-petition-to-reinstate-nvidias-jensen-huang-3725618) reported that Elon Musk, Travis Kalanick, and other technology executives signed an online open letter urging Nvidia's board to bring back co-founder Jensen Huang.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/16/elon-musk-joins-calls-to-bring-back-jensen-huang-as-allies-build-war-room-to-lobby-his-ret), [Dagens Nyheter](https://www.dn.se/ekonomi/upprop-for-att-jensen-huang-ska-atervanda-till-nvidia/) reported that Elon Musk joined calls and signed a petition demanding the reinstatement of Jensen Huang as Nvidia CEO.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/nvidia-stock-falls-as-elon-musk-silicon-valley-executives-push-for-jensen-huangs-return-as-ceo-101794823089192.html) reported that Nvidia stock fell as supporters pushed for Jensen Huang's return.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/the-campaign-to-bring-back-jensen-huang-as-nvidia-ceo-101794797544497.html) reported that allies of Jensen Huang are making the case in open letters, phone calls, and group chats that his ouster was hasty.

reports.text: [US Department of Defense](https://www.war.gov/News/Releases/Release/Article/4643910/secretary-of-war-pete-hegseth-elevates-special-operations-leadership-to-revital/) reported that Secretary of War Pete Hegseth issued a memorandum to elevate the assistant secretary for special operations and low-intensity conflict.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwgFBVV95cUxNZ2VqbXZuQ2FtWnBZRkNqbFdQQjg2WExvZzV5X2ZNSzFVV1dvSkFsaTBkNFNlczVkclJCOU85bXE5WkpyTlpfeU9mQzhaeE12dkR2a21xcjNRNjNDUUR3S1dIck4yN1pXUWJZVmU2ZXJ3ZXlkYlFIbU1hMmZBRUpwU0hRRGFNMnNvbmF6TlRKLTVvYmtwUWlwTTZiMS1peDMwazgzVlNyUUZDSlE4dTBOaXVuc1JzSEZyNjNMMG9JY0RIQQ?oc=5) reported that US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth awarded a medal to the soldier who rebuked his group outside the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/hegseth-impeachment-vote-capitol-jonathan-jackson-b3083801.html) reported that Representative Jonathan Jackson was one of several Democrats who claimed a traffic incident caused them to arrive late to the impeachment vote.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/hegseth-medal-tomb-of-the-unknown-soldier-b3084131.html), [Military.com](https://www.military.com/hegseth-awards-a-joint-medal-to-the-tomb-guard-who-told-his-group-to-be-silent-at-arlington-on-veterans-day), [The Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/world/us/2026/11/12/pete-hegseth-awards-medal-to-soldier-who-reprimanded-him-near-tomb-of-the-unknown-soldier/) reported that US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth awarded a medal to the soldier who reprimanded his group at Arlington National Cemetery.

[The Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/world/us/2026/11/12/guard-scolds-pete-hegseths-group-for-laughing-at-tomb-of-the-unknown-soldier/) reported that Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, his wife, and officials were visiting the war memorial at Virginia's Arlington national cemetery.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-914675) reported that immediately after laughter from the group, the sentinel moved toward them and shouted that all visitors must maintain an atmosphere of silence.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1580239/us-army-sentinel-rebukes-defense-secretary-pete-hegseths-delegation-at-tomb-of-the-unknown-soldier/) reported that a US Army sentinel guarding the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier sharply rebuked Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth's delegation following a Veterans Day ceremony.

[CGTN](https://newsus.cgtn.com/news/2026-11-12/House-Republicans-block-bid-to-impeach-Pete-Hegseth-1RZZ9vJajzq/p.html?UTM_Source=cgtn&UTM_Medium=rss&UTM_Campaign=World) reported that House Republicans blocked a bid to impeach Pete Hegseth.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/11/us/politics/democrats-backlash-missing-hegseth-impeachment-vote.html) reported that eleven Democrats were absent during the Hegseth impeachment vote, helping Republicans shelve the charges.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/11/us/politics/massie-trump-difficult-republican-votes.html) reported that Representative Thomas Massie stated he would use his remaining time in office to push his party toward votes for sanity.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/pete-hegseth-impeachment-vote-democrats-b3083064.html) reported that California Representative Sydney Kamlager-Dove criticized colleagues after a resolution against Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth failed.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/11/first-thing-pete-hegseth-survives-effort-to-impeach-him) reported that House Republicans blocked an impeachment resolution that cited US military actions in Iran, Yemen, and Venezuela.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/vance-defends-hegseth-labels-impeachment-push-ridiculous-show-3725437) reported that US Vice President JD Vance defended Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth and dismissed an impeachment resolution as a ridiculous show.

[The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/us-house-votes-derail-impeachment-hegseth) reported that Republicans in the US House of Representatives banded together to derail an effort to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth.
[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cxly4y5jzl0qo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that the US House blocked a bid to impeach Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth for now.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/hegseth-impeachment-vote-news-house-b3082802.html) reported that Donald Trump took a victory lap after the House GOP shelved the Pete Hegseth impeachment articles.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/us-republicans-derail-bid-to-impeach-hegseth/article71687959.ece) reported that the U.S. House voted 211 to 204 to send the impeachment resolution to the Judiciary Committee.

[NZ Herald](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/embattled-pentagon-chief-slams-impeachment-farce/W7JRTBI6NZAKZNPDSPUIEQWPFI/) reported that the articles accused Pete Hegseth of misconduct over Iran, Yemen and boat strikes.
[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/svet/hegset-preziveo-pokusaj-opoziva/lgp5w4q) reported that Republicans in the US House of Representatives blocked an initiative to impeach Pete Hegseth.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/internacional/congresistas-republicanos-bloquean-juicio-politico-hegseth_202611116af42580ea8d89799781613d.html) reported that the impeachment was pushed by Representative Thomas Massie.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/11/us-republicans-block-efforts-to-impeach-us-defence-secretary-pete-hegseth-over-iran-war) reported that Hegseth defended operations he led in Yemen, Iran, and against alleged drug smugglers.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/10/us/politics/house-hegseth-impeachment-vote.html) reported that Republicans turned back an effort to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, sparing him from potential ouster.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/10/us/politics/hegseth-speech-impeachment-takeaways.html) reported that Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth defended his record in office during a news briefing.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261110-it-s-a-farce-hegseth-slams-impeachment-effort) reported that US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth dismissed a move to impeach him by a Republican lawmaker as a farce and a political stunt.

[United Daily News (Taiwan)](https://udn.com/news/story/6809/9870543) reported that US Defense Minister Pete Hegseth called the impeachment initiative a farce and stated that attacking Iran was the right decision after Kentucky Republican Representative Thomas Massie introduced an impeachment motion.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/svet/hegsetu-preti-opoziv-evo-sta-mu-se-stavlja-na-teret-prvo-obracanje-ministra-odbrane/jkwd2m4) reported that US Defense Minister Pete Hegseth said at a press conference in the Pentagon that the impeachment initiative is based on political disagreements.

[El País](https://english.elpais.com/usa/2026-11-10/pete-hegseth-on-impeachment-effort-it-is-a-farce-and-its-a-stunt-and-everybody-knows-it.html) reported that Pete Hegseth held his first press conference in six months after Republican Congressman Thomas Massie launched proceedings to remove him from office.

[RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/2026/1110/1598704-pete-hegseth-dismisses-impeachment-effort/) reported that US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth called an effort to impeach him over abuse of power in the Iran war a farce and sabotage.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/10/us/politics/nancy-lacore-hegseth-impeachment.html) reported that Nancy Lacore, who was chief of the Navy reserve until last year and will represent a House district starting in January, was fired by Hegseth and supports his ouster.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/us/politics/article/3373990/hegseth-calls-impeachment-bid-farce-he-defends-iran-war) reported that US Secretary of Defence Pete Hegseth called an impeachment bill against him a farce while defending the ongoing war in Iran and air strikes.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/house-set-to-vote-on-pete-hegseth-impeachment-resolution-today-says-thomas-massie-101794322788233.html) reported that Congressman Thomas Massie stated the House will first consider a motion to stop the impeachment resolution against Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/pete-hegseth-pentagon-briefing-us-defense-chief-dismisses-impeachment-move-as-political-spectacle-101794316626350.html) reported that US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth dismissed the impeachment move as a political spectacle and stated he stands beside every operation in the Iran war.

[Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/alvo-de-impeachment-secretario-de-defesa-de-trump-chama-processo-de-espetaculo-politico.shtml) reported that US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth called the impeachment process initiated against him a political spectacle.

[Military.com](https://www.military.com/hegseth-claims-iran-victory-in-press-conference-as-war-and-impeachment-fight-continue) reported that Pete Hegseth defended the Iran war and drug-boat strikes as Representative Thomas Massie's impeachment articles head toward a possible House vote.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/09/us/politics/hegseth-impeachment-massie.html) reported that Representative Thomas Massie set in motion a vote to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth that must occur by Wednesday.

[US Department of Defense](https://www.war.gov/News/Releases/Release/Article/4644710/secretary-of-war-pete-hegseth-orders-sweeping-overhaul-of-military-education-to/) reported that Secretary of War Pete Hegseth directed a comprehensive overhaul of the Department's higher military service colleges.

[The Guardian World](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/live/2026/nov/10/donald-trump-pete-hegseth-thomas-massie-republicans-iran-war-impeachment-midterms-latest-news-updates) reported that US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth dismissed an impeachment effort from Congressman Thomas Massie as a personal manifesto driven by ego.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/10/hegseth-promises-to-defend-warriors-as-he-faces-impeachment?traffic_source=rss) reported that US Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth criticized an attempt by Representative Thomas Massie to impeach him.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20261110-live-pentagon-chief-pete-hegseth-calls-move-to-impeach-him-a-farce) reported that US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth called moves to impeach him over abuse of power in the Iran war a farce that would fail.

[The Guardian World](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/10/pete-hegseth-impeachment-massie) reported that Thomas Massie accused the US defense secretary of illegally waging war without congressional authorization and abusing his powers.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1580374/indonesian-vice-president-gibran-rakabuming-raka-submits-resignation-to-parliament/) reported that Indonesian Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka formally submitted his resignation to parliament's upper house in Jakarta.

[GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/world/1009283/indonesia-vp-hands-resignation-to-parliament-as-dad-jokowi-backs-prabowo/story/) reported that Indonesia VP Gibran Rakabuming Raka handed his resignation to parliament following a push by lawmakers for his impeachment.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cmvgxgz87qqro?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that Indonesia's vice-president resigned amid signs that the ruling alliance with President Prabowo is fraying.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/12/world/asia/indonesia-gibran-vice-president-resign.html) reported that Gibran Rakabuming Raka stepped down amid a scandal over his academic credentials.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/12/indonesian-vp-resigns-over-education-qualification-row?traffic_source=rss) reported that Gibran Rakabuming Raka resigned over a dispute regarding his educational qualifications.

[Antara](https://en.antaranews.com/news/442051/gibran-resigns-as-vice-president-letter-gives-no-reason-mpr) reported that Indonesia's People's Consultative Assembly Speaker Ahmad Muzani disclosed that Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka submitted his resignation letter without giving a reason.
[Antara](https://en.antaranews.com/news/441975/gibran-resignation-would-halt-120-lawmaker-impeachment-motion) reported that Gibran's resignation would halt a 120-lawmaker impeachment motion.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/asia/southeast-asia/article/3374164/gibran-officially-resigns-indonesias-vice-president-after-degree-scandal) reported that Gibran officially resigned as Indonesia's vice-president following a scandal over his high school diploma.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiygFBVV95cUxPOTZ0Q3FKQkpsRnZBSlJKMHFqS3d1QV9qTXp5aUpidXh5eEF3amd5aWh0YUFfbnJHYVQ4c29LaVRQTDJKbkRiUHBuTERNU1RuRnJ4dlFGdlY2ZWJIYjN1RmRQeUF6bkNITTFjQ2tUWlpUQWJqd3ZFQ1FOSnR4MkRzSm5uaDVoSjlOZVgwUHRkX1JCVTItVE1NUnVIQjZxcTd0N3V2NDUxSm9aUldEUWZQeVB6WGIxT0lQTE5QY2F4SG9PaTgxRGZkcnNB?oc=5) reported that over 100 Indonesian lawmakers signed a petition demanding the vice president's impeachment.

[Antara](https://en.antaranews.com/news/441795/all-house-factions-submit-proposal-to-impeach-vp-gibran) reported that all political party factions in Indonesia's House of Representatives submitted a formal Right to Express proposal to impeach Vice President Gibran.

[CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/indonesia-petition-vp-gibran-rakabuming-raka-impeachment-6542386) reported that over 100 Indonesian lawmakers signed a petition stating that Vice-President Gibran Rakabuming Raka no longer meets the requirements of his post.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/week-asia/politics/article/3374034/indonesian-vp-resignation-drama-raises-stakes-prabowo-alliances-strain) reported that the prospect of Gibran Rakabuming Raka stepping down as Indonesia's vice-president has raised the stakes for President Prabowo Subianto.

[Antara](https://en.antaranews.com/news/441679/govt-assures-no-vice-presidential-vacancy-yusril) reported that Coordinating Minister for Law, Human Rights, Immigration and Correctional Affairs Yusril Ihza Mahendra assured there is no vice presidential vacancy.

[Antara](https://en.antaranews.com/news/441647/gibran-joins-prabowo-at-palace-after-expressing-intention-to-resign) reported that Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka attended a National Heroes Day award ceremony at the State Palace after expressing his intention to resign.

[Antara](https://en.antaranews.com/news/441639/gibran-seeks-chance-to-prove-validity-of-diploma-through-court-process) reported that Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka asked President Prabowo Subianto for an opportunity to prove the validity of his diploma through court.

[Antara](https://en.antaranews.com/news/441607/palace-respects-parliament-inquiry-push-into-vps-diploma) reported that the Indonesian Presidential Palace stated it respects the parliamentary political process concerning an inquiry into the Vice President's diploma.

[Antara](https://en.antaranews.com/news/441583/palace-confirms-gibrans-intention-to-resign-from-vice-presidency) reported that State Secretary Minister Prasetyo Hadi confirmed Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka expressed his intention to resign from the vice presidency.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/asia/southeast-asia/article/3373961/indonesian-vp-gibrans-fate-hangs-balance-parliament-ponders-probe) reported that Indonesia's parliament reconvened with lawmakers weighing a probe into the eligibility of Vice-President Gibran Rakabuming Raka.

[CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/indonesia-vice-president-gibran-rakabuming-raka-intention-step-down-6538841) reported that Indonesian VP Gibran expressed intent to step down, while a presidential spokesperson denied reports that President Prabowo Subianto rejected the request.

[CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/indonesia-politicians-psi-ministers-joko-widodo-son-6538586) reported that three politicians in Prabowo's Cabinet resigned from the party led by Jokowi's son.

[The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/10/asia-pacific/politics/indonesia-vice-president-probe/) reported that the fate of Indonesia's vice president hangs in the balance as lawmakers mull a probe amid a political rift between his father and President Prabowo Subianto.

reports.text: [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/scott-bessent-confirms-relocating-from-washington-home-to-military-base-amid-iranian-threats-101794581505450.html), [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/american-politics/article-914821) reported that US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent confirmed relocating from his Washington home to a military base following Iranian threats.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2026/nov/13/us-terror-case-raf-fairford-arrests) reported that a suspect held in a New York jail has been linked to a handler behind Iran-linked operations in Britain in connection with the RAF Fairford arrests.

[Defense News](https://www.defensenews.com/global/europe/2026/11/12/3-iranian-backed-men-indicted-in-attempted-plot-on-raf-fairford/) reported that three men, with one working from jail, allegedly conspired to commit around 20 terrorist attacks across the US and Europe, including a plot on RAF Fairford.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-914783) reported that a 41-year-old US Army officer stationed at NATO headquarters in the UK was arrested on suspicion of spying for Russia.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1579836/us-authorities-charge-three-men-over-suspected-terror-plot-targeting-raf-fairford/) reported that United States authorities unsealed an eight-count indictment charging three men for involvement in foreign terror plots targeting RAF Fairford.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/coded-messages-from-jail-cell-how-alleged-iranian-operative-mohammad-dawood-al-saadi-coordinated-foiled-raf-fairford-terror-plot-uk-us-iran-war-101794386640896.html) reported that American and British authorities suspected an Iranian link to the foiled terror plot, while Tehran denied any involvement.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-charges-3-alleged-iran-operatives-for-targeting-raf-fairford-in-uk-20-other-terror-plots-101794384900293.html) reported that US prosecutors charged three alleged operatives for targeting RAF Fairford in the UK and other terror plots.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/11/us-charges-three-men-for-allegedly-plotting-attack-on-uk-base?traffic_source=rss) reported that the US charged three men for allegedly plotting an attack on a Royal Air Force base in Fairford, UK.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/us-charges-3-alleged-iranian-operatives-over-plots-targeting-jewish-communities-and-a-uk-airbase/a-79913543?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that US prosecutors claimed three alleged Iranian operatives were planning a campaign of terror against Jewish communities and a UK airbase.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20261110-us-iranian-operatives-raf-fairford-terror-plot) reported that the US Justice Department charged three men described as Iranian operatives over an alleged September terrorist plot at Britain's RAF Fairford airbase.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/united-states-canada/article/3374046/us-treasury-chief-bessent-moved-military-base-after-iran-threats) reported that US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent moved from his Washington DC residence to a US military base after Iranian threats against his life.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/us-treasury-chief-bessent-moved-to-military-base-after-iranian-threats-reports-say/article71688103.ece) reported that Iran has previously denied plotting to attend officials and people on U.S. soil.

[Oslobođenje](https://www.oslobodjenje.ba/vijesti/svijet/ministar-finansija-sad-a-se-preselio-u-vojnu-bazu-zbog-straha-od-irana/) reported that U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent moved to a military base due to threats from Iran.

[VG](https://www.vg.no/nyheter/i/xJR66p/wsj-usa-evakuerte-fly-fra-britisk-militaerbase?utm_medium=rss) reported that the US moved several military aircraft from a base in the UK following threats from Iran.

[Baltic News Network](https://bnn-news.com/world/us-soldier-arrested-in-great-britain-on-suspicion-of-spying-for-russia-9czbdwu) reported that British police detained an American soldier accused of passing sensitive information to foreign intelligence services.
[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/11/us-soldier-arrested-in-england-on-suspicion-of-spying-for-russia) reported that the FBI stated the case is of the utmost concern.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/10/us/politics/bessent-moved-base-iran-threats.html) reported that Treasury Secretary Bessent was moved from his D.C.-area home to a military base amid Iranian threats.

[CBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxPcnM2ZmY3ZXBGMkQwN09vMkxoZTNNd3MxSjRnZnFnN3RrUDVNeTk3LUYxVHNWQ2RnMkQ4OVF5RDNlSUlLbzcxUFJvaGFCU3pscExIbVZ1VldROUl3X1pvSktwVDJGcTlYMzNmY3FwRFhJeVJmZHpHd1F4UnpmeHlNOFUxb0ZnRlFiY2oyZA?oc=5) reported that a U.S. soldier was arrested in England on suspicion of espionage related to Russia.

[CBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilwFBVV95cUxOTWFjbHBKUTJzdVgtMEpEdktjTk16NWFQVkJncFJTV3UxcFJET2Ixc0d2M2lwdjZyYk0xY1RSd0pDbzF4ZFdJeXRORS1TQlItU21NdmRDRVBoRUZhUTQwYnNCWmZ2VE9lenMtdDJ1MXotZ1pxNkNQN09OMlhuWWJvX3QxZWZsWnJMbTJreDQ5YzRnQ0ZwTVB3?oc=5) reported that three individuals were charged in the U.S. with planning terror attacks, including an alleged assault on a British airbase.

[Military.com](https://www.military.com/us-pulls-tankers-special-ops-planes-from-raf-mildenhall-over-iran-threat) reported that air refueling tankers and special operations aircraft dispersed from RAF Mildenhall as force protection levels were elevated.

[Gazeta Wyborcza](https://wyborcza.pl/7,75399,33125223,amerykanie-zabieraja-samoloty-z-kolejnej-brytyjskiej-bazy-boja.html) reported that American tankers were evacuated from a second base in Britain because of an Iran threat.

[Politico](https://www.politico.eu/article/us-military-aircraft-pulled-from-second-uk-base-after-iran-threat/?utm_source=RSS_Feed&utm_medium=RSS&utm_campaign=RSS_Syndication) reported that bombers were withdrawn from RAF Fairford in October after an Iran-linked security incident.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1579406/us-withdraws-aircraft-from-second-uk-military-base/) reported that the United States moved at least 10 military aircraft from RAF Mildenhall following an alleged threat linked to Iran.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/us-relocates-military-aircraft-from-british-base-amid-iran-threats-101794324495306.html) reported that the U.S. Air Force relocated 13 aircraft from RAF Mildenhall to bases in Scotland, Spain, and Germany after identifying a threat.

[Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/189962/%D8%AA%D8%AD%D8%B3%D8%A8%D8%A7-%D9%84%D8%AA%D9%87%D8%AF%D9%8A%D8%AF-%D8%A5%D9%8A%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%86%D9%8A-%D9%88%D8%A7%D8%B4%D9%86%D8%B7%D9%86-%D8%AA%D8%B3%D8%AD%D8%A8-12-%D8%B7%D8%A7%D8%A6%D8%B1%D8%A9-%D9%85%D9%86-%D9%82%D8%A7%D8%B9%D8%AF%D8%A9-%D8%A8%D8%B1%D9%8A%D8%B7%D8%A7%D9%86%D9%8A%D8%A9) reported that the US military withdrew at least 12 refueling aircraft from a British military base due to an Iranian threat.

[Egypt Independent](https://www.egyptindependent.com/us-evacuates-aircraft-from-british-military-base-after-threat-from-iran-wsj-reports/) reported that the United States evacuated American military aircraft from a base in England following a threat from Iran, according to The Wall Street Journal.
[The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/us-withdraws-military-aircraft-second-uk-airbase) reported that Sky News stated 12 aircraft left Mildenhall on Monday based on flight tracking sources.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/europe/article/3373947/us-withdraws-9-military-aircraft-second-uk-airbase-after-iran-threat-reports) reported that the United States withdrew military aircraft from a second British airbase following a threat from Iran, according to the Wall Street Journal.
[The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/10/world/us-uk-base-evacuated-iran/) reported that US aircraft were evacuated from a second UK base due to an Iran threat.

reports.text: [Al Mada (Iraq)](https://almadapaper.net/461338/) reported that armed clashes broke out between the Iranian Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps and members of the opposition Kurdistan Free Life Party near the Iraq-Iran border.

previous_titles: Paraguay's Pena faces new charges over bank crisis
Paraguay’s ex-president Pena faces new charge over Ueno bank collapse
Paraguay’s Ex-President Peña Moved to Prison

reports.text: [teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/paraguay-pena-moved-to-military-prison/), a state-media outlet, reported that a criminal guarantees judge ordered the immediate transfer of former president Santiago Peña to the Viñas Cué military prison in Asuncion.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/16/paraguay-ex-president-moved-to-military-jail-amid-special-treatment-reports?traffic_source=rss) reported that former Paraguayan president Santiago Peña was accused of corruption following the collapse of Ueno Bank earlier in the month.

[El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/mundo/santiago-pena-trasladado-carcel-militar-evitar-privilegios_1794875745) reported that Santiago Peña was transferred to a military jail to avoid privileges following an immediate transfer order by penal guarantee judge Osmar Legal.

[The Rio Times](https://www.riotimesonline.com/paraguay-ex-president-pena-moved-vinas-cue-military-prison/) reported that former Paraguayan president Santiago Peña entered a military prison following a judge's transfer order in the Ueno Bank case.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/santiago-pena-ingresa-a-una-carcel-militar-en-paraguay-esposado-y-con-chaleco-antibalas-33164061) reported that former Paraguayan president Santiago Peña was placed in preventive detention at a military prison.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/el-mundo/el-escandalo-por-los-privilegios-de-santiago-pena-en-prision-fuerza-su-traslado-a-otra-carcel-nid16112026/) reported that the scandal over Santiago Peña's privileges in prison forced his transfer to another military jail in Paraguay.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/juez-en-paraguay-ordena-trasladar-al-expresidente-santiago-pena-a-carcel-militar-sera-recluido-en-la-prision-de-vinas-cue/) reported critics denounced alleged privileges granted to the former leader, including a gymnasium.

[El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/mundo/entrega-jefe-juridico-banco-central-paraguay-investigado-caida-ueno-bank_1794790896) reported that Aldo Rodríguez, head of the legal department of the Central Bank of Paraguay, surrendered to a police station in Asunción after an arrest warrant was issued over an altered report in the Ueno Bank case.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/latinoamerica/asi-vive-la-principal-plaza-de-mercado-de-asuncion-la-crisis-financiera-por-la-caida-de-ueno-bank-en-paraguay-3600940) reported that sellers at Mercado 4 in Asunción stated sales have plummeted due to the Ueno Bank financial crisis.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/el-mundo/la-caida-del-ueno-bank-en-paraguay-revela-el-avance-de-los-tecnomagnates-en-america-latina-nid14112026/) reported that the crisis of Paraguay's digital bank exposed links between technology entrepreneurs, governments, and far-right financing networks.

[El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/mundo/fiscalia-paraguaya-acusa-asociacion-criminal-pena-cupula-bcp-caso-ueno-bank_1794677588) reported that Paraguayan prosecutor Christian Benítez stated a new charge of criminal association has been added against former president Santiago Peña and the Central Bank leadership in the Ueno bank case.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/how-a-bank-collapse-in-paraguay-brought-down-the-countrys-president-explained/article71677767.ece) reported that millions of customers abruptly lost access to savings and pension accounts after regulators seized a bank in Paraguay.

[teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/paraguay-pena-criminal-association-ueno/), a state-media outlet, reported that Paraguay's Public Prosecutor's Office added a charge of criminal association as perpetrator against former president Santiago Peña.

[El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/internacional/fiscalia-acusa-expresidente-paraguayo-pena-de-liderar-una-asociacion-criminal) reported that the prosecutor's office accused former Paraguayan president Peña of leading a criminal association, which carries a sentence of up to 15 years in prison.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/politica/milei-se-comunico-con-pedro-alliana-el-sucesor-de-santiago-pena-en-paraguay-nid13112026/) reported that Javier Milei communicated with Pedro Alliana, the successor of Santiago Peña, and expressed readiness to collaborate.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/latinoamerica/crisis-en-paraguay-fiscalia-pide-ampliar-la-imputacion-contra-el-expresidente-santiago-pena-y-lo-acusa-de-liderar-una-asociacion-criminal-3600892), [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/el-mundo/la-fiscalia-de-paraguay-complica-la-situacion-de-pena-con-una-nueva-imputacion-por-asociacion-nid13112026/), [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/fiscalia-acusa-a-expresidente-paraguayo-de-liderar-asociacion-criminal-santiago-pena-protegio-desde-el-poder-a-ueno-bank-senala/) reported that the Paraguayan prosecutor's office expanded charges against former president Santiago Peña, accusing him of leading a criminal association and protecting Ueno Bank from power.

[Siempre!](https://www.siempre.mx/2026/11/santiago-pena-palacios-presidente-de-paraguay-sigue-la-pauta-destituido-y-en-la-carcel/) reported that regulators seized Ueno Bank, which managed about 850 million dollars in public funds.

[The Rio Times](https://www.riotimesonline.com/paraguay-adds-prosecutors-ueno-bank-pena-investigations/) reported that Paraguay's attorney general Emiliano Rolón added two prosecutors to the Ueno Bank and Santiago Peña investigations.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/fiscalia-de-paraguay-allana-la-residencia-presidencial-por-escandalo-de-ueno-bank-33098347) reported that the Paraguayan justice system is carrying out two parallel investigations, one focused on Ueno Bank executives, 10 of whom are detained.

[El Nuevo Siglo](https://www.elnuevosiglo.com.co/internacional/paraguay-detienen-al-superintendente-de-bancos-por-caso-ueno-bank) reported that Paraguay's Superintendent of Banks was detained in connection with the Ueno Bank case following reports by prosecutors regarding operations without guarantees.

[MercoPress](https://en.mercopress.com/2026/11/12/paraguay-s-banking-superintendent-arrested-in-the-ueno-bank-investigation?utm_source=feed&utm_medium=rss&utm_content=main&utm_campaign=rss), [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/mundo/caso-ueno-bank-detuvieron-superintendente-bancos-paraguay_0_haEsfgaxKm.html) reported that Paraguay's Superintendent of Banks, Holger Insfrán, was arrested as part of the investigation into Ueno Bank.

[El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/economia/ahorristas-bolivianos-ueno-bank-pueden-perder-12-dinero-tipo-cambio_1794364395) reported that Sergio León, director of the Bolivian-Paraguayan Chamber of Commerce, stated that Bolivian depositors in Ueno Bank can lose between up to 12% of their money due to the exchange rate.

[El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/mundo/seguridad-social-paraguay-denuncia-ueno-bank-516-millones-dolares_1794351537) reported that Paraguay's social security denounced Ueno Bank for more than 516 million dollars, with President Pedro Alliana confirming the return of funds to public sector contributors.

[El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/mundo/gobernante-partido-colorado-expulsa-santiago-pena-escandalo-ueno-bank_1794351056) reported that the ruling Colorado Party expelled Santiago Peña after the Ueno bank scandal.

[Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/video-explica-crise-politica-e-bancaria-que-abala-o-paraguai-e-derrubou-presidente.shtml) reported that Paraguay is facing a political and financial crisis following the collapse of Ueno Bank, which left approximately 3 million clients affected.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/banco-central-revela-que-devolvio-ahorros-al-93-de-los-clientes-de-ueno-bank-en-paraguay-investigacion-continua/) reported that the Central Bank of Paraguay announced it returned savings to 93 percent of Ueno Bank clients while investigations continue.

[El Deber](https://eldeber.com.bo/economia/caso-ueno-deja-7-senales-alerta-vigilar-salud-bancos_1794326171) reported that banking expert Fabián Chaín warned that the Ueno case leaves seven warning signs to monitor the health of banks.

reports.text: [RT](https://rt-english.com/russia/648919-moscow-car-bombing-ukraine/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS), a Russian state outlet, reported that a woman suspected of acting on orders from Kyiv's intelligence services was detained over the car bombing of an ex-Ukrainian prime minister's aide.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/16/russia-s-fsb-arrests-woman-over-car-bombing-of-intelligence-officer-sergei-zavorotny-says-she-was-manipulated-by-scammers), [The Moscow Times](https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/11/16/suspect-arrested-over-moscow-car-bombing-of-pro-russian-ukrainian-pms-ex-aide-a94278) reported that Russia's Federal Security Service detained a woman in Moscow suspected of involvement in the car bombing of intelligence officer Sergei Zavorotny after scammers coerced her into planting the bomb.

[TASS](https://tass.com/society/2218515), a Russian state outlet, reported that a Ukrainian agent was detained in Crimea while retrieving a package from a cache in Simferopol and confessed to passing data on air defenses and combat ships.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/14/after-detaining-polish-spies-in-kaliningrad-the-fsb-released-their-alleged-messages-in-polish-native-speakers-say-they-contain-errors-and-unnatural-phrasing) reported that native speakers stated Polish-language messages released by Russia's Federal Security Service alongside its announcement of detained Polish citizens contained errors and unnatural phrasing.

[Politika](https://www.politika.rs/scc/clanak/802455/uhapsene-dve-osobe-u-beceju-zaplenjeni-marihuana-i-amfetamin) reported that two people were arrested in Bečej and marijuana and amphetamines were seized.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/89899), a Russian state outlet, reported that the FSB detained four individuals in three separate incidents in Adygea, Donetsk, and Omsk.

Some 300 Italian schools evacuated due to bomb threats

narratives.label: Italy School Bomb Threats

reports.text: [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-915187) reported that more than 8,000 bomb hoaxes targeted schools, airlines, and media outlets across Europe, disrupting flights and classes.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/16/italian-schools-hit-by-new-wave-of-bomb-and-poison-threats) reported that under new security guidelines, Italian schools are no longer automatically evacuated for vague mass threats, leaving the decision to schools.

[Egypt Independent](https://www.egyptindependent.com/europe-scrambles-to-respond-to-wave-of-bomb-threats-disrupting-transport-media-and-schools/) reported that an unprecedented wave of bomb threats disrupted transport, media, and schools across Europe.
[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cr894w453e90o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that schools across Italy received bomb threats for the second day in a row, sparking evacuations.

[ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/sito/notizie/cronaca/2026/11/12/nuovi-allarmi-bomba-in-3.800-scuole-ma-si-resta-in-classe_8e554317-0de6-4431-82f1-76e9da9afb9d.html) reported that new bomb alarms hit 3,800 schools in Italy while classes continued.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimwFBVV95cUxQSFJJaFJoR2JHVWdTZmVzdkw2MDhTc29qU0pDRmdmaXpwWjN2Q3VyYjlFUWJkRmJHTmlaNFFYdWIxdTFHR3p5VGlTaGExYzFwZ3BTRjV6dTJuQWdibllJN1lwd3E1RThuUEU2ekpfbU1GSUJwU2tyMkd5a3daSEkwNm5YU19zUEIxLWpSNjNDS0lzT1NCd2ZQRG1COA?oc=5), [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/italian-schools-hit-by-fresh-bomb-threats-premiers-office-targeted-3725511) reported that Italian schools remained open despite a fresh wave of email bomb threats that led to evacuations and security inspections in several regions.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/12/italy-hit-by-second-day-of-school-bomb-threats-as-meloni-summons-opposition) reported that bomb threats hit schools in Italy and France, and French President Emmanuel Macron stated it is too soon to blame foreign powers.

[ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/sito/notizie/politica/2026/11/12/nel-pomeriggio-riunione-tecnica-sul-protocollo-di-gestione-degli-allarmi_935b5bfb-8d1b-47fb-b1f5-5bec809755af.html) reported that an official circular was issued to schools stating that evacuations should not occur in the absence of concrete dangers, while prefects retain the authority to order them.

[ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/sito/notizie/cronaca/2026/11/12/nuovo-allarme-bomba-nelle-scuole-controlli-e-evacuazioni-liveblog_97a3c6b7-93f4-44a2-940b-dd33198f2f91.html) reported that a new bomb alarm hit schools across various regions via emails signed by Mikhail Andropov.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261112-hybrid-warfare-hoax-bomb-alerts-sent-to-schools-in-italy-uk-in-latest-disruption) reported that hoax bomb alerts were sent to schools in Italy and the UK.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261112-thousands-of-schools-evacuated-in-italy-as-bomb-threats-spread-across-europe) reported that thousands of schools were evacuated across Italy following a series of hoax bomb threats.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/hoax-bomb-alerts-sent-schools-italy-uk-and-ireland-latest-disruption) reported that schools across Italy were evacuated after around 6,300 of them received bomb warnings.

[Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/europe/hoax-bomb-threats-target-italys-schools-with-over-300-evacuated) reported that Italian authorities evacuated hundreds of schools following a bomb threat sent via email.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/international/article/2026/11/11/les-ecoles-italiennes-irlandaises-et-ecossaises-visees-par-des-alertes-a-la-bombe_6809033_3210.html) reported that thousands of schools in Italy, Ireland, and Scotland received threatening emails.

[ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/sito/videogallery/italia/2026/11/11/allarme-bomba-nelle-scuole-italiane-evacuazioni-a-roma-milano-liguria-e-venezia_7aa42fc1-bbfb-4057-a24a-320286389ef8.html) reported bomb alarms across Italian schools with evacuations in Rome, Milan, Liguria, and Venice.

[Novaya Gazeta Europe](https://novayagazeta.eu/articles/2026/11/11/tysiachi-shkol-v-italii-velikobritanii-i-irlandii-poluchili-soobshcheniia-s-ugrozami-vzryva-news) reported that thousands of schools in Italy, Great Britain, and Ireland received false bomb threat messages.

[Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/centenas-de-escolas-na-italia-irlanda-do-norte-e-escocia-recebem-ameacas-de-bomba-alunos-sao-retirados.shtml) reported that hundreds of schools across Italy received bomb threats by email.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/europa/amenazas-falsas-de-bomba-siguen-alertando-a-europa-italia-irlanda-y-reino-unido-desalojan-escuelas-ante-presuntas-amenazas-3600148) reported that false bomb threats also alerted schools in the UK and Ireland, prompting evacuations.

[ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/sito/notizie/cronaca/2026/11/11/allarme-bomba-in-oltre-6000-scuole-in-italia-evacuazioni-e-controlli.-meloni-grande_870b0024-72d2-4b15-bab5-0c74dcc1d653.html) reported that false bomb threats sent via an anonymous email led to evacuations and controls in over 6,000 schools in Italy.

[Times of Malta](https://timesofmalta.com/article/threatening-hoax-messages-sent-hundreds-schools-italy-uk-ireland.1136937) reported that threatening hoax messages were sent to hundreds of schools in Italy, the UK, and Ireland.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cwz0k79pr8z2o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that false warnings containing bomb threats were sent via email to schools in Rome, Naples, Vicenza, Florence, Pisa, Trieste, and other Italian cities.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/giorgia-meloni-italian-milan-antonio-tajani-rome-b3083120.html) reported that Italian authorities evacuated around 300 schools after receiving bomb threats via email.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/europe/article/3374103/over-300-italian-schools-evacuated-after-receiving-same-emailed-bomb-alert) reported that at least 300 schools in Italy were evacuated after receiving the same bomb alert message.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/bomb-threat-emails-trigger-evacuation-of-300-schools-across-italy-101794396853871.html) reported that bomb threat emails triggered the evacuation of 300 schools across Italy amid rising concerns over hybrid warfare threats.
[24 Chasa](https://www.24chasa.bg/mezhdunarodni/article/23911182) reported that around 300 schools in Italy received bomb threats sent via email.

[De Telegraaf](https://www.telegraaf.nl/buitenland/bommeldingen-op-honderden-scholen-in-italie-ierland-en-schotland/164394527.html) reported that hundreds of schools were evacuated in Italy, Ireland, and Scotland following anonymous bomb threat emails.

[Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/imran-khan-seeks-medical-treatment-for-himself-and-bushra-bibi-in-open-letter-to-top-judges/) reported that Imran Khan sought medical treatment in an open letter to the chief justice of Pakistan.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2640124/fact-check-viral-video-of-noreen-and-uzma-is-old-not-of-release-from-kot-lakhpat-jail) reported that a viral video claiming to show Noreen and Uzma's release from Kot Lakhpat jail is old and originated from an August 10, 2026 TikTok clip.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2639924/uzma-khan-noreen-niazi-released-after-50-days-in-detention) reported that Uzma Khan and Noreen Niazi were released after 50 days in detention, while PTI founder's sister Aleema Khan remains incarcerated at Kot Lakhpat Jail.

[Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2044037/imrans-sisters-uzma-noreen-released-from-jail-after-extended-detention-orders-withdrawn-says-lawyer) reported that Dr Uzma Khan and Noreen Niazi were released from Kot Lakhpat jail following the withdrawal of their extended detention orders.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2639913/fazal-chaudhry-rules-out-any-possibility-of-deal-leniency-for-pti-after-imrans-sisters-released) reported that Fazal Chaudhry ruled out any possibility of a deal or leniency for PTI and stated that rumours of backdoor channel talks are baseless.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/international/guerre-en-ukraine-deux-ponts-de-kiev-touches-par-des-frappes-russes-20261116) reported that the Ukrainian army attacked the Crimea bridge for the second consecutive day.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/international/live/2026/11/16/en-direct-guerre-en-ukraine-volodymyr-zelensky-affirme-que-la-coree-du-nord-livre-a-la-russie-chaque-mois-des-dizaines-de-missiles-balistiques-et-demande-aux-europeens-plus-de-missiles-pour-kiev_6810982_3210.html) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated North Korea supplies Russia with dozens of ballistic missiles monthly.

[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2219057), [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/16/8063141/), [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4185270-trump-on-restrictions-on-starlink-access-in-ukraine-i-havent-heard-that.html) reported that US President Donald Trump stated he has not heard about renewed restrictions on Starlink operations in Ukraine.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/denuncia-ucrania-problemas-con-sistema-starshield/) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy advocated for a meeting to send a strong signal to Russia that Ukraine will not be left without support.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/16/zelenskyy-urges-us-and-musk-to-restore-starlink-access-after-wave-of-russian-strikes) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy urged the US and Elon Musk to restore Starlink access following a wave of Russian strikes.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/16/spacex-blames-technical-issue-for-starlink-speed-restrictions-in-ukraine) reported that Denys Sienik stated SpaceX attributed Starlink speed restrictions in Ukraine to a technical issue.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/16/u-s-senators-demand-musk-preserve-records-on-starlink-restrictions-in-ukraine-ahead-of-planned-investigation) reported that US Democratic senators Jeanne Shaheen and Chris Coons demanded that SpaceX founder Elon Musk preserve all documents related to restrictions on Ukraine's use of Starlink.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/16/ukraine-war-briefing-energy-attacks-made-possible-by-continuing-starshield-restrictions-says-zelenskyy) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy reiterated that continued restrictions on Elon Musk's Starshield service have enabled Russian energy attacks.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/volodymyr-zelensky-says-starshield-restrictions-threaten-ukraine-s-energy-defenses-ahead-of-winter-russia-ukraine-war-us-ceasefire-101794791954503.html) reported that a Russian strike on Chornomorsk in Ukraine's Odesa region injured six people and damaged energy infrastructure.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/zelenskyy-urges-removal-of-starshield-limits-on-ukraine/a-79953300?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that Ukraine's government stated satellite internet throttling prevents Kyiv from intercepting Russian attacks.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/zelensky-reporta-nuevos-problemas-con-starshield-ucrania-pierde-capacidad-para-frenar-drones-rusos/) reported that Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated Starshield limitations weaken defenses around energy infrastructure and reduce Ukraine's ability to stop Russian drones.

[Military.com](https://www.military.com/zelenskyy-says-starshield-restrictions-threaten-ukraines-energy-defenses-ahead-of-winter) reported that Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated Starshield restrictions appear to have been imposed by SpaceX despite earlier assurances from US Secretary of State Marco Rubio.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4184851-many-drone-strikes-on-substations-get-through-due-to-starshield-speed-restrictions-zelensky.html) reported that President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated many Russian Shahed-type drone strikes on substations get through because speed restrictions remain in place for Starshield terminals along the frontline.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/15/8062949/) reported that President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated Starshield terminals cut off interceptor drones at 161 km/h, preventing them from catching jet-powered Shaheds.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/zelenskyy-says-russias-energy-attacks-helped-by-starshield-restrictions/article71704646.ece) reported that President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated Russia struck energy and railway infrastructure in eight regions overnight with many strikes penetrating defenses due to Starshield limits.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/15/zelenskyy-questions-spacex-over-reported-starshield-speed-restrictions) reported that President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated that Starshield speed restrictions directly affect Ukraine's ability to intercept Russian jet-powered attack drones.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/ukraine-russia-war-live-trump-putin-zelensky-starship-b3085121.html) reported that Kyiv stated restrictions on military-grade Starshield terminals have left Ukrainian forces less able to intercept Russian jet-powered drones.

[RFE/RL](https://www.rferl.org/a/ukraine-starshield-spacex-russia-missile-airstrikes/33898879.html) reported that Ukraine stated restrictions affecting its use of SpaceX’s Starshield satellite communications system remain widespread, hampering military drone defenses.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4184601-democrats-urge-musk-to-preserve-records-on-starlink-operations-in-ukraine-media.html), [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/14/8062840/) reported that Democratic senators on the Senate Foreign Relations Committee asked SpaceX CEO Elon Musk to preserve all documents and communications regarding Starlink operations and restrictions in Ukraine.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/democratic-us-senators-order-musk-to-preserve-records-on-ukraine-starlink-access/article71700765.ece), [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90093), [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/united-states-canada/article/3374425/musk-ordered-preserve-records-ukraines-starlink-access-democratic-us-senators) reported that Democratic U.S. senators ordered Elon Musk to preserve all records concerning SpaceX's restrictions on Ukraine's access to Starlink and Starshield systems by November 30.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/us-democrats-direct-musk-to-preserve-records-on-ukraines-starlink-restriction-wsj-reports/) reported that U.S. Democrats stated the October and November restrictions raise the possibility that vulnerabilities persist within systems used by the U.S. government.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/14/world/europe/ukraine-starshield-zelensky.html) reported that President Volodymyr Zelensky stated the system used to guide drones was being throttled over Russian-occupied territory.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/14/spacex-not-honest-slowing-starshield-elon-musk-volodymyr-zelenskyy) reported that Volodymyr Zelenskyy accused SpaceX of dishonesty regarding political reasons for slowing Starshield.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/ukraine-russia-war-live-trump-putin-zelensky-spacex-starshield-b3084909.html) reported that Moscow struck a hospital in central Kyiv.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/14/ukraine-war-briefing-zelenskyy-says-starshield-restrictions-continue-on-entire-front-line) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated Starshield restrictions continue on the entire front line.

[NPR World](https://www.npr.org/2026/11/12/nx-s1-6038809/us-envoys-meet-putin-russia-ukraine-war-talks), [CGTN](https://news.cgtn.com/news/2026-11-13/Putin-US-envoys-discuss-Ukraine-talks-as-positions-remain-divided-1S24FlpboIw/p.html?UTM_Source=cgtn&UTM_Medium=rss&UTM_Campaign=World) reported that US envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff met with Russian President Vladimir Putin in the Kremlin to discuss Ukraine talks.

[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90089) reported that President Volodymyr Zelensky stated US-operated Starshield restrictions remain in place, limiting Ukraine's ability to intercept Russian drones.

[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/89977) reported that US Senators Jeanne Shaheen and Thom Tillis demanded that the Trump administration and SpaceX immediately restore Ukraine's Starshield satellite access.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/13/8062691/) reported that a bipartisan group of 105 House members asked the administration and SpaceX to explain why Starshield was restricted.
[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2217901), a Russian state outlet, reported that Volodymyr Zelensky stated the US side offered no explanation for continued Starshield restrictions for Ukraine.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/ukraine-seeks-explanation-on-starshield-speed-restrictions-from-us/) reported that President Volodymyr Zelensky stated the Starshield speed restrictions applied over Russian-occupied territory and along the front line.

[Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/12/war-in-ukraine-putin-meets-with-envoys-from-the-us-president/) Africanews reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky warned European leaders against discussions between the United States and Russia.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/13/8062721/) Ukrainska Pravda reported that the Ukrainian president instructed officials to intensify contacts with the Pentagon and SpaceX as Starshield speed limits hinder military intelligence.

[The Moscow Times](https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/11/12/zelensky-says-starshield-speed-limited-again-a94241) reported that Volodymyr Zelensky stated that Starshield speed was limited again, which helps Russians carry out more accurate strikes.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/zelenskiy-says-starshield-speed-limited-again-hampering-ukraines-defences), [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/internationalrussia-ukraine-war/article-914688) reported that Volodymyr Zelenskiy said Ukrainian military units had recorded significant disruptions to Starshield satellite communications.

reports.text: [New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/17/world/africa/congo-ebola-community-transmission.html) reported that health teams in eastern Congo struggle against fear and mistrust that drive fatal delays in seeking medical care during the Ebola outbreak.

[AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611170097.html) reported that Africa's top public health agency warned that the Ebola outbreak in DR Congo remains out of control six months after it was declared.

[CGTN](https://newsaf.cgtn.com/news/2026-11-16/Africa-CDC-warns-of-immense-challenges-over-fragile-Ebola-gains-1S7pjUCAWQ0/p.html?UTM_Source=cgtn&UTM_Medium=rss&UTM_Campaign=World), a state-media outlet, reported that the Africa CDC warned of immense challenges over fragile Ebola gains as the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak spread to 67 health zones across eight provinces in the DR Congo with over 11,100 confirmed cases and more than 5,400 deaths.

[The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/ebola-who-declares-major-success-as-3000-recover-in-drc-early-outbreak-hotspots-contained/) reported that the World Health Organisation announced that 3,000 people recovered from Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and that early outbreak hotspots were contained.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/congo-ebola-outbreak-biggest-in-history-crisis-armed-violence-hunger-healthcare-system-101794807183530.html) reported that over 11,000 people were infected and 5,500 died in Congo's Ebola outbreak, while hunger, armed violence and mistrust hamper control efforts.

[The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/16/world/science-health/africa-ebola-outbreak-six-months/) reported that the Africa CDC stated the Ebola outbreak remains out of control due to problems including deadly attacks on health workers, unpaid staff, and a lack of resources.

[teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/african-union-warns-drc-ebola-could-cause-a-large-continental-outbreak/) reported that Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention Director-General Jean Kaseya warned that the humanitarian crisis and insecurity could cause a large continental Ebola outbreak.

[Daily Maverick](https://www.dailymaverick.co.za/article/2026-11-15-africa-cdc-says-ebola-outbreak-still-out-of-control-six-months-since-it-was/) reported that the Africa CDC stated the Ebola outbreak in Congo remains out of control six months after being declared.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/ebola-outbreak-kills-over-5400-in-dr-congo-as-conflict-hampers-response/) reported that over 5,400 people died in an Ebola outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

[Premium Times](https://www.premiumtimesng.com/health/health-news/925381-ebola-drc-cases-surpass-11000-insecurity-hampers-response.html) reported that according to the WHO, an armed attack in Cantine-Aloya killed 66 civilians including three health workers and looted three health facilities.

[RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/fr/podcasts/invit%C3%A9-international/20261115-ebola-l-absence-de-vaccin-explique-l-ampleur-de-cette-%C3%A9pid%C3%A9mie-dit-jean-kaseya-africa-cdc) reported that Africa CDC Director Jean Kaseya stated the lack of vaccines explains the scale of the epidemic.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/ebola-outbreak-remains-out-of-control-in-congo-six-months-into-response/article71704179.ece) reported that the Ebola outbreak in Congo is the deadliest of the country's 17 outbreaks and remains out of control six months into the response.

[Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/rest-of-world/congo-ebola-outbreak-claims-nearly-half-of-infected-as-cases-cross-11000/articleshow/135849071.cms) reported that the outbreak has resulted in over 11,000 cases with high fatalities and inadequate basic health measures.

[The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/uae/2026/11/15/ebola-outbreak-not-under-control-amid-dysfunctions-in-response-msf-warns/) reported that MSF warned the Ebola outbreak is not under control due to response dysfunctions.

[CBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMidEFVX3lxTE9GUWp5OWp5ZzEyOERaTnRzZ1kyQjRvOVkzR1FoNWxQUEwyY2NoM3JyOXB0LWJEQlBVVk92R2JST2VYaWQ0MjFzVm1tLUFvdHdJcXM2N3dac0JWd05namhJRmtuRFVzZFplTl9yNzF1RFp3RHZV?oc=5) reported that the UN hailed progress in the Ebola response while citing insecurity as the biggest challenge.

[RT](https://rt-english.com/africa/648807-drc-ebola-attacks-health-workers/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS), a state-media outlet, reported that Africa CDC stated deadly attacks on medical teams and facilities are disrupting efforts to contain the Ebola outbreak in DR Congo.

[The East African](https://www.theeastafrican.co.ke/tea/sustainability/ebola-insecurity-in-eastern-drc-blocks-response-5668350) reported that insecurity in eastern DRC is blocking the Ebola response as deaths pass 5,300.

[Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/africa/ebola-spreads-into-rural-areas-of-drc-as-violence-hampers-response) reported that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is spreading into remote rural communities.

[UN News](https://news.un.org/feed/view/en/story/2026/11/1168797), [AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611130262.html) reported that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to spread amid repeated attacks on civilians and frontline health workers.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cx98757ymm6zo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that medical staff are going unpaid, lack proper training, and are struggling with shortages of essential supplies according to MSF.

[RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/en/africa/20261112-funds-for-dr-congo-ebola-fight-not-reaching-front-french-medical-charity-msf-says) reported that six months into Congo's Ebola outbreak, the virus is still spreading out of control and large sums of international aid are not reaching the front line.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/microsoft-announces-service-restored-global-outage-over/) reported that Microsoft announced it has restored service to customers, drawing a close to a global outage.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/secteur/high-tech/outlook-teams-copilot-microsoft-annonce-la-fin-de-la-panne-mondiale-apres-plus-de-24-heures-de-perturbations-20261114) reported that the American giant announced the restoration of all its services following a global disruption.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/tech/microsoft-global-outage-down-nhs-b3084951.html) reported that Microsoft stated the disruption was due to a technical issue not related to cyber or AI agents.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/nov/14/microsoft-says-services-fully-restored-after-global-outage) reported that operations were restored to all customers and regions affected by one of the worst IT failures in years.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/technology/microsoft-says-consumer-products-fully-recovered-3725563) reported that Microsoft announced its consumer products and services fully recovered following a global outage affecting users in at least 70 countries.
[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/videos/cqzjr903n01po?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that a server outage affected Microsoft services including Teams, Outlook, and Copilot.

[Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/13/outlook-outage-hits-users-in-74-countries-as-microsoft-seeks-fix/) reported that an Outlook outage hit users in 74 countries while Microsoft sought alternative solutions.

[The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/business/2026/11/14/microsoft-outage-recovered/) reported that Microsoft stated server issues were behind the incident affecting consumer products services and ruled out AI as the cause.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/sci-tech/technology/microsoft-says-consumer-products-services-recovered-still-monitoring-enterprise-services/article71701075.ece) reported that the technology giant stated it was monitoring the backlog of email messages accrued during the event before considering enterprise services.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/technology/20261114-microsoft-says-consumer-products-fully-recovered-business-services-improving) reported that Microsoft confirmed all services across Teams, Outlook, Copilot, and other applications fully recovered, ending the global outage.

[Bangkok Post](https://www.bangkokpost.com/world/3353954/global-outage-hits-microsoft-outlook), [Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/business/economy/microsoft-struggles-as-outage-hits-outlook-teams-copilot-worldwide), [The Will (Nigeria)](https://thewillnews.com/microsoft-outage-hits-outlook-teams-worldwide-draws-130000-us-reports/) reported that a major global Microsoft outage knocked out Outlook, Teams, and the Copilot AI assistant for businesses and government agencies across multiple regions.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/microsoft-outage-services-across-all-previously-affected-environments-restored-microsoft-365-outage-teams-outlook-101794629719606.html) reported that Microsoft stated services across all previously affected environments have been restored.
[The Korea Herald](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10936977) reported that Microsoft issued an apology as a global outage affecting email and office software services stretched into a second day.

[HuffPost World](https://www.huffpost.com/entry/microsoft-outage_n_6af6ec51e4b065342906b58b), [Mail & Guardian](https://mg.co.za/news/tech/2026-11-13-microsoft-outage-disrupts-email-and-workplace-services-across-south-africa/), [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1581230/hours-long-microsoft-outage-disrupts-businesses-and-governments-globally/) reported that Microsoft stated it was seeing improvements for Outlook email and other Microsoft 365 services following a global outage that disrupted businesses and governments.

[The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/business/2026/11/14/microsoft-outage-stabilizing/) reported that Microsoft stated server issues were behind the incident and that a broader rollout of software fixes was stabilizing the system.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2026/nov/14/microsoft-deeply-sorry-for-global-disruption-that-could-have-billion-dollar-impact-on-australia) reported that Microsoft said it was deeply sorry for the global disruption and that services were being restored.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/global-outage-microsoft-blames-network-change-for-service-disruption/) reported that Microsoft blamed a network change for a global outage that disrupted its workplace services including Outlook and Teams.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/sci-tech/technology/microsoft-outlook-outage-status-microsoft-365-services-live-updates-november-14-2026/article71700692.ece) reported that Microsoft is testing fixes, rerouting traffic, and boosting server capacity.

[Bangkok Post](https://www.bangkokpost.com/world/3353954/global-outage-hits-microsoft-outlook) reported that Microsoft Outlook suffered a major global outage with tens of thousands of users struggling to access their email.

[Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/business/economy/microsoft-struggles-as-outage-hits-outlook-teams-copilot-worldwide) reported that the outage knocked out Outlook, Teams, and the Copilot AI assistant for businesses and government agencies worldwide.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/finanzas/que-fallo-en-la-caida-de-microsoft-las-claves-en-las-24-horas-de-trabajos-de-recuperacion-33118843) reported that Microsoft attributed the global service outage to a failure during a prior capacity expansion and stated that services are generally recovering.

[Bangkok Post](https://www.bangkokpost.com/world/3353954/global-outage-hits-microsoft-outlook), [Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/business/economy/microsoft-struggles-as-outage-hits-outlook-teams-copilot-worldwide) reported that Microsoft Outlook, Teams, and Copilot experienced a major global outage affecting users worldwide.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.com/pidgin/articles/cqx2e0pl80gro?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [Baltic News Network](https://bnn-news.com/world/outage-in-microsoft-services-affects-tens-of-thousands-of-users-9yx9g5w) reported that tens of thousands of users suffered disruptions to Microsoft's online services.

[NZ Herald](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/microsoft-outage-improvements-for-outlook-and-other-services-around-globe/PZYAOUDJKVAIRBOIGXZLIOYQMA/) reported that Microsoft achieved a broad recovery for Outlook and other global services, while visa processing, property settlements, and courts experienced disruptions.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/cartera/microsoft-atribuye-caida-global-de-sus-servicios-a-un-fallo-tecnico-anuncia-una-recuperacion-generalizada/) reported that Microsoft attributed the global service outage to a technical flaw and announced a general recovery while ruling out cybersecurity issues.
