reports.text: [Military.com](https://www.military.com/video/former-cia-expert-weighs-in-on-potential-meeting-between-president-trump-and-north-korea-s-kim) reported that U.S. President Donald Trump departed for Asia focusing on economic deals and trilateral nuclear talks involving Russia and China.

[El País](https://elpais.com/internacional/2026-11-17/un-sillon-de-orejas-en-la-pista-de-esqui-el-lider-norcoreano-kim-jong-un-se-deja-ver-con-su-hija-en-la-frontera-con-china.html) reported that North Korean leader Kim Jong-un was seen with his daughter at a tourist complex under construction in Samjiyon near the Chinese border.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/mundo/noticia/2026/11/17/trump-diz-que-kim-jong-un-gostaria-de-encontra-lo-na-china-durante-cupula-da-apec-mas-pequim-nega-ter-informacoes.ghtml) reported that Beijing denied having information regarding a potential meeting between Trump and Kim Jong-un.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261117-trump-arrives-in-philippines-to-kick-off-asia-trip) reported that US President Donald Trump arrived in the Philippines for a Southeast Asian summit.

[The Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/world/asia-pacific/2026/11/17/trump-to-begin-asia-trip-with-talks-in-the-philippines/) reported that the US president was in Manila for a Quad meeting involving the US, Japan, Australia, and India.

[The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/mena/2026/11/17/trump-to-discuss-iran-war-with-xi-and-putin-as-he-begins-asia-trip/) reported that Trump is set to discuss the Iran war with Xi and Putin as he begins his Asia trip.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/17/russia-erects-monument-in-kursk-to-north-korean-troops-who-fought-alongside-its-forces-against-ukraine) reported that a monument to North Korean soldiers was erected on Internatsionalnaya Street in Kursk.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/asean-leaders-gather-in-philippines-for-49th-summit-3725662) reported that leaders of ASEAN member states and partner delegations are meeting in Pasay City, Metro Manila, for the 49th ASEAN Summit and related summits.

[Hasht-e Subh](https://8am.media/eng/trump-attend-quad-summit-before-china-visit/) reported that U.S. President Donald Trump will participate in four-way talks with the Quad before traveling to China.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/trump-kicks-off-asia-tour-ahead-of-major-talks-with-putin-xi-in-china/live-79964719?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that US President Donald Trump began an Asia tour including a Quad meeting in Manila before traveling to China for meetings with Russian and Chinese counterparts.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/16/8063179/) reported that Russian President Vladimir Putin acknowledged the involvement of North Korean soldiers in battles in Kursk Oblast during a meeting with a senior North Korean official.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/putin-hails-north-korean-troops-role-in-kursk-at-kremlin-talks-3725661) reported that Russian President Vladimir Putin praised North Korean soldiers for helping retake parts of Russia's Kursk region during talks in the Kremlin with Jo Yong-won.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/asia-pacific/20261117-trump-asia-nuclear-talks-china-russia), [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/us/2026/11/17/trump-to-hold-nuclear-talks-with-xi-and-putin-with-kim-jong-un-possibly-joining/) reported that US President Donald Trump headed to Asia for economic talks and a planned trilateral meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin.

[CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/north-korea-kim-jong-un-inspects-samjiyon-tourism-zone-6556896), [Yonhap](https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261117002351315) reported that North Korean leader Kim Jong Un inspected the Samjiyon tourism zone reconstruction, including an airport, railway, and ski resort.

[Nation (Kenya)](https://nation.africa/kenya/news/world/spy-scandal-and-midterm-defeat-heat-up-trump-s-asia-visit-5672324), [Rappler (Philippines)](https://www.rappler.com/world/asia-pacific/spy-scandal-us-midterm-defeat-heat-up-trump-asia-visit/) reported that Donald Trump will visit Manila for meetings with regional leaders before traveling to Shenzhen for the APEC forum.

[TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2219253) reported that Kremlin Spokesman Dmitry Peskov stated Vladimir Putin, Xi Jinping, and Donald Trump would meet on November 19 at the APEC CEO Summit in Shenzhen.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2026/nov/17/asean-apec-summit-2026-live-updates-trump-xi-putin-meeting-schedule-latest-news) reported that world leaders gathered in Manila for the Apec and Asean summits amid protests over the Middle East war and the scrapping of the Pax Silica initiative.

[Nikkei Asia](https://asia.nikkei.com/politics/international-relations/apec-live-xi-jinping-to-open-ceo-summit-ahead-of-gathering-with-trump-putin) reported that Xi Jinping is scheduled to open the Apec CEO Summit ahead of a gathering with Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/16/trump-departs-for-asean-on-summit-with-xi-and-putin?traffic_source=rss) reported that Donald Trump is heading to the Philippines to speak at a meeting of ASEAN leaders in Manila.

[The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/17/asia-pacific/politics/kim-trump-apec-russia/) reported that Russia stated President Vladimir Putin met with Jo Yong Won, a close confidant of Kim Jong Un, in Moscow.

[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90299) reported that President Zelensky stated Russia receives dozens of North Korean ballistic missiles monthly and is expanding domestic missile production.
[Yonhap](https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261117002300315) reported that North Korean leader Kim Jong-un inspected a tourism development site near China ahead of Trump's Asia trip.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-915071), [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2044961/trump-says-he-might-meet-with-north-koreas-kim-jong-un-in-china), [Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/us/trump-hints-at-meeting-kim-jong-un-in-china-says-xi-could-play-role/articleshow/135896438.cms) reported that US President Donald Trump stated he may meet North Korean leader Kim Jong Un in China and plans to discuss Iran with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/china/diplomacy/article/3374622/groundbreaking-no-yalta-20-what-expect-when-xi-putin-and-trump-meet) reported that the upcoming trilateral meeting between the Chinese, Russian, and US leaders in Shenzhen has drawn comparisons to the 1945 Yalta Conference.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/china-says-xi-trump-putin-to-discuss-world-peace/a-79959570?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf), [Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/asia-pacific/xi-trump-putin-trilateral-summit-to-discuss-world-peace-beijing) reported that China stated Presidents Xi, Trump, and Putin will discuss world peace at a trilateral summit in Shenzhen.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/trump-shares-agenda-for-trilateral-meet-with-xi-jinping-vladimir-putin-china-us-russia-ukraine-iran-world-peace-101794841031257.html) reported that Donald Trump stated the November 19 meeting will cover denuclearisation and conflicts involving Iran and Ukraine.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/16/trump-says-he-could-meet-with-north-korean-leader-kim-jong-un-in-china), [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/us/article/3374640/trump-floats-kim-meeting-china-says-hell-discuss-ukraine-xi-and-putin) reported that US President Donald Trump stated he could meet with North Korean leader Kim Jong-un during his trip to China.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/cumbre-apec-reunion-trump-xi-putin-centra-atencion-quien-sale-ganando/) reported that leaders arrive at the APEC summit with different objectives, while the Kremlin views the trilateral meeting itself as a gain.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/asia-pacific/20261116-xi-trump-putin-discuss-world-peace-shenzhen-summit-china-says), [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2044928/china-says-xi-trump-putin-to-discuss-world-peace-in-trilateral-summit), [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/el-mundo/china-confirmo-una-cumbre-trilateral-entre-xi-jinping-trump-y-putin-en-shenzhen-nid16112026/) reported that China's foreign ministry stated Xi Jinping, Donald Trump, and Vladimir Putin will discuss world peace at a trilateral summit in Shenzhen.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/china-says-xi-jinping-donald-trump-vladimir-putin-to-discuss-world-peace-in-upcoming-apec-trilateral-shenzhen-101794815256369.html) reported that the trilateral meeting is expected to take place on Thursday on the sidelines of the APEC summit.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/beijing-hails-groundbreaking-significance-of-us-china-russia-summit-in-shenzhen/article71707480.ece) reported that US officials indicated the agenda includes the war in Ukraine and the situation in West Asia.

[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2218511), a state-media outlet, reported that Chinese Foreign Ministry Spokesperson Mao Ning stated the upcoming gathering will be the first-ever face-to-face meeting between the leaders of China, Russia, and the US.

[Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/washington-moscow-confirm-historic-trump-xi-and-putin-meeting/news) reported that Washington and Moscow confirmed plans for U.S. President Donald Trump, Russian President Vladimir Putin, and Chinese President Xi Jinping to meet on Thursday.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/russia-downs-over-100-drones-targeting-moscow-ahead-of-putin-s-meeting-with-trump-xi-101794801168344.html) reported that Moscow Mayor Sergey Sobyanin stated Russian air defenses intercepted about 139 drones targeting Moscow.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mexico/sheinbaum-llega-a-china-para-su-primera-cumbre-de-la-apec-sostendra-reunion-con-xi-jinping-33154883) reported that Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum arrived in China for her first APEC summit and a scheduled meeting with Xi Jinping.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/china-confirma-reunion-entre-xi-trump-y-putin-este-jueves-en-shenzhen-33153944) reported that China confirmed the APEC summit will be held on November 18 and 19 in Shenzhen, hosting leaders from 21 economies.

[Folha de S.Paulo](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/mundo/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mundo/2026/11/china-confirma-cupula-trilateral-de-xi-com-trump-e-putin-na-quinta-19.shtml) reported that Beijing confirmed on Sunday night that Chinese leader Xi Jinping will meet with Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin.

[Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/estados-unidos/china-confirma-cumbre-trilateral-de-xi-jinping-con-trump-y-putin-el-19-de-noviembre_0_s7fxaBusp3.html) reported that China confirmed that the leaders of China, Russia, and the United States will hold a trilateral summit in Shenzhen on November 19 during the APEC summit.

[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2219269), a Russian state outlet, reported that Vice President JD Vance stated that President Donald Trump will get the country out of the conflict with great results.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/jd-vance-says-donald-trump-will-end-iran-war-before-2028-rules-out-forever-war-as-third-us-aircraft-carrier-arrives-in-middle-east-101794879757205.html) reported that JD Vance stated Trump will not let the Iran war become a forever war as a third US aircraft carrier reaches the Middle East.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/middle-east/article/3374663/third-us-aircraft-carrier-reaches-middle-east-trump-weighs-iran-options) reported that US Central Command stated in a social media post that a third American aircraft carrier reached the Middle East.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/iran-war-jd-vance-trump-aircraft-carrier-middle-east-b3085980.html) reported that Vice President JD Vance stated Iran will not be a 'forever war' as the USS Theodore Roosevelt and its strike force arrived in the Middle East.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2640643/vance-undecided-on-2028-presidential-run-report), [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/vance-undecided-on-2028-presidential-run-axios-reports-3725637) reported that US Vice President JD Vance is undecided about a 2028 presidential run.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/uss-theodore-roosevelt-brings-us-carriers-in-middle-east-to-three-3725641), [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261116-us-increases-carrier-presence-in-middle-east-to-3-as-uss-theodore-roosevelt-arrives-in-region-report/) reported that the USS Theodore Roosevelt entered the US Central Command area, increasing the number of US carrier strike groups in the region to three.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiogFBVV95cUxNYmZiWEcxLU9Xck9JR2h3VDIwa1VETmRCam5zQm1BWmhNcGhZS0pBdi1BZGRZLXhZT3VmUG5wYld2N1gydV8teDVFc0UtNVljakJ5Q1JNRkRUb0dqRDRfX0p4QVBGdkZRaWd3Y1J6aFdZWlZhVGt5LWxzcG9mRHVPYnBXZFFrSXVqYXkxd081YzdlNTN1T05yVTgwZUIzSUhQQWc?oc=5), [The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/third-american-aircraft-carrier-arrives-in-west-asia-as-trump-keeps-options-open-in-iran-war/article71709128.ece) reported that the USS Theodore Roosevelt arrived in the Middle East, bringing the total number of US aircraft carriers in the region to three.

[Military.com](https://www.military.com/third-us-aircraft-carrier-arrives-in-the-middle-east-as-trump-keeps-options-open-in-the-iran-war) reported that the flotilla in the Arabian Sea includes 13 destroyers, two cruisers, and a littoral combat ship.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/16/uss-roosevelt-arrives-in-middle-east-is-the-us-iran-war-about-to-resume?traffic_source=rss) reported that the aircraft carrier USS Roosevelt joined two others operating in the US Central Command area of responsibility.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/16/third-us-aircraft-carrier-arrives-in-middle-east-amid-tensions-with-iran?traffic_source=rss), [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/third-us-aircraft-carrier-arrives-iran-says-tankers-hit-mins) reported that a third US aircraft carrier, the USS Theodore Roosevelt, arrived in the Middle East amid tensions with Iran.

[The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/gulf/2026/11/16/iran-escalates-threats-against-us-forces-and-gulf-states-as-third-american-carrier-arrives/) reported that Iran escalated threats against US forces and Gulf states as the carrier arrived.

[Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/middle-east-news/2026-11-16/ty-article/reports-third-u-s-aircraft-carrier-deployed-to-middle-east/000001a1-e243-da30-a7fb-faff85dc0000) reported that the deployment of a third U.S. aircraft carrier would bring the American military presence in the Middle East to its highest level since April.

reports.text: [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/estados-unidos/justicia-y-comercio-de-eeuu-investigan-a-megaspeed-por-venta-a-china-de-chips-restringidos_0_ihQtnQZ8QI.html) reported that the US Department of Justice and Commerce are investigating Megaspeed over the sale of restricted chips to China.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/us-blocks-chinas-remote-access-to-ai-chips-after-nvidia-scandal-china-slams-move/article71711869.ece) reported that Nvidia's provision of chips to companies running data centres in Southeast Asia came under the spotlight amid questions surrounding founder Jensen Huang.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cmn504nq5033o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/us-investigates-singapore-firm-over-suspected-nvidia-chip-smuggling/) reported that the US government is investigating Nvidia partner Megaspeed over suspected export rule violations and shipments of high-end AI chips to China.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/nvidia-warns-chip-buyers-of-legal-risks-china-ai-access-report-cnbc-artificial-intelligence-101794902005379.html) reported that Nvidia warned chip buyers of legal risks tied to China AI access, and noted that the RASA bill would give the US Commerce Department tools to stop Chinese firms from renting overseas data centers.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2640794/us-confirms-probing-megaspeed-over-chip-exports), [Punch](https://punchng.com/us-confirms-probing-singapore-based-firm-over-chip-exports/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web), [South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/tech/tech-war/article/3374742/us-details-criminal-probe-nvidia-customer-megaspeed-over-potential-chip-diversion) reported that the US government confirmed an investigation into Singapore-based cloud firm and Nvidia customer Megaspeed over chip exports and potential diversion.
[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-915127) reported that US authorities began investigating Megaspeed in 2024 for suspected export violations.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/us-to-close-ai-chip-loophole-after-nvidia-scandal/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the United States announced tougher export controls on AI chips after a scandal involving Nvidia co-founder Jensen Huang.

[Nikkei Asia](https://asia.nikkei.com/business/markets/us-chip-curbs-nvidia-uncertainty-weigh-on-asian-data-center-stocks), [The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/business/2026/11/17/tech/asia-data-center-chip-trump/) reported that Asian data center stocks and operators face pressure as U.S. chip curbs require government licenses to purchase advanced AI chips from Nvidia and other American manufacturers.

[Rappler (Philippines)](https://www.rappler.com/technology/us-curb-china-access-ai-chips/) reported that the US Commerce Department worked to crack down on overseas data centers and chip smuggling to curb China's access to AI chips.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2026/11/17/us-moves-to-block-chinas-remote-access-to-ai-chips-amid-nvidia-scandal?traffic_source=rss) reported that the Trump administration introduced export licence requirements for Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia, Singapore, and Brazil.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/week-asia/economics/article/3374665/singapore-seeks-us-talks-ai-chip-export-rules-amid-nvidia-fallout-megaspeed-probe) reported that Singapore has been engaging with the United States to explore ways to facilitate trusted access for local firms after a new measure was announced.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/sci-tech/technology/singapore-seeks-trusted-access-to-ai-chips-after-new-us-curbs/article71710285.ece) reported that Singapore is at the center of controversy as cloud computing firm Megaspeed is suspected of helping Chinese firms circumvent US export controls.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-tightens-ai-chip-export-restrictions-ahead-of-trumps-visit-to-china-101794877777325.html) reported that the US tightening of AI chip export restrictions comes amid divisions within the Trump administration over regulating overseas sales of advanced American chips, especially those made by Nvidia.

[The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/business/energy/2026/11/16/china-critical-minerals-latin-america/) reported that China's rare earth curbs have placed a new emphasis on Latin American investment.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirAFBVV95cUxONGJmTGhQa3FRRDZtX3BqVk9SNlc1aHZ1QXZiUXdHMmlmZmdyUjFKS0hrREM1OFRrVDVjUGpSWnZfVTEtdlozVHVDc0h5Rld1cGVKQTFGYzVZOGJMdDNheWdEcFRhakxCVW1xcnQ3VHBzS2lRdWNPTGdtUkNxNVRnT1JUVzVKNzRXUlNuLUtBOVk2REZnZjMySER5NmhfNTliRjZsZ3B5TElrN0JU?oc=5) reported that the Trump administration moved to block China from indirect access to American AI technology.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/middle-east-allies-sign-us-ai-pact-nvidia-crisis-clouds-chip-race) reported that Israel, the UAE, and Qatar are deepening regional cooperation with Washington as the Trump administration seeks to blunt China's edge in technology.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisgFBVV95cUxNajk2S3gxMEdjVExKMzV3QmljQnVtYk1fN2Z2LUdldndlNjlkbVdrc2hhbnkzdFNtSFE0UzNUbjFYT1JQY2ZJRlpEalZXeW5XcDZCYW5NWjhCVUFqQldQTmg0ZUVfY1lYTHZnTHdNTTBqem12eC0zNE1NVVgyaVcxMi10WmdwVnlCUDNFY2ZRdnVrdURLTDctZTY2VkRLaWZ0d1A1VmFrd1pYbnl2NVhhV3Fn?oc=5), [El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/trump-compro-acciones-de-nvidia-antes-de-relajar-ventas-de-chips-a-china-segun-the-washington-post-previo-a-cambio-sobre-exportaciones/) reported that The Washington Post stated Donald Trump's stake in Nvidia grew to as much as $62 million prior to changes on chip exports.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/16/us/politics/trump-china-ai-chip-loophole.html) reported that the Trump administration moved to close an AI chip loophole regarding sales to foreign data centers serving Chinese companies.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/tech/article/3374639/us-tightens-ai-chip-export-curbs-close-chinas-overseas-data-centre-loophole) reported that the US Bureau of Industry and Security announced new restrictions on Chinese companies' remote access to advanced US artificial intelligence chips.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/trump-administration-tightens-ai-chip-export-rules-to-restrict-chinas-access-to-nvidia-chips-101794844441729.html) reported that the Trump administration tightened AI chip export rules for five countries to prevent China from accessing advanced Nvidia chips through overseas data centres.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/eu-insta-a-nvidia-a-aclarar-si-eludio-restricciones-de-exportacion-de-chips-a-china-33148586), [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/estados-unidos/eeuu-insta-a-nvidia-a-aclarar-si-eludio-restricciones-de-exportaciones-de-chips-a-china_0_AE9CGxXJeX.html) reported that US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent urged Nvidia to clarify within 10 days whether it evaded export restrictions on chips to China and to answer regarding the internal investigation into Jensen Huang.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/us-lawmakers-push-tougher-ai-chip-export-curbs-on-china-after-nvidia-jensen-huang-scandal-101794757202582.html) reported that US lawmakers are pushing for tougher AI chip export curbs on China following the Nvidia scandal.

[The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/business/2026/11/14/companies/nvidia-crisis-scrutiny-agency/) reported that the US Congress is demanding answers about whether the Bureau of Industry and Security did enough to keep Nvidia's AI processors out of China's hands.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/economy/global-economy/article/3374328/china-could-tighten-rare-earths-exports-if-us-escalates-chip-curbs-over-nvidia-analysts) reported that Chinese analysts stated China could retaliate with tighter rare earth export controls if Washington further restricts chip sales following the Nvidia saga.

[Daily Maverick](https://www.dailymaverick.co.za/article/2026-11-13-chinas-access-to-some-nvidia-chips-in-doubt-as-curbs-gain-traction-in-us/) reported that Chinese AI shares tumbled as investors worried that Jensen Huang's departure as Nvidia CEO could further restrict Chinese access to advanced US chips.

[The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/13/world/china-access-nvidia-chips-doubt/) reported that China's access to advanced Nvidia chips is in doubt as curbs gain traction in the U.S. Congress.

narratives.label: Serbia National Assembly consultations

reports.text: [Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/ex-yu/Skupstina-Srbije-bira-predsjednika-U-trci-dva-kandidata/992845) reported that two proposals were submitted for the president of the National Assembly of Serbia.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/konstituisanjem-skupstine-poceo-da-tece-rok-od-90-dana-za-izbor-nove-vlade-srbije/4f2sb64) reported that the 90-day legal deadline to form a new government in Serbia began with the constitution of the new National Assembly.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/vucic-se-obraca-u-skupstini-srbije-jovo-bakic-negoduje/j4mp6l7) reported that Aleksandar Vučić addressed the constitutive session of the National Assembly of Serbia.

[Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/regija/aleksandar-cupic-predlozen-za-novog-predsjednika-skupstine-srbije-preuzet-ce-i-ulogu-vd-predsjednika-drzave/261117138) reported that the Studentska lista nominated Aleksandar Čupić for president of the National Assembly of Serbia, and he stated he was ready to take on the role of acting head of state.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/saznajemo-jovo-bakic-sef-poslanicke-grupe-studentske-liste/0tn5tb9) reported that Jovo Bakić was chosen as the head of the Studentska lista parliamentary group.

[Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/region/1088667/stojan-radenovic-je-kandidat-sns-a-za-predsjednika-skupstine-srbije) reported that Stojan Radenović is the SNS candidate for president of the National Assembly of Serbia.

[Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/region/1088574/pocela-konstituirajuca-sjednica-skupstine-srbije-studentska-lista-sa-140-mandata-preuzima-vecinu), [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/skupstina-srbije-prenos-uzivo-studentska-lista-i-sns-prvi-put-oci-u-oci/jzw7gwg) reported that the constitutive session of the National Assembly of Serbia began with Studentska lista taking 140 mandates to form a majority, and deputies taking the oath.

[Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/regija/u-srbiji-se-danas-bira-novi-predsjednik-skupstine-on-ce-postati-i-vd-predsjednika-drzave-dva-imena-u-igri/261117004) reported that the first session of the 15th National Assembly of Serbia begins with confirming the mandates of deputies and electing the president and vice-presidents of the assembly.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/pristalice-studentskog-pokreta-okupile-se-u-pionirskom-parku-pred-sednicu-skupstine/16y8h3e) reported that supporters of the student movement gathered in Pionirski park to follow Studentska lista candidates before they went to the National Assembly for the constitutive session.

[Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/region/1088545/uz-ovacije-i-posebnu-pjesmu-poslanici-studentske-liste-iz-pionirskog-parka-ulaze-skupstinu) reported that Studentska lista deputies entered the National Assembly from Pionirski park after mandate confirmation and taking the oath.

[Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/ex-yu/Vucic-Niko-me-nije-zvao-sam-sam-sprecio-gradjanski-rat-VIDEO/992700) reported that Aleksandar Vučić rejected claims that he was under European Union pressure and stated he prevented civil war on his own.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/vucic-otkrio-da-li-ga-je-neko-zvao-u-izbornoj-noci/cx05g9p) reported that SNS leader Aleksandar Vučić denied allegations that any diplomat called him on election night to prevent violence.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/biznis/privreda/kako-funkcionisu-razvojne-banke-i-sta-predlaze-studentska-lista-za-srbiju/vr5n9ec) reported that Studentska lista has proposed creating a development bank for Serbia through the transformation of the Development Fund and the Agency for Export Insurance and Financing.

[Klix](https://www.klix.ba/vijesti/regija/studentska-lista-najavila-reviziju-ugovora-o-nabavci-oruzja-za-vojsku-srbije-i-vece-plate/261116178) reported that Studentska lista representative Luka Ponorac stated all active procurement contracts for the Serbian Armed Forces will be reviewed.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/dva-imena-sa-studentske-liste-u-trci-za-novog-predsednika-skupstine-srbije/pbkg9lk) reported that two names from Studentska lista are mentioned as potential candidates for the president of the parliament ahead of the constitutive session of the National Assembly.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/sutra-konstitutivna-sednica-skupstine-srbije-ovo-je-dnevni-red/5ls62nq) reported that the constitutive session of the new convocation of the National Assembly of Serbia will be held tomorrow to confirm mandates and elect parliamentary leadership.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/oliver-toskovic-sa-studentske-liste-otkrio-da-imaju-ime-predsednika-skupstine/keqptp7) reported that Oliver Tošković stated personnel solutions exist and the assembly expects to receive a speaker.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/biznis/privreda/studentska-lista-subvencije-na-vreme-zabrana-otkupa-ispod-cene-proizvodnje/k43t201) reported that the Students' List program proposed changing agricultural financing methods, stricter rules for buyers and warehouse operators, and protecting producers.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/sta-je-plan-studentske-liste-za-odnos-sa-srbima-u-regionu/jthbrfd) reported that the Students' List program for Serbs in the region outlines preserving the constitutional status and powers of Republika Srpska.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/radenovic-ako-bi-bilo-tajno-glasanje-ubedljivo-bih-pobedio-za-predsednika-skupstine/22d7jgb) reported that Stojan Radenovic stated he believes he would win convincingly if the vote for parliamentary speaker were held by secret ballot.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/baucal-sa-studentske-liste-ne-zeli-da-ustupi-mesto-potpredsednika-skupstine-sns-u/vr3qh32) reported that Students' List candidate Aleksandar Baucal stated that opposition representatives should be offered the position of vice president in accordance with democratic tradition in Serbia.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/biznis/nekretnine/planovi-studentske-liste-za-generalstab/xxf4t35) reported that the outgoing Serbian Government decided three months ago to cancel the contract with Jared Kushner's company regarding the Generalstaff building.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/biznis/vesti/porez-na-plate-i-imovinu-ukidaju-se-subvencije-sta-studentska-lista-predlaze-za/0df3lr7) reported that the Students' List proposed lower labor taxes, higher taxes on large property and inheritances, the abolition of job-creation subsidies for foreign investors, and the establishment of a Serbian Development Bank.

[Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/ex-yu/Vucic-izabran-za-sefa-poslanicke-grupe-u-Skupstini-Srbije/992424), [Dnevni Avaz](https://avaz.ba/vijesti/region/1087991/vucic-preuzima-novu-funkciju-u-skupstini-srbije-najavio-i-koga-ce-predloziti-za-predsjednika-parlamenta) reported that Aleksandar Vucic announced he was elected head of the parliamentary group in the National Assembly of Serbia.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/prvi-susret-oci-u-oci-studentske-liste-i-sns-nakon-izbora-foto/s98jwdg) reported that representatives of electoral lists met at the National Assembly for consultations ahead of the constituent session, where Ana Brnabić stated that democratic practice has concluded and the Students' List presented its leadership selection plan.

[Nezavisne Novine](https://www.nezavisne.com/novosti/ex-yu/Oglasili-se-Studentska-lista-Brnabic-i-Jovanov-Poznati-detalji-konsultacija/992272), [Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/politika/studentska-lista-o-konsultacijama-u-skupstini-srbije-svi-smo-se-slozili-smo-se/6s4lgp3) reported that representatives of the Students' List, Ana Brnabić, and Milenkov attended consultations in the National Assembly of Serbia regarding the upcoming constituent session.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/atiku-thanks-yobe-people-for-warm-campaign-reception/), [This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/16/atiku-thanks-yobe-residents-for-massive-welcome-commends-gov-for-fair-campaign-ground/) reported that former Vice President Atiku Abubakar thanked the people of Potiskum and Yobe State for the reception accorded to his campaign team.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMingFBVV95cUxQUWI3OGxfWTRxVTVMY3diaEZFMWZmRlZGYnZ0dnJKSzZqYjN4U2xmMTIyMVJ4U3QxcnI1VEVSblhZck40NTZCaGVhamRFQ2l0VDZnNXhYLTRTRUNRSDNqVW9FQ2pHZXRfQzNQOUEzRG9vaU82Q094M2J0eGo4T3N3QWdadEVmQ3BJR3FPRGNHUXdmcWpWcWItVl9LVERRUQ?oc=5) reported that Cape Verde voted in an election with emigration in focus.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipgFBVV95cUxNNEZaaVg2di1CeGcyQlpLZjBmeHpaYXQ5YTRGMk8xM0NyZkVtSmFuX2d1ckFqOExOMVhmbzk4U0lEYk96VVd3OENPVTd6bERTNTJDQl8tR3ZxS2JZX2xER3JfSHdCRF9JQkxLMm11bnFTYmN1LUN4R3lfRy15MmJsSS04VUEzX183SDFYSVFDaHJIaTJFT1VQeHljX2FFbkYwV0hmY1VB?oc=5) reported that Cape Verde voted in an election that could yield its first woman president since independence in 1975.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/15/cape-verde-heads-to-the-polls-in-presidential-election), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/15/polls-open-in-cape-verde-in-race-with-first-female-presidential-candidate?traffic_source=rss) reported that voters in Cape Verde went to the polls for a presidential election where incumbent President José Maria Neves faces opposition candidates including Joana Rosa.

reports.text: [teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/eisenkot-netanyahu-must-leave-office/) reported that Israeli opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot demanded Benjamin Netanyahu's immediate departure and an investigation into allegations that his aides were involved in a school scheme.

[Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-security/2026-11-17/ty-article/.premium/eisenkot-may-have-to-oust-security-chiefs-over-netanyahus-stolen-election-drive/000001a1-e623-d3ad-a5e3-e7fb6aa10000) reported that reports claimed the prime minister's office pushed allegations that Arab parties stole the vote and the Shin Bet chief sought to wiretap Joint List lawmakers.

[Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2045063/israeli-leaders-slam-netanyahus-attempted-election-coup) reported that Israeli leaders criticized Benjamin Netanyahu over reports that his office tried to frame Arab-Israeli party members ahead of polls.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/16/is-israels-opposition-less-right-wing-than-netanyahu?traffic_source=rss) reported that an Israeli government without Prime Minister Netanyahu may be close, but a government without his politics is far less certain.

[The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/joint-list-calls-criminal-probe-netanyahu-after-expose) reported that the Joint List called for a criminal probe into caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu following allegations of attempting to falsely incriminate Arab officials ahead of the election.

[ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-17/benjamin-netanyahu-gadi-eisenkot-call-for-investigation/107392590) reported that Gadi Eisenkot demanded an investigation into the Israeli Prime Minister's Office over election fraud claims.

[Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261116-lapid-accuses-netanyahu-of-attempted-coup-through-targeting-arab-parties-in-israel/) reported that Israeli opposition figure Yair Lapid accused caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of seeking to stage an attempted coup by targeting Arab parties.

[Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/16/israel-party-chiefs-say-netanyahus-election-fraud-claims-a-coup-attempt/) reported that party chiefs stated Netanyahu's election fraud claims were a coup attempt, while his Likud party denied the claims.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/turkiye/netanyahu-allies-open-to-unity-government-without-ben-gvirs-party-3725611), [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261116-netanyahu-allies-open-door-to-unity-government-without-ben-gvirs-party-report/) reported that associates of caretaker Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu told Gadi Eisenkot's team that Likud would accept a unity government without Itamar Ben-Gvir's party.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/tibi-seeks-criminal-probe-of-netanyahu-over-alleged-election-interference-3725628) reported that Ahmad Tibi called for an immediate police probe into Netanyahu and his office following a Channel 12 investigation.

[The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/mena/2026/11/16/eisenkot-calls-for-inquiry-into-alleged-netanyahu-role-in-election-day-arrests-of-arab-israeli-activists/), [Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/eisenkot-calls-for-probe-into-alleged-netanyahu-election-interference-3725614), [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261116-eisenkot-says-netanyahu-threatens-democracy-pledges-probe-into-pms-office-role-in-election/) reported that opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot called for an inquiry into Benjamin Netanyahu's alleged role in election-day arrests of Arab Israeli activists.

[Siempre!](https://www.siempre.mx/2026/11/la-corrupcion-en-el-ine-morena-y-su-prisa-por-deslindarse-de-taddei/) reported that presidential approval in Mexico has suffered from wear according to Polls MX data.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/mundo/oposicion-israeli-pide-investigar-presunta-manipulacion-electoral-por-oficina-de-netanyahu-33152148), [La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/el-mundo/eisenkot-acuso-a-netanyahu-de-amenazar-la-democracia-y-pidio-investigar-una-presunta-maniobra-nid15112026/) reported that Israeli opposition figures, including Eisenkot, called for an investigation into alleged electoral manipulation by Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's office regarding the arrest of Arab activists during elections.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/nacion/pan-exige-investigar-presuntas-irregularidades-en-gestion-de-taddei-pide-un-ine-independiente-de-morena/) reported that the PAN party in Mexico presented a factual complaint to the FGR to investigate potential offenses related to public fund management under Taddei.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/internacional/oficina-netanyahu-planeo-detener-miembros-partidos-arabes-acusarlos-falsamente-fraude-electoral_202611166afabd97ea8d89799786fb0c.html) reported that a popular Israeli media outlet published information regarding a plan by Netanyahu's office to arrest Arab party members to falsely accuse them of electoral fraud.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/politics-and-diplomacy/article-914926) reported that Naftali Bennett urged Gadi Eisenkot's bloc to pressure Haredi parties rather than beg them to join the government.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/internacional/netanyahu-ofrece-gobierno-unidad-iran-partidos-arabes-eisenkot-tacha-farol_202611146af8b8ccd3bddc0868b1f4c7.html) reported that Israeli opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot dismissed Benjamin Netanyahu's offer of a unity government without Arab parties as a bluff.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/netanyahu-pide-a-eisenkot-un-gobierno-de-unidad-ante-iran-que-excluya-a-los-arabes-llama-a-negociar-sin-condiciones/) reported that Benjamin Netanyahu asked Gadi Eisenkot to join a unity government that excludes Arab parties, while the opposition leader dismissed the offer as a bluff.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/15/audio-new-orleans-mississippi-river-cruise-tanker-crash) reported that federal safety investigators recovered audio from the crash and noted the tank vessel suffered sudden steering failure two minutes before the collision.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/new-orleans-boat-crash-captain-b3085338.html) reported that Captain Leonard Stewart of the American Heritage called for help as his ship capsized in the Mississippi River with nearly 200 passengers and crew members.
[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-914927) reported that the Port of New Orleans sued the Chinese-owned tanker Atlantic Asphalt for over $1 million in damages.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cwe89y2r5j20o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that the New Orleans port filed a $1m lawsuit requesting that the tanker involved in the collision be seized and sold.

reports.text: [Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/turkiye/cop31-draws-record-crowds-as-summit-enters-final-days/news) reported that the UN Climate Change Conference in Antalya attracted over 102,000 registered participants to its Blue Zone as it entered its final days.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/faster-fossil-fuels-phase-out-120bn-aid-in-cop31-draft-101794884329232.html) reported that the COP31 draft included a faster fossil fuels phase-out and $120 billion in aid.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/environment/2026/nov/16/cop31-draft-text-draw-out-parties-find-agreement-president-talks-says) reported that the president of the COP31 talks stated that the draft text of a possible final outcome was an attempt to draw out parties to find agreement.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/climate-change/cop31-energy-fossil-fuels-text-deal-turkey-b3085834.html) reported that the first week of the UN climate conference in Antalya faced logistical problems and transport chaos.

[This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/16/cop31-first-week-records-26bn-green-investment-deals-10bn-climate-finance-pledges/) reported that the first week of COP31 ended with commitments exceeding $26 billion in green investment deals and $10 billion in climate finance pledges.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/cop31-draft-urges-tripling-adaptation-finance-to-120b-by-2035-3725650), [Punch](https://punchng.com/cop31-draft-targets-120bn-annual-adaptation-finance-by-2035/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that the COP31 draft text proposed raising annual climate adaptation finance for developing countries to at least $120 billion by 2035 and urged an immediate transition away from fossil fuels.

[This Day](https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/16/cop31-launches-ai-pledge-green-industrialisation-drive-to-advance-climate-action/) reported that the COP31 Presidency launched an artificial intelligence pledge and green industrialization drive.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/cop31-draft-deal-calls-for-immediate-shift-away-from-fossil-fuels/a-79960705?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf), [Politico](https://www.politico.eu/article/draft-cop31-text-suggests-immediate-fossil-fuel-transition/?utm_source=RSS_Feed&utm_medium=RSS&utm_campaign=RSS_Syndication) reported that a draft deal at the COP31 UN climate talks calls for an immediate shift away from fossil fuels.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/cop31-draft-deal-calls-for-immediate-shift-away-from-fossil-fuels/a-79960705?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that the preliminary agreement includes at least $120 billion to help countries adapt.

[RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/2026/1113/1599060-climate-cop-fossil-fuels/) reported that UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres called for an immediate and drastic reduction in greenhouse gas emissions as divisions over fossil fuels dominated COP31.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/13/climate/cop31-turkey-ipcc-climate-report.html), [RFI](https://www.rfi.fr/en/international/20261113-eu-vows-to-defend-climate-science-as-cop31-talks-expose-global-divisions) reported that fossil fuel-dependent countries attempted to delay scientific climate assessments at the COP31 summit in Turkey, prompting the European Union to pledge to defend climate science.

[Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/politics/erdogan-pushes-climate-pledges-into-action-as-cop31-talks-advance/news) reported that Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan called for turning global climate commitments into concrete results as the COP31 Leaders' Summit concluded in Antalya.

[Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2044380/cop31-must-deliver-climate-justice-not-empty-pledges-says-sherry) reported that Senator Sherry Rehman called for COP31 in Antalya to deliver a credible, accessible, and equitable climate financing framework.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/un-climate-chief-urges-speed-cop31-confronts-fossil-fuel-divide) reported that the UN's top climate official urged negotiators at the COP31 conference in Turkey to speed up efforts as talks confront a fossil fuel divide.

[The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/un-climate-chief-urges-speed-cop31-confronts-fossil-fuel-divide) reported that UN climate talks at COP31 face pressure to reach a deal on fossil fuels, electrification, and global warming.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/cop31-talks-face-early-friction-over-future-fossil-fuels), [Jowhar](https://jowhar.com/fossil-fuels-take-center-stage-at-cop31-as-leaders-urge-emissions-cuts/) reported that COP31 climate talks in Antalya faced friction over fossil fuels as UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres urged drastic emissions cuts.

[Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/araghchi-arrives-in-pakistan-set-to-visit-oman-on-tuesday/) reported that Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi arrived in Pakistan to participate in the 30th session of the Economic Cooperation Organization.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/iran-foreign-minister-abbas-aragchi-to-visit-muscat-hold-talks-with-omani-counterpart-101794748995709.html) reported that Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi will hold talks with his Omani counterpart during a visit to Muscat on Tuesday.
[IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86322588/Araghchi-set-to-visit-Pakistan-and-Oman-Foreign-Ministry) reported that Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi will visit Pakistan and Oman.
[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/middle-east/iran-news/article-914945) reported that Iranian state news agency IRNA announced Araghchi's upcoming visit to Oman.

[Hasht-e Subh](https://8am.media/eng/iran-accuses-us-violating-international-law/) reported that Gholam-Hossein Darzi, Iran's representative to the United Nations, accused the United States of violating international law and the United Nations Charter.

reports.text: [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/aden-houthis-iran-strait-of-hormuz-yemen-b3086340.html) reported that Saudi-backed forces in Yemen deployed additional troops near the port city of Aden to counter a potential Houthi rebel advance.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261117-saudi-arabia-replaces-military-commander-after-yemen-setbacks) reported that Saudi Arabia replaced its military commander overseeing the coalition against the Houthis following setbacks.

[Mehr News](https://en.mehrnews.com/news/249487/Aramco-is-our-prime-target-in-Saudi-Arabia-Yemeni-military) reported that the Yemeni military warned that Saudi oil giant Aramco and its facilities are prime targets for attacks.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/17/yemen-army-reports-661-attacks-on-houthis-amid-houthi-push-towards-aden?traffic_source=rss) reported that Yemen's army recorded 661 attacks by Houthi forces and 173 Houthi fighters killed or wounded as government forces repositioned to defend Aden.
[The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/houthis-advance-toward-aden-us-iran-deadlock-continues) reported that Houthi forces are advancing toward Aden while the US-Iran deadlock continues.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/16/saudi-arabia-challenged-yemeni-allies-ceding-ground-houthis) reported that Saudi Arabia was challenged by Yemeni allies over ceding ground to Houthis.

[Pakistan Observer](https://pakobserver.net/lt-gen-fahd-bin-hamad-replaced-as-saudi-joint-forces-commander-amid-houthi-attacks/), [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/gulf/2026/11/16/saudi-arabia-replaces-joint-forces-commander-overseeing-fight-with-houthis/) reported that Saudi Arabia replaced Lt. Gen. Fahd bin Hamad as Joint Forces Commander overseeing operations in Yemen.

[Long War Journal](https://www.longwarjournal.org/archives/2026/11/houthis-retake-bab-al-mandeb-and-move-toward-aden.php) reported that Yemeni government-aligned forces redeployed from the west coast to focus on defending Aden as Houthi forces seized territory along Bab al Mandeb.

[ANSA](https://www.ansa.it/sito/notizie/mondo/2026/11/16/gli-houthi-padroni-a-bab-el-mandeb-dopo-la-ritirata-dei-filo-sauditi_850c3a05-2ef4-46b8-b2ed-b22483a90c37.html) reported that loyalists left the strait as the Saudi-led coalition's counteroffensive ended in a retreat.

[ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-17/yemen-government-forces-retreat-bab-el-mandeb-strait/107392710) reported that Saudi-backed forces in Yemen retreated to defend the key port city of Aden.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/yemens-saudi-backed-forces-retreat-defend-aden-houthis-advance-what-know) reported that Saudi Arabia named a new commander of its military forces as its Yemeni allies cede ground.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/yemen/20261116-saudi-arabia-dismisses-commander-of-anti-houthi-coalition-as-rebels-advance), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/16/saudi-arabia-dismisses-commander-of-coalition-forces-fighting-houthis?traffic_source=rss), [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/saudi-arabia-dismisses-commander-anti-houthi-coalition) reported that Saudi Arabia dismissed the commander of the coalition forces fighting the Houthis in Yemen as government forces withdraw from the Red Sea coast.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/16/houthis-edge-closer-to-aden-as-yemeni-forces-pull-out-of-bab-al-mandeb?traffic_source=rss), [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261116-yemeni-forces-withdraw-from-area-near-bab-al-mandab-as-houthis-take-control/) reported that forces loyal to Yemen's internationally recognised government withdrew from positions near the Bab al-Mandab Strait as Houthis advanced.

[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cqvg2xgyvnjpo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that Saudi-backed Yemeni forces are moving troops from the Bab al-Mandab Strait to defend the interim capital Aden, leaving Houthis in control of the waterway.

[RT](https://rt-english.com/news/648876-houthis-tighten-grip-key-route/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS), a state-media outlet, reported that Saudi-backed Yemeni forces withdrew from positions near the Bab el-Mandeb Strait as Houthi advances threatened Aden.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/16/houthis-advance-in-yemen-as-government-forces-move-to-defend-aden?traffic_source=rss) reported that an advance by the Houthi armed group in Yemen threatens one of the government's last strongholds.

[The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/16/world/houthis-aden-govt-defences/) reported that Houthi forces advanced on Aden and seized the Red Sea coast in a lightning offensive while Saudi-backed forces bolstered defenses.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/15/yemeni-government-forces-redeploy-from-bab-al-mandeb-to-defend-aden?traffic_source=rss) reported that a spokesman for the Southern Armed Forces said the group is repositioning from Dhubab airport and areas around Bab al-Mandeb.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/anti-houthi-forces-retreat-yemen-iran-strikes-bahrain) reported that Saudi-backed forces retreated against the Houthis in Yemen while Iran and its allies increased pressure on the US and Gulf states.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/yemeni-government-force-retreats-strait-major-setback-war-against-houthis) reported that Yemeni government forces announced they were withdrawing from the area near the Bab el-Mandeb Strait to focus on defending their main base in Aden.

[Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/11/yemen-government-forces-withdraw-area-near-bab-el-mandeb-strait-houthis-control), [The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/mena/2026/11/15/southern-yemeni-forces-withdraw-from-area-near-bab-al-mandab/), [The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/middle-east/article-914920) reported that Yemeni forces fighting for the internationally recognized government withdrew from an area near the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, leaving the Houthis in control.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/middle-east/20261115-yemen-houthis-advance-to-within-60-kilometres-of-aden-military-sources-say), [teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/yemen-bab-al-mandab-conflict/) reported that Houthi forces in Yemen advanced to within 60 kilometres of Aden and took the Kharaz base as government and pro-Saudi forces retreated.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/yemeni-government-forces-retreat-from-strait-in-major-setback-in-war-against-houthis/article71705608.ece) reported that Houthi gains in Yemen and attacks on Saudi Arabia and Red Sea shipping have strengthened Iran's position.
[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/15/world/middleeast/saudi-houthis-yemen-red-sea.html) reported that Saudi-backed forces in Yemen retreated from the Red Sea as Houthi forces advanced.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinwFBVV95cUxPM1hhZ2pySkp3SHdfNllHQ2VsLUFteHIxRlFGVVR3QXFIbXJZX01HQkZ5Ml96SjBMSkJkOHh6TjNIakZkR3k5ME1WY0RyYTNBQkxvaF9qYTVtNm5GVEFqckVEalRReVdXUFJKZVhlSXEzcnotRFMyVVBMZllhdmJxUFBwRjByVExHbGhnR3luTDVqTlRxOG5TTjFVbmdBRmM?oc=5) reported that Yemen's Houthis stated they fired missiles at Saudi forces in Jazan.

[Tehran Times](https://www.tehrantimes.com/news/532098/Yemeni-forces-complete-Aden-encirclement), a state outlet, reported that forces loyal to Yemen's Ansarallah movement completed the encirclement of Aden.

[Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2044365/yemeni-govt-forces-fortify-defences-in-aden) reported that Yemen's internationally recognized government is fortifying positions on the outskirts of Aden province as Houthi forces advance.

[The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/yemen-govt-forces-fortify-aden-defences-houthis-advance) reported that Yemen's government forces are fortifying defenses around Aden as Houthi forces advance.

[Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/86180999), a Moldovan news outlet, reported that Hungarian authorities recovered cash worth nearly €17.7 million in an investigation involving former National Development Minister Miklós Seszták.

[Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/world/europe/hungary-finds-30-million-cash-some-buried-in-forests-in-bribery-probe-20261115-p61e7e.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported that Hungary found $30 million in cash, some buried in forests, in a bribery probe.

[Sydney Morning Herald](https://www.smh.com.au/world/cash-found-in-hungary-in-anti-graft-probe-20261115-p61e8r.html?ref=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_source=rss_feed) reported on footage released from Hungary’s National Asset Recovery and Protection Office showing cash found in an anti-graft probe.

[Times of Malta](https://timesofmalta.com/article/hungary-seizes-195-million-cash-hidden-forests-graft-probe.1137115) reported that Miklos Sesztak, two other ministers from Viktor Orban's cabinet, and his brother have been taken into custody in different cases.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/14/hungary-seizes-millions-in-cash-found-buried-in-forests-amid-corruption-investigation) reported that investigators uncovered large amounts of cash buried in forests, concealed in agricultural buildings, and stashed inside safes.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90112) reported that Hungary's National Asset Recovery and Protection Agency seized over 5 billion forints, €2.7 million, and $1.3 million in physical cash.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/14/hungarian-investigators-uncover-19-5m-hidden-in-forests-and-buildings?traffic_source=rss) reported that nearly $20 million was found in Hungary's forests and buildings amid a corruption probe into an ex-minister.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/international/article-914852) reported that it took a dozen State Treasury workers eight hours to count the cash as part of Prime Minister Peter Magyar’s Operation Purgatory anti-corruption drive.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/13/hungary-seizes-195m-in-cash-found-buried-in-forests-amid-graft-inquiry), [Budapest Times](https://www.budapesttimes.hu/hungary/billions-in-buried-cash-found-in-forests-and-safes-in-ex-ministers-bribery-case/) reported that Hungary's anti-corruption agency seized $19.5 million in cash found buried in forests and safes as part of a bribery inquiry into an Orbán-era minister.

reports.text: [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/tv-shows/the-debate/20261116-should-ukraine-trade-donbas-for-nato-membership) reported that President Volodymyr Zelensky stated the United States asked him about a swap where Russia gets the Donbas and the rest of Ukraine gets NATO membership.

[Nigerian Tribune](https://tribuneonlineng.com/zelenskyy-us-proposal-donbas-withdrawal-nato-membership/) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated US negotiators raised the possibility of Ukraine withdrawing from the eastern Donbas region in exchange for NATO membership.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/international/live/2026/11/16/en-direct-guerre-en-ukraine-volodymyr-zelensky-annonce-la-preparation-d-une-reunion-de-la-coalition-des-volontaires-qui-pourrait-s-averer-historique_6810982_3210.html) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky announced the preparation of a coalition of volunteers meeting to define the European position in future talks with Moscow.

[TASS](https://tass.com/russias-foreign-policy/2218325), a Russian state-media outlet, reported that Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov stated that all participants in the Abu Dhabi talks viewed them positively, with the exception of Volodymyr Zelenskyy.
[TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2218191), a Russian state-media outlet, reported that Moscow believes staying out of EANA and other European forums serves the interests of Russian organizations.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/ukraine-donbas-russia-war-map-frontline-update-b3085148.html) reported that fresh peace talks in Abu Dhabi failed to reach a meaningful breakthrough.

[Burkina 24](https://burkina24.com/2026/11/15/guerre-en-ukraine-washington-evoque-le-donbass-en-echange-dune-adhesion-a-lotan-selon-zelensky/) reported according to Zelensky that Washington raised a possible withdrawal of Ukrainian forces from Donbas in exchange for NATO membership.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/15/give-donbas-take-nato-seat-could-new-us-pitch-work-for-ukraine-russia?traffic_source=rss) reported that a US pitch involving Ukraine ceding Donbas to take a NATO seat is being considered.

[Rappler (Philippines)](https://www.rappler.com/world/europe/us-floated-ukraine-ceding-donbas-nato-membership/) reported that President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated Kyiv would not concede territory but would put the question to a national referendum if Ukraine received security guarantees.
[TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2218183), a Russian state outlet, reported that Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov took part in a conference on political affairs in Abu Dhabi.
[TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2218209), a Russian state outlet, reported that Russian and UAE foreign ministers met in Abu Dhabi to discuss bilateral relations and Persian Gulf tensions.

[Politico](https://www.politico.eu/article/finland-rejects-reported-russian-demand-to-leave-nato-as-part-of-peace-talks/?utm_source=RSS_Feed&utm_medium=RSS&utm_campaign=RSS_Syndication) reported that Finnish Defense Minister Antti Häkkänen called the reported Russian demand for Finland to leave NATO outrageous.

[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90105) reported that Russia revived late-2021 security demands during peace talks with US envoys in Moscow, calling for NATO to withdraw troops to its 1997 borders.

[TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2218103) reported that Russia’s permanent representative to the OSCE Dmitry Polyansky stated that Europeans came with old talking points and were mum on Abu Dhabi talks.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/14/8062819/) reported that a document presented by Russian officials during negotiations with US envoys in Abu Dhabi calls for NATO to return to its 1997 military positions.

[The Express Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2640123/russia-demands-finland-leave-nato-in-abu-dhabi-talks-report), [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/14/russia-demands-finland-leave-nato-bild-reports-moscow-denies-it-and-helsinki-is-outraged) reported that the German newspaper Bild stated Russia demanded Finland leave NATO during Abu Dhabi talks, while Moscow denied the report and Helsinki expressed outrage.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/14/us-suggested-ukraine-cede-parts-of-donbas-to-russia-to-become-part-of-nato?traffic_source=rss), [The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/us-suggested-ukraine-cede-land-nato-zelensky-says) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said the US suggested Ukraine cede parts of Donbas to Russia to join NATO.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-asked-ukraine-to-cede-donbas-in-exchange-for-nato-membership-zelensky-says-101794649702111.html) reported that Volodymyr Zelensky said he would put the question to a referendum if Ukraine received a comprehensive security package including security guarantees.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/international/live/2026/11/14/en-direct-guerre-en-ukraine-les-dernieres-informations-au-14-novembre-2026_6808609_3210.html), [Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/flash-actu/guerre-en-ukraine-les-etats-unis-ont-propose-a-kiev-des-concessions-territoriales-en-echange-d-une-adhesion-a-l-otan-annonce-zelensky-20261114) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky announced that the United States proposed territorial concessions to Ukraine in exchange for NATO membership.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20261114-us-negotiators-suggest-ukraine-cedes-territory-in-exchange-for-nato-membership) reported that President Zelensky said the US had proposed ceding Ukraine's eastern city of Donbas to Russia in exchange for Ukrainian membership of NATO.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/14/us-floats-ukraine-ceding-land-to-russia-in-exchange-for-nato-membership-zelenskyy) reported that Putin has indicated Russia will not back down on territorial demands to control parts of Ukraine and has rejected the idea of foreign peacekeeping troops.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/us-proposes-ukraine-cede-territory-for-nato-membership-zelensky/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said the US proposed Ukraine cede its Donbas region in exchange for NATO membership during recent peace talks in Abu Dhabi.

reports.text: [Jowhar](https://jowhar.com/u-s-air-travel-gradually-rebounds-after-days-of-widespread-disruptions/) reported that U.S. air travel gradually rebounded following widespread disruptions.

[Daily Maverick](https://www.dailymaverick.co.za/article/2026-11-15-us-air-travel-disruptions-continue-into-third-day/) reported that US air travel disruptions continued into a third day, with over 5,200 flights affected on Sunday.

[Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/estados-unidos/eeuu-busca-causa-raiz-de-la-falla-que-dejo-paralizados-todos-los-vuelos_0_zCyBF4MQ1z.html) reported that the US government is investigating router failures in Arkansas and Texas as the root cause of the flight suspension.

[Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/americas/us-authorities-warn-air-travel-chaos-may-continue-for-another-day), [GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/world/1009619/trump-admin-warns-air-travelers-of-another-messy-day/story/), [Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2044632/trump-admin-warns-us-air-travellers-of-another-messy-day) reported that the US government warned that air travel disruptions caused by the ground stop could persist into Monday.

[Vanguard](https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/us-flight-disruptions-trump-admin-says-air-travel-chaos-may-last-another-day/) reported that the Trump administration stated the air travel disruptions caused by the no-takeoff order may last another day.

[El País](https://elpais.com/us/2026-11-15/el-bloqueo-aereo-destapa-el-infierno-de-volar-desde-los-aeropuertos-de-estados-unidos.html) reported that the flight ban revealed systemic issues across US airport operations.

[Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/mundo/perdieron-20-mil-vuelos-bloqueo-aereo-estados-unidos-afirma-trafico-normalizara-noche_0_1gcAlPxDcS.html) reported that nearly 20,000 flights were lost due to the blockage, with the FAA director anticipating operations to return to normal schedules.
[El Estímulo](https://elestimulo.com/nota-de-prensa/2026-11-14/reactivan-operaciones-de-vuelo-en-espacio-aereo-de-estados-unidos/) reported that flight operations in US airspace were reactivated.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2026/nov/14/us-bound-flights-out-of-australia-grounded-as-telecommunications-outage-affects-american-travel) reported that Sydney and Melbourne airports said flights were affected by the now-lifted departure ban in the US.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/us-what-exactly-caused-the-longest-nationwide-ground-stop-in-25-years) reported that officials are warning it will take days to recover from the ongoing delays.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/14/us/repair-that-triggered-air-traffic-meltdown-was-expected-to-be-routine.html) reported that officials stated an upgrade to antiquated communications equipment at a remote facility overloaded other parts of the national air traffic system.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/suspension-de-vuelos-en-eu-asi-se-veia-el-espacio-aereo-en-medio-de-la-emergencia-miles-de-viajes-fueron-cancelados-o-retrasados/) reported on the visual state of US airspace and the thousands of canceled or delayed flights during the flight suspension emergency.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/estados-unidos/caos-aereo-en-eeuu-revelan-la-falla-que-derivo-en-la-paralizacion-de-los-vuelos-en-todo-el-pais-nid14112026/), [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/estados-unidos/caos-aereo-en-eeuu-persiste-tras-suspension-masiva-de-vuelos-por-falla-tecnica_0_vuCYVXOQ5O.html) reported that US authorities stated the nationwide flight suspension was caused by an incident during routine updates to an old communications line.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/us-lifts-nationwide-ground-stop-for-airports-hours-after-halting-all-departures/a-79945062?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf), [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20261114-us-flights-resume-after-nationwide-ground-stop-lifted-aviation), [RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/2026/1114/1599194-travel-stop-lifted/) reported that the US Federal Aviation Administration lifted a nationwide ground stop for all airports.

[Egypt Independent](https://www.egyptindependent.com/all-us-flights-grounded-amid-cyberattack-speculation-what-we-know-so-far/) reported that US Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy announced the grounding of all departing flights due to a communications issue.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20261113-us-flight-authority-orders-national-ground-stop-over-air-traffic-control-communication-issue), [Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikAFBVV95cUxOeFBta25Rakd3c0VBM0NUWjJzbmV2ajZwTWRtUFVTcTVzZ2otRGo0cXZSWWV0MzNBSXdmMXNzdm9SU1d1blBBNnktRlNqQmcwVUVxQzhCNERGel9ETDBHZjJwb29IYmhGX2VPNm8xeGwwU0VNajFzZnpIM19lejBOVTZrRVVjb2t4SDh3emhSZHI?oc=5), [DW](https://www.dw.com/en/faa-issues-us-national-ground-stop-on-all-flights/a-79945062?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf), [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivwFBVV95cUxPTTdvYllmb0pHUXVJVGNLUmFZb2I0WXpjZENubU52NW1nQlFJa1E4c3ZNTGhseUdiUzl0ZXJWa0pOSnR1ZDlRQk9FTHZlaWkyT0hLM1J3OW5tVUhIb0o4OWN5bDVVakF5T3lIanR1SVVMSkctSDlpb2loMWI2MENuWEIxTmhTcy1kZXdqSlRrdi1NMHlFSGtPRWEzdUFrMWR1c2wwNk9rRUUwOGpzajM0N1h2MndWVU9MYngyMVdudw?oc=5) reported that the Federal Aviation Administration issued a national ground stop on all departing flights due to an air traffic control communications issue.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/13/us/markwayne-mullin-faa-ground-stop.html) reported that Homeland Security Secretary Mullin stated he did not know what caused the telecommunication outage.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/travel/news-and-advice/faa-ground-stop-us-flights-b3084974.html) reported that the stoppage was the first nationwide ground stop since January 2023.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/sci-tech/technology/why-italy-hit-meta-with-record-805-million-fine-explained/article71707103.ece) reported that Italy's data protection authority conducted a technical analysis following a complaint from a consumer protection forum.

[RT](https://rt-english.com/news/648873-italy-fines-meta-privacy/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS), a Russian state outlet, reported that Italy fined Meta €805 million over Facebook's access to Android users' photo galleries without informed consent.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/nov/15/italy-fines-meta-887m-for-accessing-android-users-photos-and-videos) reported that Italy fined Meta $887 million for accessing Android users' photos and videos.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/finanzas/italia-multa-a-meta-con-805-millones-de-euros-por-acceder-a-fotos-de-usuarios-sin-consentimiento-33137919) reported that Italy fined Meta 805 million euros for accessing user photos without consent.

[NZ Herald](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/italy-fines-meta-16b-for-accessing-photos-of-users-without-consent/UDW7UOIDQRGX7DPOX4IAWOTLII/) reported that Italian regulators fined Meta over accessing photos of users without consent.

[Punch](https://punchng.com/italy-fines-meta-e805m-over-access-to-users-photos-without-consent/?utm_source=rss.punchng.com&utm_medium=web) reported that about 20 million Android users in Italy were affected.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/14/italy-fines-meta-880m-over-photo-privacy?traffic_source=rss) reported that Italian regulators stated Meta's lack of cooperation and the large number of people affected contributed to the size of the fine.
[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cwn83gxemk35o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that Meta is accused of not informing 20 million users that it had access to their photos.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiowFBVV95cUxQSVFmcHRvNGEzVXRKbU5Kc0JhSDV4R2o0bnpXSUJMZnRMc1E2ckNCRzBaWDhzY2xObHVtNmtiWmdoX3g4NlVsYkc1bzFDbVB0T016LWczNHJ6bGx2ZXlQeDZPUGNjeXJPaWZ3Wm5DdU9za21PMXFlZVVDckh5Q1I0QnROcElOTnA2bGMzczBMbFJweW1ISkkwWUgzNXJpTU95N0NR?oc=5) reported that Italy fined Meta $887 million over Android users' data access.

[Politico](https://www.politico.eu/article/italy-hits-meta-with-e805m-fine-over-privacy-law-violation/?utm_source=RSS_Feed&utm_medium=RSS&utm_campaign=RSS_Syndication) reported that the penalty is the largest fine ever issued by Italy's data protection regulator.

[teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/italy-fines-meta-e805-million-for-accessing-user-photos-without-permission/) reported that the Italian Data Protection Authority fined Meta Platforms Ireland Limited for accessing photos, videos, and metadata stored on phones without permission.

reports.text: [The Washington Times](https://www.washingtontimes.com/news/2026/nov/16/united-airlines-hit-sudden-system-outage/) reported that United Airlines suffered a widespread system outage that left planes unable to take off.
[TASS](https://tass.com/emergencies/2219263) reported that a major outage hit United Airlines affecting a system related to flight departures.
[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/svet/drama-na-americkim-aerodromima-pao-sistem-united-airlinesa/npgmhe1) reported that United Airlines confirmed a system failure occurred on Monday afternoon.

[El Sol de México](https://oem.com.mx/elsoldemexico/finanzas/jpmorgan-chase-atribuye-los-fallos-a-un-error-de-software-y-descarta-un-ciberataque-33166828) reported that JPMorgan Chase attributed banking service outages affecting thousands of customers to a software error and ruled out a cyberattack.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/economia/united-airlines-reporta-interrupcion-generalizada-sus-sistemas_202611176afb8b9903bbf30bb04e2f1a.html) reported that United Airlines experienced a widespread system disruption in the United States attributed to instability in communications and radar systems.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/united-airlines-restablece-sistema-tras-falla-tecnologica-interrupcion-provoco-retrasos-en-vuelos/) reported that on November 13 the FAA ordered flights to remain on the ground because a new router failed and saturated the system.
[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/16/united-airlines-system-outage) reported that United Airlines acknowledged a technology issue that delayed flight departures.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/united-airlines-hit-by-widespread-system-outage-days-after-faa-ground-stop-disrupted-us-air-travel-101794867751137.html) reported that the carrier clarified the issue was not affecting flights already in the air or services operated by United Express.

[NZ Herald](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/united-airlines-reports-widespread-outage-just-days-after-nationwide-ground-stop/CHU2RQYJERCJNHQAEB4INTZEGY/) reported that old network equipment was overloaded, disrupting 17 of 22 major control centres.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/united-airlines-resolves-tech-outage-that-delayed-flights/a-79964387?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that United Airlines said a system outage that delayed departures has been resolved.
[TASS](https://tass.com/economy/2219271), a Russian state-owned outlet, reported that there was no indication that the United Airlines electronic system outage was a cybersecurity-related issue.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/business-and-innovation/article-915107) reported that there was no indication that United's outage was connected to the Federal Aviation Administration shutdown.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/mundo/noticia/2026/11/16/united-airlines-relata-falha-generalizada-dias-depois-da-suspensao-de-voos-nos-eua.ghtml) reported that United Airlines reported a widespread system outage days after nationwide flight cancellations due to technical problems.

[La Nación (Argentina)](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/estados-unidos/estados-unidos-recupera-la-normalidad-aerea-tras-miles-de-cancelaciones-y-una-falla-en-el-sistema-de-nid16112026/) reported that more than 18,000 flights were canceled and 28,000 suffered delays over three days due to an FAA router issue before normal operations resumed.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/cartera/bancos-de-eu-reportan-fallas-en-sus-plataformas-digitales-usuarios-denuncian-problemas-de-acceso/) reported that Zelle also registered interruptions in its transfer services alongside bank platform issues.

[El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/eeuu-y-canada/se-desploman-las-acciones-de-grandes-bancos-en-wall-street-tras-fallas-en-sus-plataformas-digitales-en-estados-unidos-3601471) reported that shares of JPMorgan Chase, Bank of America, Wells Fargo, and Capital One registered losses on Wall Street following digital platform failures.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/chase-bank-of-america-us-bank-and-wells-fargo-among-banks-down-today-users-report-mobile-banking-outages-101794855031957.html), [El Tiempo](https://www.eltiempo.com/mundo/eeuu-y-canada/caida-de-bancos-en-estados-unidos-chase-bank-of-america-y-wells-fargo-presentan-fallas-en-sus-servicios-digitales-3601448), [Clarín](https://www.clarin.com/estados-unidos/usuarios-denuncian-problemas-de-acceso-a-chase-bank-of-america-y-wells-fargo_0_giCFGzhtEk.html) reported that users of Chase, Bank of America, Wells Fargo, and US Bank experienced digital service outages and difficulties accessing online accounts.

reports.text: [TASS](https://tass.com/world/2219753), a state-media outlet, reported that according to the US Central Command, all Iranian drones were intercepted without damage to US equipment or injury to personnel.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivgFBVV95cUxPV29iM2xvSHBZbjBVTy1QTFd3aUVKb2ZnMjY3a2wzWWo5eGRGV2UxSTcwTUJCeVFUaDc5TFhoaE1HbC14UVg5NUtRLUE4bXB5M0o2UnhCOXoxVEFLd29QYmJYdWg2M2h5NG80Rkk4X1BaOE5fTUpJVUctOTBIZEltS2FfSXRXeEFFOVNqaFNBaGljVmxubGJnWERTUC05ek5vX0tubUt6cUd2Qi1SZ3NSMUFtVnlHLUtqSzRiUVl3?oc=5), [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/17/iran-claims-drone-attack-on-us-radar-system-at-sheikh-isa-air-base-in-bahrain), [Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1582777/iran-claims-strike-on-us-radar-system-in-bahrain/) reported that Iran launched a drone attack targeting a US military radar system at the Sheikh Isa Air Base in Bahrain.

[IRNA English](https://en.irna.ir/news/86324363/IRGC-targets-US-radar-system-at-Bahrain-s-Sheikh-Isa-Air-Base), an Iranian state-run outlet, reported that the Islamic Revolution Guards Corps carried out a precision drone operation targeting the US military radar system at Bahrain's Sheikh Isa Air Base.

[RT](https://rt-english.com/news/648851-iran-us-base-bahrain/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS), a state-media outlet, reported that Iran’s IRGC claimed six drones struck a US radar site in Bahrain in retaliation for US attacks on Iranian civilian areas.

[Hasht-e Subh](https://8am.media/eng/irans-revolutionary-guards-claim-drone-attack-on-us-radar-facility-in-bahrain/) reported that Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps stated it targeted a US radar defense facility at Al-Riffa Air Base in Bahrain with six drones.
