[Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/middle-east-news/2026-11-15/ty-article/bahrain-intercepts-iranian-drone-attacks-as-tehran-says-it-hit-u-s-base/000001a1-debc-da30-a7fb-debdb7ed0000) reported that the attack was the first on Bahrain since September.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/middle-east/iran-bahrain-us-base-trump-b3085199.html) reported that Donald Trump stated he might hold off from attacking Iran if the US faces no new provocations.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/middle-east/20261115-iran-claims-attack-on-us-military-airbase-in-bahrain), [teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/iran-starts-new-wave-of-response-to-u-s-aggression-in-bahrain-attack/), [Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/mid-east/blasts-rock-bahrain-as-fresh-iran-strikes-target-us-base-on-island) reported that Iran's Revolutionary Guard claimed responsibility for a drone attack on a US military base in Bahrain.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/iran-claims-strike-on-us-base-in-bahrain-kingdom-says-it-intercepted-aerial-attacks-101794731270651.html), [The Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/world/middle-east/2026/11/15/bahrain-intercepts-iranian-aerial-attacks-as-tehran-says-it-attacked-us-base/), [RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/2026/1115/1599264-bahrain-iran-attacks/) reported that Bahrain stated it intercepted the aerial attacks.

reports.text: [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/17/second-tanker-in-two-days-sinks-off-bulgarias-black-sea-coast-search-operation-under-way) reported that a second tanker sank off Bulgaria's Black Sea coast.

[Dnevnik (Bulgaria)](https://www.dnevnik.bg/bulgaria/2026/11/17/4980766_gazovoz_potuna_v_bulgarskata_ikonomicheska_zona_na/?ref=rss) reported that the tanker Gas Husky sank following a drone attack in Bulgaria's exclusive economic zone in the Black Sea.

[RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/leinster/2026/1117/1599491-vessel-wexford/), [The Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/ireland/2026/11/17/six-crew-members-rescued-after-cargo-vessel-ran-aground-off-coast-of-wexford/) reported that six crew members were rescued after an 88-metre cargo vessel ran aground off Roney Point on the Wexford coast.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/16/12-crew-members-rescued-after-cargo-ship-capsizes-off-bulgaria-following-suspected-drone-s), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/16/cargo-ship-capsizes-off-bulgarias-black-sea-coast?traffic_source=rss) reported that all 12 crew members of a cargo ship that capsized off Bulgaria were rescued.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/16/12-crew-members-rescued-after-cargo-ship-capsizes-off-bulgaria-following-suspected-drone-s), [GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/world/1009728/crew-rescued-from-capsized-wheat-ship-in-black-sea-drone-strike-suspected/story/), [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/cargo-ship-sinks-in-bulgarias-black-sea-after-reported-drone-attack-all-12-crew-rescued/) reported that authorities suspected a drone strike caused the vessel to capsize.

[GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/world/1009728/crew-rescued-from-capsized-wheat-ship-in-black-sea-drone-strike-suspected/story/) reported that the ship was carrying 3,000 metric tons of wheat.

[Dnevnik (Bulgaria)](https://www.dnevnik.bg/burzi-novini/2026/11/16/4980351_turgovski_korab_potuva_v_bulgarskata_ikonomicheska/?ref=rss) reported that a merchant ship was sinking in the Bulgarian economic zone in the Black Sea near Kaliakra, according to the Ministry of Transport.

[Dnevnik (Bulgaria)](https://www.dnevnik.bg/sviat/voinata_v_ukraina/2026/11/15/4980175_dronove_udariha_tri_koraba_v_rumunski_vodi_v_cherno/?ref=rss) reported that Prime Minister Luca Niculescu stated drones struck three commercial vessels in Romanian waters in the Black Sea near the Sulina canal.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90153) reported that an unidentified drone attacked the Palau-flagged commercial vessel Larissa 1 inside Romanian territorial waters.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90181) reported that Romanian Prime Minister Luca Niculescu condemned the drone attack on three commercial vessels near the Danube Delta.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/15/three-commercial-vessels-struck-by-drones-near-romanias-black-sea-pm-says) reported that Romania's Prime Minister called the drone strikes on three commercial vessels near Romania's Black Sea unacceptable and a violation of international law.

[GMA News](https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/world/1009606/3-ships-struck-by-drones-in-black-sea-near-romanian-shipping-canal/story/) reported that Prime Minister Luca Niculescu stated drones struck three commercial ships in the Black Sea near Romania's Sulina canal and armed forces scrambled aircraft.

[Politico](https://www.politico.eu/article/romanian-pm-condemns-unacceptable-drone-strikes-black-sea-ships/?utm_source=RSS_Feed&utm_medium=RSS&utm_campaign=RSS_Syndication), [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/three-commercial-ships-struck-by-drones-near-romanias-black-sea-coast-over-two-days/) reported that Romanian Defense Minister Ștefan-Radu Oprea confirmed the strikes on three commercial vessels near Constanța.

reports.text: [Moldova news (YAM)](https://news.yam.md/ro/story/87330337) reported that Estonia will close its border with Russia on December 1 and that Lithuanian President Gitanas Nausėda warned Lithuania is not ruling out similar measures.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261116-estonia-to-close-russian-border-crossings-after-attempted-arson-attack-on-drone-maker), [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/feature/2026/11/16/estonia-is-closing-its-border-with-russia-after-an-alleged-sabotage-attempt-and-preparing-to-move-government-services-to-the-cloud-in-case-of-invasion) reported that Estonia will close all border crossings with Russia starting December 1 following a suspected sabotage attack at Threod Systems.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/16/8063116/) reported that Lithuanian President Gitanas Nausėda stated Lithuania may consider closing all border crossings with Russia if destabilisation efforts continue.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/16/estonia-to-close-russia-border-after-sabotage-bid-on-drone-maker-foreign-minister-says), [Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90202) reported that Prime Minister Kristen Michal stated the GRU ordered a sabotage attempt at defense company Threod Systems.
[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/16/8063038/) reported that Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha praised Estonian security services for thwarting the attack.

[The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/16/world/estonia-russia-border-sabotage-bid/) reported that Estonia's decision to close its border with Russia marked an escalation in regional tensions linked to Moscow's war against Ukraine.

[Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-crime/4184944-eight-people-detained-in-estonia-over-attempted-arson-attack-on-defense-industry-plant-allegedly-commissioned-by-russia.html) reported that the Estonian Prosecutor General's Office stated eight people were detained over an attempted arson attack on a Threod defense industry building in Viimsi commissioned by Russia.
[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2218361) reported that Interior Minister Igor Taro stated Estonia will decide on closing its border with Russia next week on a temporary or permanent basis.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitwFBVV95cUxOVkhQYlBYSGp1OG16aUlIS0JBcWpXQnpYbDlDaVFqb0V4cG04dm9wbnptbW1WRnI1bmh2ck0tTmM2Vl9pYVN2dG5NVmpTM2liUG9JWDNkVTZPVUxQc0swQ3FuN3UyZ2tyanRHVENpeUQtbTl0Z3RYSlIzVFB3QnFtdzVvWURCWDlCVjhlclpUTlpWaVhxektwaEFtY2Z2ZGRUYmJ1Z0ozUW9jY0lSOURycDkxSktlRnc?oc=5), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/15/estonia-to-close-border-crossings-with-russia-after-alleged-arson-attack?traffic_source=rss), [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/estonia-to-close-border-with-russia-after-moscow-linked-sabotage-attempt-on-drone-maker/) reported that Estonia is closing its border crossings with Russia following an alleged or attempted arson attack on a drone manufacturer.

[TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2218399), a Russian state outlet, reported that Russian diplomat Maria Zakharova stated Moscow will check information about Estonia's plans and view it as Russophobia if confirmed.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/15/estonian-drone-maker-targeted-by-gru-ordered-sabotage-attempt-pm-says) reported that Prime Minister Kristen Michal said Estonia was preparing to potentially close its border with Russia.

[Politico](https://www.politico.eu/article/estonia-accuses-russia-of-attempted-arson-attack-on-drone-maker/?utm_source=RSS_Feed&utm_medium=RSS&utm_campaign=RSS_Syndication) reported that Estonia will close its border with Russia after Tallinn's Internal Security Service stated an attempted arson attack on a defense firm was commissioned by Russia's GRU military intelligence agency.

[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90184) reported that Estonian security authorities thwarted an attempted explosion and arson attack against drone manufacturer Threod Systems and detained suspects.

[TASS](https://tass.com/world/2218363), a Russian state-owned outlet, reported that Estonian Foreign Minister Margus Tsahkna announced Estonia will close all Estonian-Russian border crossing points as of December 1.

reports.text: [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/drug-lord-miguel-angel-felix-gallardo-dies-b3086191.html) reported that Miguel Ángel Félix Gallardo, known as the Godfather of Mexican drug trafficking and boss of bosses, died at age 80 after being kept in prison since 1989.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/nacion/el-jefe-de-jefes-y-las-redes-de-poder-en-el-trasiego-de-droga-asi-tejio-felix-gallardo-su-entramado-criminal/) reported on the criminal history and smuggling networks of Miguel Angel Felix Gallardo.
[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/mexican-drug-lord-felix-gallardo-dies-at-80/a-79954351?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that Felix Gallardo died of multiple organ failure at the age of 80.
[La Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/2026/11/16/politica/021n1pol?partner=rss) reported that Miguel Angel Felix Gallardo died at the Country 2000 private hospital.

[El Universal (Mexico)](https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/nacion/poco-a-poco-hay-que-darle-tiempo-cuando-felix-gallardo-pidio-confiar-en-amlo-para-combatir-la-violencia-en-mexico/) reported that drug lord Miguel Angel Felix Gallardo died at the age of 80 after spending 37 years in prison.

reports.text: [Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/17/8063246/) reported that Kremlin spokesperson Dmitry Peskov stated Vladimir Putin has been briefed and vowed to rebuild the Crimean Bridge after a Ukrainian multi-weapon strike.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivwFBVV95cUxPTl9Eb1E5UVQ3M3dxTUZvVFZiRndFUElsU3RMZ2ZGR0poZlV6X3JHdklhNUswWEE4RGZkbXZkWmpwS3I3ZTgyY1Vrc2tXOXZnYl9kSlJsT1BuR3pWZmkyYlRENWgyWHVSU0Y5dkhVdlFrNXMxMnNJTTVMRTF6aUJpQkdXUnV1NnE5aW43QVFlYmFfdjlxTVBUY0Rfam1tSFBRMl8weFVMSWw0RFBTekdncV8weE5CcXlwcHhMWDh3QQ?oc=5) reported that Russia stated Ukraine struck its bridge to Crimea for the second consecutive day in what was described as the largest drone attack of the war.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261117-ukraine-russia-hit-key-bridges-ahead-of-putin-xi-trump-summit) reported that Ukraine struck Russia's Crimean bridge for the second night in a row, shutting it down, while Russia struck two major bridges in Kyiv.

[Defence Blog](https://defence-blog.com/putins-bridge-to-crimea-falls-into-the-kerch-strait/) reported that the arch over the shipping channel on the road section of the Crimean Bridge collapsed into the Kerch Strait.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/17/ukrainian-drone-attack-kills-two-in-crimea-as-kyiv-targets-kerch-bridge?traffic_source=rss) reported that a Ukrainian drone attack killed two people in Crimea.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/17/8063218/) reported that Ukrainian forces used an FP-5 Flamingo cruise missile, alongside Palianytsia and Ruta drones and Neptune missiles, during the strike on the Crimean Bridge.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90332) reported that President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated the strike on the Crimean Bridge was the culmination of a seven-stage operation.

[RT](https://rt-english.com/russia/648941-crimean-bridge-drone-ukraine/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS), a Russian state outlet, reported that Crimea's head Sergey Aksyonov stated the Ukrainian forces targeted the Crimean Bridge for the second day in a row, leading to its closure.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/17/8063184/) reported that the Crimean Bridge came under another attack, resulting in one of its arches and part of its roadway being damaged and falling into the sea, with all traffic suspended.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/17/ukrainian-monitoring-channels-claim-missile-strike-sends-crimea-bridge-road-arch-into-the-water), [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4185406-one-of-crimean-bridges-arches-damaged-in-second-strike.html) reported that Ukrainian forces attacked the Crimean Bridge again, damaging one of its arches and sending the road arch into the water according to monitoring channels and local officials.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/17/ukraine-war-briefing-crimea-bridge-attacked-again-after-russia-strikes-major-kyiv-bridges) reported that Ukraine hit the symbolic bridge linking occupied Crimea to Russia, and Kyiv's heating and water were disrupted.

[CGTN](https://news.cgtn.com/news/2026-11-16/news-1S7hKwQqaPe/p.html?UTM_Source=cgtn&UTM_Medium=rss&UTM_Campaign=World) reported that Russian media stated the Crimean Bridge came under attack with traffic restrictions expected to remain in place until midday on Monday.

[TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2219261) reported that Head of the Republic of Crimea Sergey Aksyonov urged residents and visitors to refrain from traveling toward the Crimean Bridge after Ukrainian forces attacked it again.
[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261116-ukraine-hits-key-crimea-bridge-with-drones) reported that a correspondent stated Ukraine hit a key Crimea bridge with drones to send a message.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90298) reported that Russian-installed authorities suspended traffic after the Crimean Bridge was attacked on Tuesday, following Russian missile strikes.
[TASS](https://tass.com/society/2219169) reported that motor traffic along the Crimean Bridge resumed on a single lane with an alternating flow after a Ukrainian strike.

[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90263) reported that President Zelensky stated Ukrainian drone campaigns have disabled over 55% of Russian refining capacity, hitting 27 of Russia's 32 refineries, while Bloomberg estimates nearly 40% offline.
[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/16/8063138/) reported that Russian officials stated road traffic has partially resumed on the Crimean Bridge following an attack.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/16/ukraine-drone-kerch-bridge-russia-occupied-crimea) reported that Ukraine targeted the Kerch bridge connecting Russia and occupied Crimea during an overnight drone barrage, leading to temporary traffic restrictions.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261116-russia-says-intercepted-over-1-300-ukrainian-drones-in-a-major-attack), [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/record-number-of-ukrainian-drones-launched-at-russia-moscow-oblast-among-main-targets/) reported that Russia's Defense Ministry stated it intercepted 1,336 Ukrainian drones over 15 regions, Crimea, and surrounding seas.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90237) reported that Moscow's mayor claimed around 600 drones were shot down overnight.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/feature/2026/11/16/ukrainian-drone-attack-damages-crimea-bridge-shutting-down-road-traffic-for-hours-kremlin-says-damage-is-minor), [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/ukrainian-drones-strike-crimea-bridge-kremlin-says-minor-damage-caused-traffic-unaffected-101794834894044.html) reported that Ukrainian drones struck the Crimean Bridge, causing minor damage and traffic restrictions according to the Kremlin and Russian officials.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/germany-news-plans-for-rwanda-migrant-hub-come-under-fire/live-79965639?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/17/why-are-five-eu-countries-reviving-plans-to-deport-migrants-to-rwanda?traffic_source=rss) reported that human rights groups slammed plans by Germany and four other EU states to send rejected asylum seekers to Rwanda as a return hub.

[AllAfrica](https://allafrica.com/stories/202611170105.html), [Jowhar](https://jowhar.com/eu-countries-present-rwanda-agreement-to-create-migrant-return-center-hub/) reported that Rwanda and five European Union member states announced a partnership to establish a migrant return hub in Rwanda.

[The Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/11/17/world/politics/european-nations-rwanda-hub-migrants/) reported that Germany, Denmark, Austria, Greece, and the Netherlands planned a Rwanda migrant hub despite human rights protests and a UNHCR warning.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/germany-eu-states-open-talks-on-rwanda-deportation-scheme/a-79959158?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that Germany joined four other EU states to open talks on establishing a migrant deportation hub in Rwanda following the approval of EU regulations easing deportations.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/rwanda-to-host-hub-for-rejected-eu-migrants) reported that five European countries are negotiating a deal to deport rejected asylum seekers to Rwanda to host a hub.

[teleSUR English](https://www.telesurenglish.net/rwanda-to-create-return-center-for-asylum-seekers/), a state-media outlet, reported that Austrian Chancellor Christian Stocker announced the plan aims to avoid human trafficking networks and reduce deaths on migration routes.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivwFBVV95cUxOZFh2TV8xR3JSejFkM0c0RjBIVmVsWXhkZUtTWHlsLTY4WEI0Q0hVZDJFQURQaWdpM3JtRFdocXFpcW85RTJGeVgzaGhyODNTTUxIcHc5YUl4SWVQU0dwb0d3XzRzZFB0QjBrY2VGQWFSUVRWLTZNeUZZd1dSdnNJTG1zRzI2VXN3TGFTM092MEhRMjRkblBmeXZJSVhacS1aQXg5cG5tOEw2T2MxTjNkdjVOSUtLR1dELUtSdlYwWQ?oc=5) reported that Austria stated five EU countries are starting talks with Rwanda on a deportation hub.
[Kyiv Post](https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90286) reported that Danish Prime Minister Mette Frederiksen defended the plan.

[Le Figaro](https://www.lefigaro.fr/international/cinq-pays-de-l-union-europeenne-devoilent-leur-projet-de-centre-pour-migrants-au-rwanda-20261116) reported that the project aims to facilitate the return of individuals whose asylum applications were rejected or who lack the right to stay in the European Union.

[RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/europe/2026/1116/1599373-eu-migrant-hub-deal/), [Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/europe/5-eu-nations-present-plan-for-1st-migrant-return-hub-in-rwanda) reported that five EU nations presented a plan alongside Rwandan officials to establish the first migrant deportation center in Rwanda.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/16/five-eu-countries-unveil-rwanda-deportation-plan-in-migration-crackdown), [Politico](https://www.politico.eu/article/5-countries-announce-plan-to-deport-failed-asylum-seekers-to-rwanda/?utm_source=RSS_Feed&utm_medium=RSS&utm_campaign=RSS_Syndication) reported that Germany, Denmark, Austria, Greece, and the Netherlands aim to begin deporting rejected asylum seekers to Rwanda in 2027.
[Legit (Nigeria)](https://www.legit.ng/world/1741658-5-eu-countries-plan-open-migrant-deportation-centre-rwanda-2027/) reported that rights groups raised concerns over detention and DR Congo.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/16/five-eu-countries-to-announce-first-ever-return-hub-for-migrants-in-rwanda), [France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/africa/20261116-eu-nations-to-unveil-rwanda-deal-for-migrant-return-hub) reported that Denmark, Austria, Germany, the Netherlands, and Greece are set to announce a deal to establish a migrant deportation center in Rwanda.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/rwanda-asylum-seeker-deportation-eu-scheme-b3085455.html) reported that two lawmakers were shown facilities earmarked for Britain's abandoned Rwanda scheme.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/middle-east/iran-news/article-915109) reported that sources familiar with the intelligence described the planning to CNN as an effort to give Iran additional options rather than evidence of an imminent attack.
